@Erdos597Object.SetInterpretation.cliqueFree_four_iff : ∀ {V : Type u_1} (G : SimpleGraph V),
  G.CliqueFree 4 ↔ ∀ (a b c d : V), ¬(G.Adj a b ∧ G.Adj a c ∧ G.Adj a d ∧ G.Adj b c ∧ G.Adj b d ∧ G.Adj c d)
theorem Erdos597Object.SetInterpretation.cliqueFree_four_iff.{u_1} : ∀ {V : Type u_1} (G : SimpleGraph V),
  G.CliqueFree 4 ↔ ∀ (a b c d : V), ¬(G.Adj a b ∧ G.Adj a c ∧ G.Adj a d ∧ G.Adj b c ∧ G.Adj b d ∧ G.Adj c d) :=

theorem Erdos597Object.SetInterpretation.cliqueFreeFourValue_set : ∀ (vertices edges : ZFSet.{0}),
  Erdos597Object.cliqueFreeFourValue Erdos597Object.SetInterpretation.setStructure vertices edges ↔

        ∀ c ∈ vertices,
          ∀ d ∈ vertices,
            ¬(a.pair b ∈ edges ∧

      Exists.casesOn (ZFSet.mem_range.mp h) fun w heq =>

              ∀ (hab : G.Adj x_1.1 x_1.2), (↑(↑⟨x_1, hab⟩).1).pair ↑(↑⟨x_1, hab⟩).2 = (↑x).pair ↑y → G.Adj x y) val

@Erdos597.ordinalGraphRamsey_comap_equiv : ∀ {V : Type u_1} {W : Type u_2} (alpha beta : Ordinal.{0}) (e : V ≃ W)
  (G : SimpleGraph W),
  Erdos597.OrdinalGraphRamsey alpha beta (SimpleGraph.comap (⇑e) G) ↔ Erdos597.OrdinalGraphRamsey alpha beta G
theorem Erdos597.ordinalGraphRamsey_comap_equiv.{u_1, u_2} : ∀ {V : Type u_1} {W : Type u_2} (alpha beta : Ordinal.{0})
  (e : V ≃ W) (G : SimpleGraph W),
  Erdos597.OrdinalGraphRamsey alpha beta (SimpleGraph.comap (⇑e) G) ↔ Erdos597.OrdinalGraphRamsey alpha beta G :=
fun {V} {W} alpha beta e G =>
  {
    mp := fun h red blue hcompl =>
      Or.casesOn (h red blue hcompl) (fun hred => Or.inl hred) fun h =>
        Exists.casesOn h fun f h =>
          And.casesOn h fun hfinj hmap =>
            Or.inr
              (Exists.intro (fun w => f (e.symm w))
                ⟨Function.Injective.comp hfinj (Equiv.injective e.symm), fun a b hab =>
                  hmap (e.symm a) (e.symm b)
                    (Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (Eq.trans SimpleGraph.comap_adj._simp_1
                          (congr (congrArg G.Adj (Equiv.apply_symm_apply e a)) (Equiv.apply_symm_apply e b))))
                      hab)⟩),
    mpr := fun h red blue hcompl =>
      Or.casesOn (h red blue hcompl) (fun hred => Or.inl hred) fun h =>
        Exists.casesOn h fun f h =>
          And.casesOn h fun hfinj hmap =>
            Or.inr
              (Exists.intro (fun v => f (e v))
                ⟨Function.Injective.comp hfinj (Equiv.injective e), fun x x_1 hab => hmap (e x) (e x_1) hab⟩) }

theorem Erdos597Object.OriginalPartition.avoiding_embedding_iff_clique : ∀ (alpha beta : Ordinal.{0})
  (H : SimpleGraph alpha.ToType),
  (∃ f, ∀ (x y : beta.ToType), x ≠ y → ¬H.Adj (f x) (f y)) ↔

  {
    mp := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun f havoid =>

@Erdos597Object.OriginalPartition.original_iff_transported : ∀ {U : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {W : Type u_3}

  {W : Type u_3} {r : U → U → Prop} {s : V → V → Prop} (alpha beta : Ordinal.{0}) (redIso : (fun x1 x2 => x1 < x2) ≃r r)

  Erdos597.OrdinalGraphRamsey alpha beta G ↔
    ∀ (H : SimpleGraph V), (∃ f, ∀ (x y : U), x ≠ y → ¬H.Adj (f x) (f y)) ∨ G.IsContained H :=

  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrArg (fun _a => _a ↔ ∀ (H : SimpleGraph V), (∃ f, ∀ (x y : U), x ≠ y → ¬H.Adj (f x) (f y)) ∨ G.IsContained H)
        (propext (Erdos597Object.OriginalPartition.original_iff_ordered_embeddings alpha beta G))))
    {
      mp := fun h H =>
        Or.casesOn (h (SimpleGraph.comap (⇑hostIso) H))
          (fun h =>
            Exists.casesOn h fun f havoid =>
              Or.inl
                (Exists.intro ((redIso.symm.toRelEmbedding.trans f).trans hostIso.toRelEmbedding) fun x y hxy =>
                  havoid (redIso.symm x) (redIso.symm y) fun heq => hxy (RelIso.injective redIso.symm heq)))
          fun hcopy =>
          Or.inr
            (SimpleGraph.IsContained.trans hcopy
              (SimpleGraph.Copy.isContained (SimpleGraph.Iso.comap hostIso.toEquiv H).toCopy)),
      mpr := fun h H =>
        Or.casesOn (h (SimpleGraph.comap (⇑hostIso.symm) H))
          (fun h =>
            Exists.casesOn h fun f havoid =>
              Or.inl
                (Exists.intro ((redIso.toRelEmbedding.trans f).trans hostIso.symm.toRelEmbedding) fun x y hxy =>
                  havoid (redIso x) (redIso y) fun heq => hxy (RelIso.injective redIso heq)))
          fun hcopy =>
          Or.inr
            (SimpleGraph.IsContained.trans hcopy
              (SimpleGraph.Copy.isContained (SimpleGraph.Iso.comap hostIso.symm.toEquiv H).toCopy)) }

    mp := fun h =>
      And.casesOn ((Erdos597Object.SetProducts.lexOrderValue_set (left.prod right) order).mp h) fun hbetween horder =>

                  Exists.casesOn right_1 fun y h =>

                        entry ∈ order → entry ∈ Erdos597Object.SetProducts.lexOrderSet left right)

theorem Erdos597Object.MartinTransport.ccc_map_orderIso.{u_1, u_2} : ∀ {P : Type u_1} {Q : Type u_2}
  [inst : PartialOrder P] [inst_1 : PartialOrder Q] (e : P ≃o Q),
  Erdos597Object.MartinTransport.CountableChainCondition P → Erdos597Object.MartinTransport.CountableChainCondition Q :=
fun {P} {Q} [PartialOrder P] [PartialOrder Q] e h A hA =>
  have hpre := fun ⦃x⦄ hx ⦃y⦄ hy hxy hcommon =>
    Exists.casesOn hcommon fun z h =>
      And.casesOn h fun hzx hzy =>
        hA hx hy (fun heq => hxy (OrderIso.injective e heq))
          (Exists.intro (e z) ⟨OrderIso.monotone e hzx, OrderIso.monotone e hzy⟩);
  have himage := Set.Countable.image (h (⇑e ⁻¹' A) hpre) ⇑e;
  Eq.mp (congrArg Set.Countable ((fun x_0 => (fun x_0 => Set.image_preimage_eq x_0 (OrderIso.surjective e)) x_0) A))
    himage

theorem Erdos597Object.MartinTransport.small_martin_axiom.{u_1, u_2} : Erdos597.MartinAxiomAlephOne →
  ∀ (P : Type u_1) [inst : PartialOrder P] [Small.{0, u_1} P],
    Erdos597Object.MartinTransport.CountableChainCondition P →
      ∀ (I : Type u_2) [inst_2 : Small.{0, u_2} I],
        Cardinal.mk (Shrink.{0, u_2} I) ≤ Cardinal.aleph 1 →
          ∀ (D : I → Set P),
            (∀ (i : I) (p : P), ∃ q ∈ D i, q ≤ p) → ∀ (p : P), ∃ F, p ∈ F ∧ ∀ (i : I), ∃ q ∈ F, q ∈ D i :=
fun h P [PartialOrder P] [Small.{0, u_1} P] hccc I [Small.{0, u_2} I] hcard D hdense p =>
  let e := orderIsoShrink P;
  let d := equivShrink I;
  have hccc' :=
    (Erdos597Object.MartinTransport.ccc_original_iff (Shrink.{0, u_1} P)).mp
      (Erdos597Object.MartinTransport.ccc_map_orderIso e hccc);
  let D' := fun i => ⇑e.symm ⁻¹' D (d.symm i);
  have hdense' := fun i q =>
    Exists.casesOn (hdense (d.symm i) (e.symm q)) fun r h =>
      And.casesOn h fun hr hrq =>
        Exists.intro (e r)
          ⟨Eq.mpr
              (id
                (Eq.trans Set.mem_preimage._simp_1
                  (congrArg (Membership.mem (D (d.symm i))) (OrderIso.symm_apply_apply e r))))
              hr,
            Eq.mp (congrArg (LE.le (e r)) (OrderIso.apply_symm_apply e q)) (OrderIso.monotone e hrq)⟩;
  Exists.casesOn (h (Shrink.{0, u_1} P) hccc' (Shrink.{0, u_2} I) hcard D' hdense' (e p)) fun F h =>
    And.casesOn h fun hp hF =>
      Exists.intro (Erdos597Object.MartinTransport.pullbackFilter e F)
        ⟨hp, fun i =>
          Exists.casesOn (hF (d i)) fun q h =>
            And.casesOn h fun hq hqD =>
              Exists.intro (e.symm q)
                ⟨Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (Eq.trans (Erdos597Object.MartinTransport.mem_pullbackFilter._simp_1 e F (e.symm q))
                        (congrArg (Membership.mem F) (OrderIso.apply_symm_apply e q))))
                    hq,
                  Eq.mp
                    (Eq.trans
                      (congrFun'
                        (congrArg Membership.mem

@Erdos597Object.MartinTransport.ccc_below : ∀ {P : Type u_1} [inst : PartialOrder P],
  Erdos597Object.MartinTransport.CountableChainCondition P →
    ∀ (p : P), Erdos597Object.MartinTransport.CountableChainCondition { q // q ≤ p }
theorem Erdos597Object.MartinTransport.ccc_below.{u_1} : ∀ {P : Type u_1} [inst : PartialOrder P],
  Erdos597Object.MartinTransport.CountableChainCondition P →
    ∀ (p : P), Erdos597Object.MartinTransport.CountableChainCondition { q // q ≤ p } :=
fun {P} [PartialOrder P] h p A hA =>
  have himage := fun ⦃x⦄ a =>
    Exists.casesOn (motive := fun x_1 => ∀ ⦃y : P⦄, y ∈ Subtype.val '' A → x ≠ y → (fun x y => ¬∃ z ≤ x, z ≤ y) x y) a
      fun a h =>
      And.casesOn (motive := fun x_1 => ∀ ⦃y : P⦄, y ∈ Subtype.val '' A → x ≠ y → (fun x y => ¬∃ z ≤ x, z ≤ y) x y) h
        fun ha right =>
        Eq.ndrec (motive := fun ⦃x⦄ => ∀ ⦃y : P⦄, y ∈ Subtype.val '' A → x ≠ y → (fun x y => ¬∃ z ≤ x, z ≤ y) x y)
          (fun ⦃y⦄ a_1 =>
            Exists.casesOn (motive := fun x => ↑a ≠ y → (fun x y => ¬∃ z ≤ x, z ≤ y) (↑a) y) a_1 fun b h =>
              And.casesOn (motive := fun x => ↑a ≠ y → (fun x y => ¬∃ z ≤ x, z ≤ y) (↑a) y) h fun hb right =>
                Eq.ndrec (motive := fun ⦃y⦄ => ↑a ≠ y → (fun x y => ¬∃ z ≤ x, z ≤ y) (↑a) y)
                  (fun hab a_2 =>
                    Exists.casesOn a_2 fun z h =>
                      And.casesOn h fun hza hzb =>
                        hA ha hb (fun h => hab (congrArg Subtype.val h))
                          (Exists.intro ⟨z, LE.le.trans hza a.property⟩ ⟨hza, hzb⟩))
                  right)
          right;
  have hc := h (Subtype.val '' A) himage;
  have hmaps := fun q hq => Exists.intro q ⟨hq, rfl⟩;
  Set.MapsTo.countable_of_injOn hmaps (Function.Injective.injOn Subtype.val_injective) hc
'Erdos597Object.MartinTransport.ccc_below' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]
Erdos597Object.MartinTransport.unbased_to_based : Erdos597Object.MartinTransport.UnbasedMartinAxiomAlephOne →
  Erdos597.MartinAxiomAlephOne
theorem Erdos597Object.MartinTransport.unbased_to_based : Erdos597Object.MartinTransport.UnbasedMartinAxiomAlephOne →
  Erdos597.MartinAxiomAlephOne :=
fun h P [PartialOrder P] hccc I hI D hD p =>
  let Q := { q // q ≤ p };
  have hQ := Nonempty.intro ⟨p, le_rfl⟩;
  have hcccQ :=
    (Erdos597Object.MartinTransport.ccc_original_iff Q).mp
      (Erdos597Object.MartinTransport.ccc_below ((Erdos597Object.MartinTransport.ccc_original_iff P).mpr hccc) p);
  let D' := fun i => Subtype.val ⁻¹' D i;
  have hdense := fun i q =>
    Exists.casesOn (hD i ↑q) fun r h =>
      And.casesOn h fun hrD hrq => Exists.intro ⟨r, LE.le.trans hrq q.property⟩ ⟨hrD, hrq⟩;
  Exists.casesOn (h Q hQ hcccQ I hI D' hdense) fun F hF =>
    let A := {q | ∃ r ∈ F, ↑r ≤ q};
    have hfilter :=
      Order.IsPFilter.of_def
        (Exists.casesOn (Order.PFilter.nonempty F) fun r hr => Exists.intro (↑r) (Exists.intro r ⟨hr, le_rfl⟩))
        (fun x a =>
          Exists.casesOn (motive := fun x_1 =>
            ∀ y ∈ A, ∃ z ∈ A, (fun x1 x2 => x1 ≥ x2) x z ∧ (fun x1 x2 => x1 ≥ x2) y z) a fun a h =>
            And.casesOn (motive := fun x_1 => ∀ y ∈ A, ∃ z ∈ A, (fun x1 x2 => x1 ≥ x2) x z ∧ (fun x1 x2 => x1 ≥ x2) y z)
              h fun ha hax y a_1 =>
              Exists.casesOn a_1 fun b h =>
                And.casesOn h fun hb hby =>
                  Exists.casesOn (Order.PFilter.directed F a ha b hb) fun c h =>
                    And.casesOn h fun hc right =>
                      And.casesOn right fun hca hcb =>
                        Exists.intro ↑c
                          ⟨Exists.intro c ⟨hc, le_rfl⟩,
                            ⟨LE.le.trans
                                (have this := hca;
                                this)
                                hax,
                              LE.le.trans
                                (have this := hcb;
                                this)
                                hby⟩⟩)
        fun {x y} hxy a =>
        Exists.casesOn a fun r h => And.casesOn h fun hr hrx => Exists.intro r ⟨hr, LE.le.trans hrx hxy⟩;
    Exists.intro hfilter.toPFilter
      ⟨Exists.casesOn (Order.PFilter.nonempty F) fun r hr => Exists.intro r ⟨hr, r.property⟩, fun i =>
        Exists.casesOn (hF i) fun r h => And.casesOn h fun hr hrD => Exists.intro ↑r ⟨Exists.intro r ⟨hr, le_rfl⟩, hrD⟩⟩

theorem Erdos597Object.PosetEncoding.pair_mem_orderCode : ∀ (P : Type) [inst : PartialOrder P] (x y : P),
  (↑((Erdos597Object.SetSubsets.typeEquiv P) x)).pair ↑((Erdos597Object.SetSubsets.typeEquiv P) y) ∈
      Erdos597Object.PosetEncoding.orderCode P ↔
    x ≤ y :=
fun P [PartialOrder P] x y =>
  {
    mp := fun h =>
      Exists.casesOn (ZFSet.mem_range.mp h) fun w hp =>
        Subtype.casesOn (motive := fun x_1 =>
          (↑((Erdos597Object.SetSubsets.typeEquiv P) (↑x_1).1)).pair
                ↑((Erdos597Object.SetSubsets.typeEquiv P) (↑x_1).2) =
              (↑((Erdos597Object.SetSubsets.typeEquiv P) x)).pair ↑((Erdos597Object.SetSubsets.typeEquiv P) y) →
            x ≤ y)
          w
          (fun val hab hp =>
            Prod.casesOn (motive := fun x_1 =>
              ∀ (hab : x_1.1 ≤ x_1.2),
                (↑((Erdos597Object.SetSubsets.typeEquiv P) (↑⟨x_1, hab⟩).1)).pair
                      ↑((Erdos597Object.SetSubsets.typeEquiv P) (↑⟨x_1, hab⟩).2) =
                    (↑((Erdos597Object.SetSubsets.typeEquiv P) x)).pair ↑((Erdos597Object.SetSubsets.typeEquiv P) y) →
                  x ≤ y)
              val
              (fun a b hab hp =>
                And.casesOn (ZFSet.pair_inj.mp hp) fun ha hb =>
                  have hax := Equiv.injective (Erdos597Object.SetSubsets.typeEquiv P) (Subtype.ext ha);
                  have hby := Equiv.injective (Erdos597Object.SetSubsets.typeEquiv P) (Subtype.ext hb);
                  Eq.mp (congr (congrArg LE.le hax) hby) hab)
              hab hp)
          hp,
    mpr := fun h => ZFSet.mem_range.mpr (Exists.intro ⟨(x, y), h⟩ rfl) }

Erdos597Object.SetAxioms.omega_subset_of_ordinal_inductive : ∀ (x : ZFSet.{0}),
  x.IsOrdinal → ∅ ∈ x → (∀ a ∈ x, ∃ b ∈ x, a ∈ b) → ZFSet.omega ⊆ x
theorem Erdos597Object.SetAxioms.omega_subset_of_ordinal_inductive : ∀ (x : ZFSet.{0}),
  x.IsOrdinal → ∅ ∈ x → (∀ a ∈ x, ∃ b ∈ x, a ∈ b) → ZFSet.omega ⊆ x :=
fun x hx hzero hstep =>
  Exists.casesOn (ZFSet.isOrdinal_iff_mem_range_toZFSet.mp hx) fun a h =>
    Eq.ndrec (motive := fun x => x.IsOrdinal → ∅ ∈ x → (∀ a ∈ x, ∃ b ∈ x, a ∈ b) → ZFSet.omega ⊆ x)
      (fun hx hzero hstep =>
        have hn := fun n =>
          Nat.recAux
            (Ordinal.toZFSet_mem_toZFSet_iff.mp
              (Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg (Membership.mem a.toZFSet)
                    (Eq.trans (congrArg Ordinal.toZFSet Nat.cast_zero) Ordinal.toZFSet_zero)))
                hzero))
            (fun n ih =>
              Exists.casesOn (hstep (↑n).toZFSet (Ordinal.toZFSet_mem_toZFSet_iff.mpr ih)) fun y h =>
                And.casesOn h fun hy hny =>
                  Exists.casesOn (Ordinal.mem_toZFSet_iff.mp hy) fun b h =>
                    And.casesOn h fun hba right =>
                      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun y => y ∈ a.toZFSet → (↑n).toZFSet ∈ y → ↑(n + 1) < a)
                        (fun hy hny =>
                          have hnb := Ordinal.toZFSet_mem_toZFSet_iff.mp hny;
                          lt_of_le_of_lt
                            (Eq.mpr (id (congrFun' (congrArg LE.le (Ordinal.natCast_succ n)) b))
                              (Order.succ_le_of_lt hnb))
                            hba)
                        right hy hny)
            n;
        fun ⦃z⦄ hz =>
        Exists.casesOn ((Erdos597Object.OrdinalPresentation.mem_omega_iff z).mp hz) fun n h =>
          Eq.ndrec (motive := fun ⦃z⦄ => z ∈ ZFSet.omega → z ∈ a.toZFSet)
            (fun hz => Ordinal.toZFSet_mem_toZFSet_iff.mpr (hn n)) h hz)
      h hx hzero hstep
'Erdos597Object.SetAxioms.omega_subset_of_ordinal_inductive' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]

Erdos597Object.SetCollection.set_collection_property : ∀ (relation : ZFSet.{0} → ZFSet.{0} → Prop) (domain : ZFSet.{0}),
  (∀ x ∈ domain, ∃ y, relation x y) →
    ∃ image, (∀ x ∈ domain, ∃ y ∈ image, relation x y) ∧ ∀ y ∈ image, ∃ x ∈ domain, relation x y
theorem Erdos597Object.SetCollection.set_collection_property : ∀ (relation : ZFSet.{0} → ZFSet.{0} → Prop)
  (domain : ZFSet.{0}),
  (∀ x ∈ domain, ∃ y, relation x y) →
    ∃ image, (∀ x ∈ domain, ∃ y ∈ image, relation x y) ∧ ∀ y ∈ image, ∃ x ∈ domain, relation x y :=
fun relation domain h =>
  have hchoice := fun x => h (↑x) x.property;
  (fun f hf =>
      Exists.intro (ZFSet.range f)
        ⟨fun x hx => Exists.intro (f ⟨x, hx⟩) ⟨ZFSet.mem_range_self ⟨x, hx⟩, hf ⟨x, hx⟩⟩, fun y hy =>
          Exists.casesOn (ZFSet.mem_range.mp hy) fun x h =>
            Eq.ndrec (motive := fun y => y ∈ ZFSet.range f → ∃ x ∈ domain, relation x y)
              (fun hy => Exists.intro ↑x ⟨x.property, hf x⟩) h hy⟩)
    (fun x => Classical.choose (hchoice x)) fun x => Classical.choose_spec (hchoice x)

Erdos597Object.SetZorn.maximal_of_union_closed : ∀ (A : ZFSet.{0}),
  (∀ c ⊆ A, (∀ (x y : ZFSet.{0}), x ∈ c → y ∈ c → x ⊆ y ∨ y ⊆ x) → c.sUnion ∈ A) → ∃ m ∈ A, ∀ z ∈ A, m ⊆ z → m = z
theorem Erdos597Object.SetZorn.maximal_of_union_closed : ∀ (A : ZFSet.{0}),
  (∀ c ⊆ A, (∀ (x y : ZFSet.{0}), x ∈ c → y ∈ c → x ⊆ y ∨ y ⊆ x) → c.sUnion ∈ A) → ∃ m ∈ A, ∀ z ∈ A, m ⊆ z → m = z :=
fun A hclosed =>
  have hbound := fun c hc hchain =>
    let code := ZFSet.range fun x => ↑x;
    have hcode := fun ⦃x⦄ hx =>
      Exists.casesOn (ZFSet.mem_range.mp hx) fun y h =>
        Eq.ndrec (motive := fun ⦃x⦄ => x ∈ code → x ∈ A) (fun hx => hc y.property) h hx;
    have hcodeChain := fun x y hx hy =>
      Exists.casesOn (ZFSet.mem_range.mp hx) fun a h =>
        Eq.ndrec (motive := fun x => x ∈ code → x ⊆ y ∨ y ⊆ x)
          (fun hx =>
            Exists.casesOn (ZFSet.mem_range.mp hy) fun b h =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun y => y ∈ code → ↑a ⊆ y ∨ y ⊆ ↑a)
                (fun hy => if hab : ↑a = ↑b then Or.inl (hab ▸ le_rfl) else hchain a.property b.property hab) h hy)
          h hx;
    Exists.intro code.sUnion
      ⟨hclosed code hcode hcodeChain, fun z hz ⦃y⦄ hy =>
        ZFSet.mem_sUnion.mpr (Exists.intro z ⟨ZFSet.mem_range.mpr (Exists.intro ⟨z, hz⟩ rfl), hy⟩)⟩;
  Exists.casesOn (zorn_le₀ (↑A) hbound) fun m hm =>
    Exists.intro m ⟨hm.left, fun z hz hmz => le_antisymm hmz (hm.right hz hmz)⟩

  Cardinal.mk I ≤ Cardinal.aleph 1 →

                        x))

                      (congrArg LE.le

@Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.compatible_iff : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  {P : Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.BooleanPoset B I} (p q : Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.Condition P),
  (∃ r ≤ p, r ≤ q) ↔ p.value ⊓ q.value ⊓ Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.compatibleValue P p.label q.label ≠ ⊥
theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.compatible_iff : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  {P : Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.BooleanPoset B I} (p q : Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.Condition P),
  (∃ r ≤ p, r ≤ q) ↔ p.value ⊓ q.value ⊓ Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.compatibleValue P p.label q.label ≠ ⊥ :=
fun {B I} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] {P} p q =>
  {
    mp := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun r h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hrp hrq heq =>
          have hrel := le_iSup_of_le r.label (le_inf hrp.right hrq.right);
          have hbound := le_inf (le_inf hrp.left hrq.left) hrel;
          r.nonzero (bot_unique (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => r.value ≤ _a) heq) hbound)),
    mpr := fun hnonzero =>
      have hex :=
        Decidable.byContradiction fun h =>
          hnonzero
            (of_eq_true
              (Eq.trans
                (congrFun'
                  (congrArg Eq
                    (Eq.trans (inf_iSup_eq (p.value ⊓ q.value) fun i => P.leValue i p.label ⊓ P.leValue i q.label)
                      (Eq.trans
                        (congrArg iSup
                          (funext fun i =>
                            (fun k =>
                                Eq.mp
                                  (Eq.trans
                                    (Mathlib.Tactic.Push.not_exists._simp_1 fun k =>
                                      p.value ⊓ q.value ⊓ (P.leValue k p.label ⊓ P.leValue k q.label) ≠ ⊥)
                                    (forall_congr fun k => Classical.not_not._simp_2))
                                  h k)
                              i))
                        iSup_bot)))
                  ⊥)
                (eq_self ⊥)));
      Exists.casesOn hex fun k hk =>
        let r :=
          { value := p.value ⊓ q.value ⊓ (P.leValue k p.label ⊓ P.leValue k q.label), label := k, nonzero := hk,
            valid :=
              LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_left) (LE.le.trans (P.le_members k p.label) inf_le_left) };
        Exists.intro r
          ⟨⟨LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_left, LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_left⟩,
            ⟨LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_right, LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_right⟩⟩ }

@Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.disjoint_family_support_countable : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B],
  Flypitch.BA_CCC B →
    ∀ {J : Type} (weight : J → B), (∀ (i j : J), i ≠ j → weight i ⊓ weight j = ⊥) → {i | weight i ≠ ⊥}.Countable
theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.disjoint_family_support_countable : ∀ {B : Type}
  [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B],
  Flypitch.BA_CCC B →
    ∀ {J : Type} (weight : J → B), (∀ (i j : J), i ≠ j → weight i ⊓ weight j = ⊥) → {i | weight i ≠ ⊥}.Countable :=
fun {B} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] hB {J} weight hdisjoint =>
  let support := {i | weight i ≠ ⊥};
  have hnonzero := fun b a => Exists.casesOn a fun i h => And.casesOn h fun hi right => right ▸ hi;
  have hpair := fun a a_1 =>
    Exists.casesOn (motive := fun x => ∀ b ∈ weight '' support, a ≠ b → a ⊓ b = ⊥) a_1 fun i h =>
      And.casesOn (motive := fun x => ∀ b ∈ weight '' support, a ≠ b → a ⊓ b = ⊥) h fun left right =>
        Eq.ndrec (motive := fun a => ∀ b ∈ weight '' support, a ≠ b → a ⊓ b = ⊥)
          (fun b a =>
            Exists.casesOn (motive := fun x => weight i ≠ b → weight i ⊓ b = ⊥) a fun j h =>
              And.casesOn (motive := fun x => weight i ≠ b → weight i ⊓ b = ⊥) h fun left right =>
                Eq.ndrec (motive := fun b => weight i ≠ b → weight i ⊓ b = ⊥)
                  (fun hab => hdisjoint i j fun hij => hab (congrArg weight hij)) right)
          right;
  have hcount := hB (weight '' support) hnonzero hpair;
  have hinjective := fun ⦃i⦄ hi ⦃j⦄ a hij =>
    Classical.byContradiction fun hne =>
      have hzero := hdisjoint i j hne;
      hi
        (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a = ⊥) (inf_idem (weight i)))
          (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => weight i ⊓ _a = ⊥) (Eq.symm hij)) hzero));
  have hmaps := fun i hi => Exists.intro i ⟨hi, rfl⟩;
  Set.MapsTo.countable_of_injOn hmaps hinjective hcount

 Classical.choice,
 Quot.sound]
@Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.countable_support_of_cover : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B],
  Flypitch.BA_CCC B →
    ∀ {J : Type} (weight : J → B),
      Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.HasCountableCover weight → {i | weight i ≠ ⊥}.Countable
theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.countable_support_of_cover : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B],
  Flypitch.BA_CCC B →
    ∀ {J : Type} (weight : J → B),
      Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.HasCountableCover weight → {i | weight i ≠ ⊥}.Countable :=
fun {B} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] hB {J} weight hcover =>
  Exists.casesOn hcover fun rows h =>
    And.casesOn h fun hrows hbound =>
      have hcount :=
        Set.countable_iUnion fun n =>
          Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.disjoint_family_support_countable hB (rows n) (hrows n);
      (fun h => Set.Countable.mono h hcount) fun ⦃i⦄ hi =>
        Classical.byContradiction fun hnot =>
          have hzero := fun n => Classical.byContradiction fun hne => hnot (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr (Exists.intro n hne));
          have hle := hbound i;
          hi
            (bot_unique
              (Eq.mp
                (congrArg (LE.le (weight i)) (Eq.trans (congrArg iSup (funext fun n => (fun n => hzero n) n)) iSup_bot))
                hle))

  Flypitch.BA_CCC B →
    ∀ (P : Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.BooleanPoset B I),
      Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.BooleanCountableChainCondition P →

      have hne := fun h => hpq (Subtype.ext h);

    Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.countable_support_of_cover hB weight (hP (↑A) label weight hvalid hincompatible);
  have hall := Set.eq_univ_of_forall fun p => (↑p).nonzero;

@Erdos597Object.PosetCompletion.lower_topology_ccc : ∀ {P : Type} [inst : PartialOrder P],
  Erdos597Object.MartinTransport.CountableChainCondition P →
    Flypitch.countable_chain_condition (Topology.WithLowerSet P)
theorem Erdos597Object.PosetCompletion.lower_topology_ccc : ∀ {P : Type} [inst : PartialOrder P],
  Erdos597Object.MartinTransport.CountableChainCondition P →
    Flypitch.countable_chain_condition (Topology.WithLowerSet P) :=
fun {P} [PartialOrder P] hP =>
  Flypitch.countable_chain_condition_of_nonempty fun family hnonempty hopen hdisjoint =>
    have hpoint := fun U => Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr (hnonempty U.property);
    (fun point hpoint =>
        let choosePoint := fun U => Topology.WithLowerSet.ofLowerSet (point U);
        have hincompatible := fun U V hne a =>
          Exists.casesOn a fun r h =>
            And.casesOn h fun hrU hrV =>
              have hlowerU := Topology.IsLowerSet.isOpen_iff_isLowerSet.mp (hopen U.property);
              have hlowerV := Topology.IsLowerSet.isOpen_iff_isLowerSet.mp (hopen V.property);
              have hmemU := hlowerU hrU (hpoint U);
              have hmemV := hlowerV hrV (hpoint V);
              Set.disjoint_left.mp (hdisjoint U.property V.property fun h => hne (Subtype.ext h)) hmemU hmemV;
        have hinjective := fun ⦃U V⦄ hpointEq =>
          Decidable.byContradiction fun hne =>
            hincompatible U V hne
              (Exists.intro (choosePoint U)
                ⟨le_rfl, Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ≤ choosePoint V) hpointEq)) (le_refl (choosePoint V))⟩);
        have hanti := fun ⦃p⦄ a =>
          Exists.casesOn (motive := fun x =>
            ∀ ⦃y : P⦄, y ∈ Set.range choosePoint → p ≠ y → (fun p q => ¬∃ r ≤ p, r ≤ q) p y) a fun U h =>
            Eq.ndrec (motive := fun ⦃p⦄ =>
              ∀ ⦃y : P⦄, y ∈ Set.range choosePoint → p ≠ y → (fun p q => ¬∃ r ≤ p, r ≤ q) p y)
              (fun ⦃q⦄ a =>
                Exists.casesOn (motive := fun x => choosePoint U ≠ q → (fun p q => ¬∃ r ≤ p, r ≤ q) (choosePoint U) q) a
                  fun V h =>
                  Eq.ndrec (motive := fun ⦃q⦄ => choosePoint U ≠ q → (fun p q => ¬∃ r ≤ p, r ≤ q) (choosePoint U) q)
                    (fun hpq => hincompatible U V fun h => hpq (congrArg choosePoint h)) h)
              h;
        have hcount := hP (Set.range choosePoint) hanti;
        have hmaps := fun U x => Exists.intro U rfl;
        have huniv := Set.MapsTo.countable_of_injOn hmaps (Function.Injective.injOn hinjective) hcount;
        Set.to_countable family)
      (fun U => Classical.choose (hpoint U)) fun U => Classical.choose_spec (hpoint U)

@Erdos597Object.PosetCompletion.countable_join_representation : ∀ {P B : Type} [inst : PartialOrder P]
  [inst_1 : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B],
  Erdos597Object.MartinTransport.CountableChainCondition P →
    ∀ (image : P → B),
      (∀ (p q : P), (∃ r ≤ p, r ≤ q) ↔ image p ⊓ image q ≠ ⊥) →
        (∀ (b : B), b ≠ ⊥ → ∃ p, image p ≤ b) →
          ∀ (b : B), ∃ A, A.Countable ∧ b = Erdos597Object.PosetCompletion.joinOfSubset image A
theorem Erdos597Object.PosetCompletion.countable_join_representation : ∀ {P B : Type} [inst : PartialOrder P]
  [inst_1 : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B],
  Erdos597Object.MartinTransport.CountableChainCondition P →
    ∀ (image : P → B),
      (∀ (p q : P), (∃ r ≤ p, r ≤ q) ↔ image p ⊓ image q ≠ ⊥) →
        (∀ (b : B), b ≠ ⊥ → ∃ p, image p ≤ b) →
          ∀ (b : B), ∃ A, A.Countable ∧ b = Erdos597Object.PosetCompletion.joinOfSubset image A :=
fun {P B} [PartialOrder P] [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] hP image hcompatible hdense b =>
  let families := {A | (∀ p ∈ A, image p ≤ b) ∧ A.Pairwise fun p q => ¬∃ r ≤ p, r ≤ q};
  have hchain := fun c hc hcc =>
    Exists.intro (⋃₀ c)
      ⟨⟨fun p a => Exists.casesOn a fun A h => And.casesOn h fun hA hp => (hc hA).left p hp, fun ⦃p⦄ a =>
          Exists.casesOn (motive := fun x => ∀ ⦃y : P⦄, y ∈ ⋃₀ c → p ≠ y → (fun p q => ¬∃ r ≤ p, r ≤ q) p y) a
            fun A h =>
            And.casesOn (motive := fun x => ∀ ⦃y : P⦄, y ∈ ⋃₀ c → p ≠ y → (fun p q => ¬∃ r ≤ p, r ≤ q) p y) h
              fun hA hp ⦃q⦄ a =>
              Exists.casesOn (motive := fun x => p ≠ q → (fun p q => ¬∃ r ≤ p, r ≤ q) p q) a fun C h =>
                And.casesOn (motive := fun x => p ≠ q → (fun p q => ¬∃ r ≤ p, r ≤ q) p q) h fun hC hq hpq =>
                  Or.casesOn (eq_or_ne A C)
                    (fun h =>
                      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun C => C ∈ c → q ∈ C → ¬∃ r ≤ p, r ≤ q)
                        (fun hC hq => (hc hA).right hp hq hpq) h hC hq)
                    fun hne =>
                    Or.casesOn (hcc hA hC hne) (fun hAC => (hc hC).right (hAC hp) hq hpq) fun hCA =>
                      (hc hA).right hp (hCA hq) hpq⟩,
        fun A hA => Set.subset_sUnion_of_mem hA⟩;
  Exists.casesOn (zorn_subset families hchain) fun A hA =>
    have hcountable := hP A (Maximal.prop hA).right;
    have hbelow := iSup_le fun p => (Maximal.prop hA).left (↑p) p.property;
    have habove :=
      Decidable.byContradiction fun hnot =>
        have hnonzero := fun hzero =>
          hnot
            (Eq.mp (congrArg (LE.le b) (compl_compl (Erdos597Object.PosetCompletion.joinOfSubset image A)))
              (le_compl_iff_disjoint_right.mpr (disjoint_iff.mpr hzero)));
        Exists.casesOn (hdense (b ⊓ (Erdos597Object.PosetCompletion.joinOfSubset image A)ᶜ) hnonzero) fun p hp =>
          have hincompatible := fun q hq hcommon =>
            (hcompatible p q).mp hcommon
              (bot_unique

@Erdos597Object.CompletionEmbedding.mem_perp_lower_iff : ∀ {P : Type} [inst : PartialOrder P]
  (S : Set (Topology.WithLowerSet P)) (p : P),
  Topology.WithLowerSet.toLowerSet p ∈ Sᵖ ↔ ∀ q ≤ p, Topology.WithLowerSet.toLowerSet q ∉ S
theorem Erdos597Object.CompletionEmbedding.mem_perp_lower_iff : ∀ {P : Type} [inst : PartialOrder P]
  (S : Set (Topology.WithLowerSet P)) (p : P),
  Topology.WithLowerSet.toLowerSet p ∈ Sᵖ ↔ ∀ q ≤ p, Topology.WithLowerSet.toLowerSet q ∉ S :=
fun {P} [PartialOrder P] S p =>
  {
    mp := fun hp q hqp hq =>
      Exists.casesOn (Flypitch.mem_perp_iff.mp hp) fun T h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hdisjoint right =>
          And.casesOn right fun hT hpT =>
            have hlower := Topology.IsLowerSet.isOpen_iff_isLowerSet.mp hT;
            have hqT := hlower hqp hpT;
            have hempty :=
              Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => Topology.WithLowerSet.toLowerSet q ∈ _a) (Eq.symm hdisjoint))) ⟨hqT, hq⟩;
            hempty,
    mpr := fun h =>
      Flypitch.mem_perp_iff.mpr
        (Exists.intro (Erdos597Object.PosetCompletion.cone p)
          ⟨Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr fun q a =>
              And.casesOn a fun hqp hq => h (Topology.WithLowerSet.ofLowerSet q) hqp hq,
            ⟨Erdos597Object.PosetCompletion.cone_open p, le_rfl⟩⟩) }

@Erdos597Object.CompletionEmbedding.valueOpen_perp : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (Q : Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.BooleanPoset B I) (b : B),
  Erdos597Object.CompletionEmbedding.valueOpen Q bᵖ = Erdos597Object.CompletionEmbedding.valueOpen Q bᶜ
theorem Erdos597Object.CompletionEmbedding.valueOpen_perp : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (Q : Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.BooleanPoset B I) (b : B),
  Erdos597Object.CompletionEmbedding.valueOpen Q bᵖ = Erdos597Object.CompletionEmbedding.valueOpen Q bᶜ :=
fun {B I} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] Q b =>
  Set.ext fun p =>
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg
          (fun _a =>
            _a ∈ Erdos597Object.CompletionEmbedding.valueOpen Q bᵖ ↔
              _a ∈ Erdos597Object.CompletionEmbedding.valueOpen Q bᶜ)
          (have this := rfl;
          this)))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              _a ↔
                Topology.WithLowerSet.toLowerSet (Topology.WithLowerSet.ofLowerSet p) ∈
                  Erdos597Object.CompletionEmbedding.valueOpen Q bᶜ)
            (propext
              (Erdos597Object.CompletionEmbedding.mem_perp_lower_iff (Erdos597Object.CompletionEmbedding.valueOpen Q b)
                (Topology.WithLowerSet.ofLowerSet p)))))
        (id
          {
            mp := fun hp =>
              le_compl_iff_disjoint_right.mpr
                (disjoint_iff.mpr
                  (Decidable.byContradiction fun hnonzero =>
                    let q :=
                      { value := (Topology.WithLowerSet.ofLowerSet p).value ⊓ b,
                        label := (Topology.WithLowerSet.ofLowerSet p).label, nonzero := hnonzero,
                        valid := LE.le.trans inf_le_left (Topology.WithLowerSet.ofLowerSet p).valid };
                    have hqp :=
                      ⟨inf_le_left,
                        LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans inf_le_left (Topology.WithLowerSet.ofLowerSet p).valid)
                          (Q.reflexive (Topology.WithLowerSet.ofLowerSet p).label)⟩;
                    hp q hqp inf_le_right)),
            mpr := fun hp q hqp hqb =>
              q.nonzero (bot_unique (Trans.trans (le_inf hqb (LE.le.trans hqp.left hp)) (inf_compl_self b))) }))

@Erdos597Object.CompletionEmbedding.baseMap_sSup : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (Q : Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.BooleanPoset B I) (s : Set B),
  Erdos597Object.CompletionEmbedding.baseMap Q (sSup s) = sSup (Erdos597Object.CompletionEmbedding.baseMap Q '' s)
theorem Erdos597Object.CompletionEmbedding.baseMap_sSup : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (Q : Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.BooleanPoset B I) (s : Set B),
  Erdos597Object.CompletionEmbedding.baseMap Q (sSup s) = sSup (Erdos597Object.CompletionEmbedding.baseMap Q '' s) :=
fun {B I} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] Q s =>
  have himages :=
    Set.ext fun d =>
      {
        mp := fun a =>
          Exists.casesOn a fun w h =>
            And.casesOn h fun left right =>
              Exists.casesOn left fun b h =>
                And.casesOn h fun hb right_1 =>
                  Eq.ndrec (motive := fun w =>
                    Erdos597Object.CompletionEmbedding.baseMap Q w = d →
                      d ∈ compl '' Erdos597Object.CompletionEmbedding.baseMap Q '' s)
                    (fun right =>
                      right ▸
                        Exists.intro (Erdos597Object.CompletionEmbedding.baseMap Q b)
                          ⟨Exists.intro b ⟨hb, rfl⟩, Eq.symm (Erdos597Object.CompletionEmbedding.baseMap_compl Q b)⟩)
                    right_1 right,
        mpr := fun a =>
          Exists.casesOn a fun w h =>
            And.casesOn h fun left right =>
              Exists.casesOn left fun b h =>
                And.casesOn h fun hb right_1 =>
                  Eq.ndrec (motive := fun w => wᶜ = d → d ∈ Erdos597Object.CompletionEmbedding.baseMap Q '' compl '' s)

                      right ▸
                        Exists.intro bᶜ
                          ⟨Exists.intro b ⟨hb, rfl⟩, Erdos597Object.CompletionEmbedding.baseMap_compl Q b⟩)
                    right_1 right };
  compl_injective
    (Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a => _a = (sSup (Erdos597Object.CompletionEmbedding.baseMap Q '' s))ᶜ)
          (Eq.symm (Erdos597Object.CompletionEmbedding.baseMap_compl Q (sSup s)))))

        (id

            (fun _a =>
              Erdos597Object.CompletionEmbedding.baseMap Q _a =
                (sSup (Erdos597Object.CompletionEmbedding.baseMap Q '' s))ᶜ)

          (id
            (congrArg (fun _a => _a = (sSup (Erdos597Object.CompletionEmbedding.baseMap Q '' s))ᶜ)
              (Erdos597Object.CompletionEmbedding.baseMap_sInf Q (compl '' s))))
          (Eq.mpr

@Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.rawLE_trans : ∀ {ι : Type} [inst : Preorder ι] [IsDirectedOrder ι] {B : ι → Type}
  [inst_2 : (i : ι) → CompleteBooleanAlgebra (B i)] (e : (i j : ι) → i ≤ j → CompleteLatticeHom (B i) (B j))
  [DirectedSystem B fun x1 x2 x3 => ⇑(e x1 x2 x3)] {p q r : Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.RawCondition e},
  Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.RawLE e p q →
    Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.RawLE e q r → Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.RawLE e p r
theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.rawLE_trans : ∀ {ι : Type} [inst : Preorder ι] [IsDirectedOrder ι]
  {B : ι → Type} [inst_2 : (i : ι) → CompleteBooleanAlgebra (B i)]
  (e : (i j : ι) → i ≤ j → CompleteLatticeHom (B i) (B j)) [DirectedSystem B fun x1 x2 x3 => ⇑(e x1 x2 x3)]
  {p q r : Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.RawCondition e},
  Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.RawLE e p q →
    Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.RawLE e q r → Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.RawLE e p r :=
fun {ι} [Preorder ι] [IsDirectedOrder ι] {B} [(i : ι) → CompleteBooleanAlgebra (B i)] e
    [DirectedSystem B fun x1 x2 x3 => ⇑(e x1 x2 x3)] {p q r} hpq hqr =>
  Exists.casesOn hpq fun i h =>
    Exists.casesOn h fun hpi h =>
      Exists.casesOn h fun hqi hpq =>
        Exists.casesOn hqr fun j h =>
          Exists.casesOn h fun hqj h =>
            Exists.casesOn h fun hrj hqr =>
              Exists.casesOn (exists_ge_ge i j) fun k h =>
                And.casesOn h fun hik hjk =>
                  Exists.intro k
                    (Exists.intro (LE.le.trans hpi hik)
                      (Exists.intro (LE.le.trans hrj hjk)
                        (have hpq' := OrderHomClass.monotone (e i k hik) hpq;
                        have hqr' := OrderHomClass.monotone (e j k hjk) hqr;
                        LE.le.trans
                          (Eq.mp
                            (congr
                              (congrArg LE.le
                                ((fun ⦃i j k⦄ hij hjk x => DirectedSystem.map_map' e hij hjk x) hpi hik p.value))
                              ((fun ⦃i j k⦄ hij hjk x => DirectedSystem.map_map' e hij hjk x) hqi hik q.value))
                            hpq')
                          (Eq.mp
                            (congr
                              (congrArg LE.le
                                ((fun ⦃i j k⦄ hij hjk x => DirectedSystem.map_map' e hij hjk x) hqj hjk q.value))
                              ((fun ⦃i j k⦄ hij hjk x => DirectedSystem.map_map' e hij hjk x) hrj hjk r.value))
                            hqr'))))

  {B : ι → Type} [inst_2 : (i : ι) → CompleteBooleanAlgebra (B i)]

theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.compatible_ofRaw_iff : ∀ {ι : Type} [inst : Preorder ι]
  [inst_1 : IsDirectedOrder ι] {B : ι → Type} [inst_2 : (i : ι) → CompleteBooleanAlgebra (B i)]
  (e : (i j : ι) → i ≤ j → CompleteLatticeHom (B i) (B j)) [inst_3 : DirectedSystem B fun x1 x2 x3 => ⇑(e x1 x2 x3)]
  (p q : Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.RawCondition e),
  (∃ r ≤ Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.ofRaw e p, r ≤ Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.ofRaw e q) ↔
    ∃ r, Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.RawLE e r p ∧ Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.RawLE e r q :=
fun {ι} [Preorder ι] [IsDirectedOrder ι] {B} [(i : ι) → CompleteBooleanAlgebra (B i)] e
    [DirectedSystem B fun x1 x2 x3 => ⇑(e x1 x2 x3)] p q =>
  {
    mp := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun r h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hrp hrq =>
          Exists.casesOn (Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.exists_ofRaw e r) fun s h =>
            Eq.ndrec (motive := fun r =>
              r ≤ Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.ofRaw e p →
                r ≤ Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.ofRaw e q →
                  ∃ r, Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.RawLE e r p ∧ Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.RawLE e r q)
              (fun hrp hrq => Exists.intro s ⟨hrp, hrq⟩) h hrp hrq,
    mpr := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun r h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hrp hrq => Exists.intro (Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.ofRaw e r) ⟨hrp, hrq⟩ }

@Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.raw_compatible_iff_at : ∀ {ι : Type} [inst : Preorder ι] [IsDirectedOrder ι]
  {B : ι → Type} [inst_2 : (i : ι) → CompleteBooleanAlgebra (B i)]
  (e : (i j : ι) → i ≤ j → CompleteLatticeHom (B i) (B j)) [DirectedSystem B fun x1 x2 x3 => ⇑(e x1 x2 x3)],
  (∀ (i j : ι) (h : i ≤ j), Function.Injective ⇑(e i j h)) →
    ∀ (p q : Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.RawCondition e) (k : ι) (hp : p.index ≤ k) (hq : q.index ≤ k),
      (∃ r, Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.RawLE e r p ∧ Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.RawLE e r q) ↔
        (e p.index k hp) p.value ⊓ (e q.index k hq) q.value ≠ ⊥
theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.raw_compatible_iff_at : ∀ {ι : Type} [inst : Preorder ι] [IsDirectedOrder ι]
  {B : ι → Type} [inst_2 : (i : ι) → CompleteBooleanAlgebra (B i)]
  (e : (i j : ι) → i ≤ j → CompleteLatticeHom (B i) (B j)) [DirectedSystem B fun x1 x2 x3 => ⇑(e x1 x2 x3)],
  (∀ (i j : ι) (h : i ≤ j), Function.Injective ⇑(e i j h)) →
    ∀ (p q : Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.RawCondition e) (k : ι) (hp : p.index ≤ k) (hq : q.index ≤ k),
      (∃ r, Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.RawLE e r p ∧ Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.RawLE e r q) ↔
        (e p.index k hp) p.value ⊓ (e q.index k hq) q.value ≠ ⊥ :=
fun {ι} [Preorder ι] [IsDirectedOrder ι] {B} [(i : ι) → CompleteBooleanAlgebra (B i)] e
    [DirectedSystem B fun x1 x2 x3 => ⇑(e x1 x2 x3)] hinj p q k hp hq =>
  {
    mp := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun r h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hrp hrq hzero =>
          Exists.casesOn (exists_ge_ge r.index k) fun m h =>
            And.casesOn h fun hrm hkm =>
              have hrp' :=
                (Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.rawLE_iff_at e hinj r p m hrm (LE.le.trans hp hkm)).mp hrp;
              have hrq' :=
                (Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.rawLE_iff_at e hinj r q m hrm (LE.le.trans hq hkm)).mp hrq;
              have hbound :=
                Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg (fun _a => (e r.index m hrm) r.value ≤ _a)
                      (map_inf (e k m hkm) ((e p.index k hp) p.value) ((e q.index k hq) q.value))))
                  (Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg (LE.le ((e r.index m hrm) r.value))
                        (congr
                          (congrArg min ((fun ⦃i j k⦄ hij hjk x => DirectedSystem.map_map' e hij hjk x) hp hkm p.value))
                          ((fun ⦃i j k⦄ hij hjk x => DirectedSystem.map_map' e hij hjk x) hq hkm q.value))))
                    (le_inf hrp' hrq'));
              Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.mapped_nonzero e hinj hrm r.nonzero
                (bot_unique
                  (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => (e r.index m hrm) r.value ≤ _a) (map_bot (e k m hkm)))
                    (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => (e r.index m hrm) r.value ≤ (e k m hkm) _a) hzero) hbound))),
    mpr := fun hnonzero =>
      let r := { index := k, value := (e p.index k hp) p.value ⊓ (e q.index k hq) q.value, nonzero := hnonzero };
      Exists.intro r
        ⟨Exists.intro k
            (Exists.intro le_rfl
              (Exists.intro hp
                (Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrFun'
                      (congrArg LE.le
                        ((fun ⦃i⦄ x => DirectedSystem.map_self' e x)
                          ((e p.index k hp) p.value ⊓ (e q.index k hq) q.value)))
                      ((e p.index k hp) p.value)))
                  inf_le_left))),
          Exists.intro k
            (Exists.intro le_rfl
              (Exists.intro hq
                (Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrFun'
                      (congrArg LE.le
                        ((fun ⦃i⦄ x => DirectedSystem.map_self' e x)
                          ((e p.index k hp) p.value ⊓ (e q.index k hq) q.value)))
                      ((e q.index k hq) q.value)))
                  inf_le_right)))⟩ }

theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.compatible_ofStage_iff : ∀ {ι : Type} [inst : Preorder ι]
  [inst_1 : IsDirectedOrder ι] {B : ι → Type} [inst_2 : (i : ι) → CompleteBooleanAlgebra (B i)]
  (e : (i j : ι) → i ≤ j → CompleteLatticeHom (B i) (B j)) [inst_3 : DirectedSystem B fun x1 x2 x3 => ⇑(e x1 x2 x3)],
  (∀ (i j : ι) (h : i ≤ j), Function.Injective ⇑(e i j h)) →
    ∀ (i : ι) (b c : B i) (hb : b ≠ ⊥) (hc : c ≠ ⊥),
      (∃ r ≤ Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.ofStage e i b hb,
          r ≤ Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.ofStage e i c hc) ↔
        b ⊓ c ≠ ⊥ :=
fun {ι} [Preorder ι] [IsDirectedOrder ι] {B} [(i : ι) → CompleteBooleanAlgebra (B i)] e
    [DirectedSystem B fun x1 x2 x3 => ⇑(e x1 x2 x3)] hinj i b c hb hc =>
  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrArg (fun _a => (∃ r ≤ _a, r ≤ Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.ofStage e i c hc) ↔ b ⊓ c ≠ ⊥)
        (Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.ofStage.eq_1 e i b hb)))
    (Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg
          (fun _a =>
            (∃ r ≤ Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.ofRaw e { index := i, value := b, nonzero := hb }, r ≤ _a) ↔
              b ⊓ c ≠ ⊥)
          (Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.ofStage.eq_1 e i c hc)))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a => _a ↔ b ⊓ c ≠ ⊥)
            (propext
              (Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.compatible_ofRaw_iff e { index := i, value := b, nonzero := hb }
                { index := i, value := c, nonzero := hc }))))

                  { index := i, value := b, nonzero := hb } { index := i, value := c, nonzero := hc } i le_rfl
                  le_rfl))))
          (of_eq_true

              (congrFun'
                (congrArg Iff
                  (congrFun'
                    (congrArg Ne
                      (congr (congrArg min ((fun ⦃i⦄ x => DirectedSystem.map_self' e x) b))
                        ((fun ⦃i⦄ x => DirectedSystem.map_self' e x) c)))
                    ⊥))
                (b ⊓ c ≠ ⊥))
              (iff_self (b ⊓ c ≠ ⊥)))))))

  Flypitch.BA_CCC B → Erdos597Object.MartinTransport.CountableChainCondition { b // b ≠ ⊥ } :=
fun {B} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] hB A hA =>
  have hcount :=
    hB (Subtype.val '' A) (fun a a_1 => Exists.casesOn a_1 fun b h => And.casesOn h fun hb right => right ▸ b.property)
      fun a a_1 =>
      Exists.casesOn (motive := fun x => ∀ b ∈ Subtype.val '' A, a ≠ b → a ⊓ b = ⊥) a_1 fun b h =>
        And.casesOn (motive := fun x => ∀ b ∈ Subtype.val '' A, a ≠ b → a ⊓ b = ⊥) h fun hb right =>
          Eq.ndrec (motive := fun a => ∀ b ∈ Subtype.val '' A, a ≠ b → a ⊓ b = ⊥)
            (fun b_1 a =>
              Exists.casesOn (motive := fun x => ↑b ≠ b_1 → ↑b ⊓ b_1 = ⊥) a fun c h =>
                And.casesOn (motive := fun x => ↑b ≠ b_1 → ↑b ⊓ b_1 = ⊥) h fun hc right =>

                          (Exists.intro ⟨↑b ⊓ ↑c, hnonzero⟩ ⟨inf_le_left, inf_le_right⟩))
                    right)
            right;
  Set.MapsTo.countable_of_injOn (Set.mapsTo_image Subtype.val A) (Function.Injective.injOn Subtype.val_injective) hcount

                      ⊥)

@Erdos597Object.ProjectionCompletion.valueOpen_perp : ∀ {B P : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  [inst_1 : PartialOrder P] (R : Erdos597Object.ProjectionCompletion.PosetProjection B P) (b : B),
  Erdos597Object.ProjectionCompletion.valueOpen R bᵖ = Erdos597Object.ProjectionCompletion.valueOpen R bᶜ
theorem Erdos597Object.ProjectionCompletion.valueOpen_perp : ∀ {B P : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  [inst_1 : PartialOrder P] (R : Erdos597Object.ProjectionCompletion.PosetProjection B P) (b : B),
  Erdos597Object.ProjectionCompletion.valueOpen R bᵖ = Erdos597Object.ProjectionCompletion.valueOpen R bᶜ :=
fun {B P} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] [PartialOrder P] R b =>
  Set.ext fun p =>
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg
          (fun _a =>
            _a ∈ Erdos597Object.ProjectionCompletion.valueOpen R bᵖ ↔
              _a ∈ Erdos597Object.ProjectionCompletion.valueOpen R bᶜ)
          (have this := rfl;
          this)))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              _a ↔
                Topology.WithLowerSet.toLowerSet (Topology.WithLowerSet.ofLowerSet p) ∈
                  Erdos597Object.ProjectionCompletion.valueOpen R bᶜ)
            (propext
              (Erdos597Object.CompletionEmbedding.mem_perp_lower_iff (Erdos597Object.ProjectionCompletion.valueOpen R b)
                (Topology.WithLowerSet.ofLowerSet p)))))
        (id
          {
            mp := fun hp =>
              le_compl_iff_disjoint_right.mpr
                (disjoint_iff.mpr
                  (Decidable.byContradiction fun hnonzero =>
                    let d := R.value (Topology.WithLowerSet.ofLowerSet p) ⊓ b;
                    have hd := hnonzero;
                    have hcompatible :=
                      Eq.mpr
                        (id
                          (congrFun'
                            (congrArg Ne
                              (Eq.trans
                                (Erdos597Object.ProjectionCompletion.valueOpen_perp._simp_1_1
                                  (R.value (Topology.WithLowerSet.ofLowerSet p))
                                  (R.value (Topology.WithLowerSet.ofLowerSet p)) b)
                                (congrFun' (congrArg min (inf_idem (R.value (Topology.WithLowerSet.ofLowerSet p)))) b)))
                            ⊥))
                        hd;
                    Exists.casesOn ((R.compatible (Topology.WithLowerSet.ofLowerSet p) d hd).mpr hcompatible) fun q h =>
                      And.casesOn h fun hqp hqd =>
                        hp q hqp
                          (have hvalue := R.monotone hqd;
                          LE.le.trans (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => R.value q ≤ _a) (R.condition_value d hd)) hvalue)
                            inf_le_right))),
            mpr := fun hp q hqp hqb =>
              R.nonzero q
                (bot_unique (Trans.trans (le_inf hqb (LE.le.trans (R.monotone hqp) hp)) (inf_compl_self b))) }))
'Erdos597Object.ProjectionCompletion.valueOpen_perp' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]

theorem Erdos597Object.ProjectionCompletion.algebraMap_le_iff : ∀ {B P : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  [inst_1 : PartialOrder P] (R : Erdos597Object.ProjectionCompletion.PosetProjection B P) (b c : B),

  {
    mp := fun hbc =>
      Classical.byContradiction fun hnot =>
        have hd := fun hzero =>
          hnot (Eq.mp (congrArg (LE.le b) (compl_compl c)) (le_compl_iff_disjoint_right.mpr (disjoint_iff.mpr hzero)));

            (Trans.trans
              (le_inf (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a ≤ c) (R.condition_value (b ⊓ cᶜ) hd)) hbound) inf_le_right)
              (inf_compl_self c))),
    mpr := fun hbc => Erdos597Object.ProjectionCompletion.algebraMap_monotone R hbc }

@Erdos597Object.LimitReductions.compatible_of_reductions : ∀ {ι : Type} [inst : Preorder ι] [inst_1 : IsDirectedOrder ι]
  {B : ι → Type} [inst_2 : (i : ι) → CompleteBooleanAlgebra (B i)]
  (e : (i j : ι) → i ≤ j → CompleteLatticeHom (B i) (B j)) [inst_3 : DirectedSystem B fun x1 x2 x3 => ⇑(e x1 x2 x3)]
  (hinj : ∀ (i j : ι) (h : i ≤ j), Function.Injective ⇑(e i j h)) {i j : ι} (hij : i ≤ j)
  (p q : Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.Condition e),
  (∃ c, ∃ (hc : c ≠ ⊥), Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.ofStage e j c hc = p) →
    ∀ (a b : B i),
      a ≤ Erdos597Object.LimitProjections.stageProjection e hinj i p →
        (e i j hij) b ≤ Erdos597Object.LimitProjections.stageProjection e hinj j q → a ⊓ b ≠ ⊥ → ∃ r ≤ p, r ≤ q
theorem Erdos597Object.LimitReductions.compatible_of_reductions : ∀ {ι : Type} [inst : Preorder ι]
  [inst_1 : IsDirectedOrder ι] {B : ι → Type} [inst_2 : (i : ι) → CompleteBooleanAlgebra (B i)]
  (e : (i j : ι) → i ≤ j → CompleteLatticeHom (B i) (B j)) [inst_3 : DirectedSystem B fun x1 x2 x3 => ⇑(e x1 x2 x3)]
  (hinj : ∀ (i j : ι) (h : i ≤ j), Function.Injective ⇑(e i j h)) {i j : ι} (hij : i ≤ j)
  (p q : Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.Condition e),
  (∃ c, ∃ (hc : c ≠ ⊥), Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.ofStage e j c hc = p) →
    ∀ (a b : B i),
      a ≤ Erdos597Object.LimitProjections.stageProjection e hinj i p →
        (e i j hij) b ≤ Erdos597Object.LimitProjections.stageProjection e hinj j q → a ⊓ b ≠ ⊥ → ∃ r ≤ p, r ≤ q :=
fun {ι} [Preorder ι] [IsDirectedOrder ι] {B} [(i : ι) → CompleteBooleanAlgebra (B i)] e
    [DirectedSystem B fun x1 x2 x3 => ⇑(e x1 x2 x3)] hinj {i j} hij p q hp a b ha hb hab =>
  Exists.casesOn hp fun c h =>
    Exists.casesOn h fun hc h =>
      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun p => a ≤ Erdos597Object.LimitProjections.stageProjection e hinj i p → ∃ r ≤ p, r ≤ q)
        (fun ha =>
          have hleft := fun hzero => hab (bot_unique (LE.le.trans (inf_le_inf_right b ha) (Eq.le hzero)));
          have hmiddle :=
            (Erdos597Object.BooleanProjection.inf_image_nonzero_iff (e i j hij) c b).mpr
              (Eq.mp
                (congrArg (fun _a => _a ⊓ b ≠ ⊥)
                  (Erdos597Object.LimitReductions.stageProjection_ofStage_above e hinj hij c hc))
                hleft);
          have hright := fun hzero =>
            hmiddle
              (bot_unique
                (Trans.trans (inf_le_inf_left c hb)
                  (Eq.mp
                    (congrFun' (congrArg Eq (inf_comm (Erdos597Object.LimitProjections.stageProjection e hinj j q) c))
                      ⊥)
                    hzero)));
          Exists.casesOn ((Erdos597Object.LimitProjections.compatible_stage_iff e hinj j q c hc).mpr hright) fun r h =>
            And.casesOn h fun hrq hrp => Exists.intro r ⟨hrp, hrq⟩)
        h ha

@Erdos597Object.StationaryLimits.succLimits_isClub : ∀ {α : Type} [inst : LinearOrder α] [WellFoundedLT α],
  Cardinal.aleph0 < Order.cof α → IsClub {a | Order.IsSuccLimit a}
theorem Erdos597Object.StationaryLimits.succLimits_isClub : ∀ {α : Type} [inst : LinearOrder α] [WellFoundedLT α],
  Cardinal.aleph0 < Order.cof α → IsClub {a | Order.IsSuccLimit a} :=
fun {α} [LinearOrder α] [WellFoundedLT α] hα =>
  have hcard := LT.lt.trans_le (LT.lt.trans Cardinal.aleph0_pos hα) (Order.cof_le_cardinalMk α);
  {
    dirSupClosed := fun ⦃s⦄ hs hsne a ⦃x⦄ hx =>
      Decidable.byContradiction fun hnot => hnot (hs (IsLUB.mem_of_nonempty_of_not_isSuccLimit hx hsne hnot)),
    isCofinal := fun a =>
      let next := fun x => Classical.choose (exists_gt x);
      have hnext := fun x => Classical.choose_spec (exists_gt x);
      let g := fun n => next^[n] a;
      have hg :=
        strictMono_of_lt_add_one fun n a_1 =>
          id
            (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => next^[n] a < _a) (Function.iterate_succ_apply' next n a)))
              (hnext (next^[n] a)));
      have hsmall := LE.le.trans_eq Cardinal.mk_range_le Cardinal.mk_nat;
      have hbounded := BddAbove.of_not_isCofinal fun h => LT.lt.not_ge hα (LE.le.trans (Order.cof_le h) hsmall);
      let x := sSup (Set.range g);
      have hx := isLUB_csSup (Set.range_nonempty g) hbounded;
      have hlimit :=
        Decidable.byContradiction fun hnot =>
          Exists.casesOn (IsLUB.exists_of_nonempty_of_not_isSuccLimit hx hnot) fun n hn =>
            have hlt := hg (Nat.lt_succ_self n);
            LT.lt.not_ge (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a < g n.succ) hn) hlt) (hx.left (Exists.intro (n + 1) rfl));
      Exists.intro x ⟨hlimit, hx.left (Exists.intro 0 rfl)⟩ }

@Erdos597Object.StationaryLimits.ccc_of_stationary_density : ∀ {α : Type} [inst : LinearOrder α]
  [inst_1 : WellFoundedLT α] [IsRegularCardinalOrder α] {ι : Type} [inst_3 : Preorder ι] [inst_4 : IsDirectedOrder ι]
  {B : ι → Type} [inst_5 : (i : ι) → CompleteBooleanAlgebra (B i)]
  (e : (i j : ι) → i ≤ j → CompleteLatticeHom (B i) (B j)) [inst_6 : DirectedSystem B fun x1 x2 x3 => ⇑(e x1 x2 x3)],
  (∀ (i j : ι) (h : i ≤ j), Function.Injective ⇑(e i j h)) →
    (∀ (i : ι), Flypitch.BA_CCC (B i)) →
      Order.cof α = Cardinal.aleph 1 →
        ∀ (stages : α → ι) (hmono : Monotone stages),
          (∀ (i : ι), ∃ a, i ≤ stages a) →
            ∀ (s : Set α),
              IsStationary s →
                Erdos597Object.StationaryLimits.DenseAlong e stages hmono s →
                  Erdos597Object.MartinTransport.CountableChainCondition (Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.Condition e)
theorem Erdos597Object.StationaryLimits.ccc_of_stationary_density : ∀ {α : Type} [inst : LinearOrder α]
  [inst_1 : WellFoundedLT α] [IsRegularCardinalOrder α] {ι : Type} [inst_3 : Preorder ι] [inst_4 : IsDirectedOrder ι]
  {B : ι → Type} [inst_5 : (i : ι) → CompleteBooleanAlgebra (B i)]
  (e : (i j : ι) → i ≤ j → CompleteLatticeHom (B i) (B j)) [inst_6 : DirectedSystem B fun x1 x2 x3 => ⇑(e x1 x2 x3)],
  (∀ (i j : ι) (h : i ≤ j), Function.Injective ⇑(e i j h)) →
    (∀ (i : ι), Flypitch.BA_CCC (B i)) →
      Order.cof α = Cardinal.aleph 1 →
        ∀ (stages : α → ι) (hmono : Monotone stages),
          (∀ (i : ι), ∃ a, i ≤ stages a) →
            ∀ (s : Set α),
              IsStationary s →
                Erdos597Object.StationaryLimits.DenseAlong e stages hmono s →
                  Erdos597Object.MartinTransport.CountableChainCondition
                    (Erdos597Object.BooleanDirectLimit.Condition e) :=
fun {α} [LinearOrder α] [WellFoundedLT α] [IsRegularCardinalOrder α] {ι} [Preorder ι] [IsDirectedOrder ι] {B}
    [(i : ι) → CompleteBooleanAlgebra (B i)] e [DirectedSystem B fun x1 x2 x3 => ⇑(e x1 x2 x3)] hinj hB hα stages hmono
    hcofinal s hs hdense A hA =>
  Decidable.byContradiction fun huncountable =>
    have hcard :=
      Cardinal.aleph_one_le_iff.mpr (lt_of_not_ge fun h => huncountable (Cardinal.le_aleph0_iff_set_countable.mp h));
    have hcardα := Eq.trans (Eq.symm Order.cof_eq_cardinalMk) hα;
    Nonempty.casesOn
      ((Cardinal.le_def α ↑A).mp (Eq.mpr (id (congrFun' (congrArg LE.le hcardα) (Cardinal.mk ↑A))) hcard)) fun embed =>
      let p := fun a => ↑(embed a);
      have hpinjective := fun ⦃a b⦄ h => Function.Embedding.injective embed (Subtype.ext h);
      (fun support hsupport =>
          have hαne :=
            Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ≠ Cardinal.aleph0) hα)) (LT.lt.ne' Cardinal.aleph0_lt_aleph_one);

      Erdos597Object.ExtensionContinuity.Continuous (Erdos597Object.SystemExtension.extendedMap e legs) :=

@Erdos597Object.SystemReindexing.lowerPoint_upperPoint : ∀ {J : Type} [inst : LinearOrder J] (j : J)

theorem Erdos597Object.SystemReindexing.lowerPoint_upperPoint : ∀ {J : Type} [inst : LinearOrder J] (j : J)
  (i : WithTop ↑(Set.Iio j)),
  Erdos597Object.SystemReindexing.lowerPoint j (Erdos597Object.SystemReindexing.upperPoint j i) = i :=

  WithTop.recTopCoe
    (fun h =>
      Eq.symm h ▸
        of_eq_true
          (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg Eq (dite_eq_right_of_eq_false (lt_self_iff_false._simp_1 j))) ⊤) (eq_self ⊤)))

            (congrFun'
              (congrArg Eq
                (Eq.trans
                  (dite_congr (Eq.refl (↑i_1 < j))

                    Eq.refl ⊤)

              ↑i_1)
            (eq_self ↑⟨↑i_1, id (Eq.refl ↑i_1) ▸ Eq.mpr_prop (Eq.refl (↑i_1 < j)) hi⟩)))

@Erdos597Object.SystemReindexing.upperPoint_lowerPoint : ∀ {J : Type} [inst : LinearOrder J] (j : J) (i : ↑(Set.Iic j)),
  Erdos597Object.SystemReindexing.upperPoint j (Erdos597Object.SystemReindexing.lowerPoint j i) = i
theorem Erdos597Object.SystemReindexing.upperPoint_lowerPoint : ∀ {J : Type} [inst : LinearOrder J] (j : J)
  (i : ↑(Set.Iic j)),
  Erdos597Object.SystemReindexing.upperPoint j (Erdos597Object.SystemReindexing.lowerPoint j i) = i :=
fun {J} [LinearOrder J] j i =>
  Subtype.casesOn i fun i hi =>
    if h : i < j then
      of_eq_true
        (Eq.trans
          (congrFun'
            (congrArg Eq
              (congrArg
                (fun x =>
                  match x with
                  | none => ⟨j, Erdos597Object.SystemReindexing.upperPoint._proof_1 j⟩
                  | some i => ⟨↑i, Erdos597Object.SystemReindexing.upperPoint._proof_2 j i⟩)
                (dite_eq_left_of_eq_true (eq_true h))))
            ⟨i, hi⟩)
          (eq_self ⟨i, Erdos597Object.SystemReindexing.upperPoint._proof_2 j ⟨i, of_eq_true (eq_true h)⟩⟩))
    else
      have hij := le_antisymm hi (le_of_not_gt h);
      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun i =>
        ∀ (hi : i ∈ Set.Iic j),
          ¬i < j →
            Erdos597Object.SystemReindexing.upperPoint j (Erdos597Object.SystemReindexing.lowerPoint j ⟨i, hi⟩) =
              ⟨i, hi⟩)
        (fun hi h =>
          of_eq_true
            (Eq.trans
              (congrFun'
                (congrArg Eq
                  (congrArg
                    (fun x =>
                      match x with
                      | none => ⟨j, Erdos597Object.SystemReindexing.upperPoint._proof_1 j⟩
                      | some i => ⟨↑i, Erdos597Object.SystemReindexing.upperPoint._proof_2 j i⟩)
                    (dite_eq_right_of_eq_false (lt_self_iff_false._simp_1 j))))
                ⟨j, hi⟩)
              (eq_self ⟨j, Erdos597Object.SystemReindexing.upperPoint._proof_1 j⟩)))
        (Eq.symm hij) hi h

@Erdos597Object.IterationSystems.System.ext : ∀ {I : Type} [inst : Preorder I]
  {S T : Erdos597Object.IterationSystems.System I},
  S.obj = T.obj → (∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j), S.map i j h ≍ T.map i j h) → S = T
theorem Erdos597Object.IterationSystems.System.ext : ∀ {I : Type} [inst : Preorder I]
  {S T : Erdos597Object.IterationSystems.System I},
  S.obj = T.obj → (∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j), S.map i j h ≍ T.map i j h) → S = T :=
fun {I} [Preorder I] {S T} hobj hmap =>
  Erdos597Object.IterationSystems.System.casesOn (motive := fun t => S = t → S = T) S
    (fun obj map coherent injective h =>
      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {S} => S.obj = T.obj → (∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j), S.map i j h ≍ T.map i j h) → S = T)
        (fun hobj hmap =>
          Erdos597Object.IterationSystems.System.casesOn (motive := fun t =>
            T = t → { obj := obj, map := map, coherent := coherent, injective := injective } = T) T
            (fun otherObj otherMap otherCoherent otherInjective h =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {T} =>
                { obj := obj, map := map, coherent := coherent, injective := injective }.obj = T.obj →
                  (∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j),
                      { obj := obj, map := map, coherent := coherent, injective := injective }.map i j h ≍
                        T.map i j h) →
                    { obj := obj, map := map, coherent := coherent, injective := injective } = T)
                (fun hobj hmap =>
                  Eq.ndrec (motive := fun otherObj =>
                    ∀ (otherMap : (i j : I) → i ≤ j → CompleteLatticeHom (otherObj i).Carrier (otherObj j).Carrier)
                      (otherCoherent :
                        DirectedSystem (fun i => (otherObj i).Carrier) fun x1 x2 x3 => ⇑(otherMap x1 x2 x3))
                      (otherInjective : ∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j), Function.Injective ⇑(otherMap i j h)),
                      (∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j), map i j h ≍ otherMap i j h) →
                        { obj := obj, map := map, coherent := coherent, injective := injective } =
                          { obj := otherObj, map := otherMap, coherent := otherCoherent, injective := otherInjective })
                    (fun otherMap otherCoherent otherInjective hmap =>
                      have hm := funext fun i => funext fun j => funext fun h => eq_of_heq (hmap i j h);
                      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun otherMap =>
                        ∀
                          (otherCoherent :
                            DirectedSystem (fun i => (obj i).Carrier) fun x1 x2 x3 => ⇑(otherMap x1 x2 x3))
                          (otherInjective : ∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j), Function.Injective ⇑(otherMap i j h)),
                          (∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j), map i j h ≍ otherMap i j h) →
                            { obj := obj, map := map, coherent := coherent, injective := injective } =
                              { obj := obj, map := otherMap, coherent := otherCoherent, injective := otherInjective })
                        (fun otherCoherent otherInjective hmap =>
                          Eq.refl { obj := obj, map := map, coherent := coherent, injective := injective })
                        hm otherCoherent otherInjective hmap)
                    hobj otherMap otherCoherent otherInjective hmap)
                (Eq.symm h) hobj hmap)
            (Eq.refl T))
        (Eq.symm h) hobj hmap)
    (Eq.refl S)

@Erdos597Object.SystemRestrictions.reindex_continuous : ∀ {I J : Type} [inst : LinearOrder I] [inst_1 : LinearOrder J]
  (S : Erdos597Object.IterationSystems.System I) (r : J ≤i I),
  Erdos597Object.ExtensionContinuity.Continuous S.map →
    Erdos597Object.ExtensionContinuity.Continuous (S.reindex ⇑r ⋯).map
theorem Erdos597Object.SystemRestrictions.reindex_continuous : ∀ {I J : Type} [inst : LinearOrder I]
  [inst_1 : LinearOrder J] (S : Erdos597Object.IterationSystems.System I) (r : J ≤i I),
  Erdos597Object.ExtensionContinuity.Continuous S.map →
    Erdos597Object.ExtensionContinuity.Continuous (S.reindex ⇑r ⋯).map :=
fun {I J} [LinearOrder I] [LinearOrder J] S r hS j hj b hb =>
  Exists.casesOn (hS (r j) (Order.IsNormal.map_isSuccLimit (InitialSeg.isNormal r) hj) b hb) fun i h =>
    Exists.casesOn h fun hij h =>
      Exists.casesOn h fun c h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hc hcb =>
          Exists.casesOn (InitialSeg.mem_range_of_rel r hij) fun k h =>
            Eq.ndrec (motive := fun i =>
              ∀ (hij : i < r j) (c : (S.obj i).Carrier),
                c ≠ ⊥ →
                  (S.map i (r j) (LT.lt.le hij)) c ≤ b →
                    ∃ j_1,
                      ∃ (hji : j_1 < j),
                        ∃ c, c ≠ ⊥ ∧ ((S.reindex (⇑r) (InitialSeg.monotone r)).map j_1 j (LT.lt.le hji)) c ≤ b)
              (fun hij c hc hcb =>
                Exists.intro k
                  (Exists.intro ((StrictMono.lt_iff_lt (InitialSeg.strictMono r)).mp hij) (Exists.intro c ⟨hc, hcb⟩)))
              h hij c hc hcb
'Erdos597Object.SystemRestrictions.reindex_continuous' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]

@Erdos597Object.PrefixExtensions.map_heq_of_indices : ∀ {I : Type} [inst : Preorder I]
  (S : Erdos597Object.IterationSystems.System I) {a b c d : I},
  a = c → b = d → ∀ (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d), S.map a b hab ≍ S.map c d hcd
theorem Erdos597Object.PrefixExtensions.map_heq_of_indices : ∀ {I : Type} [inst : Preorder I]
  (S : Erdos597Object.IterationSystems.System I) {a b c d : I},
  a = c → b = d → ∀ (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d), S.map a b hab ≍ S.map c d hcd :=
fun {I} [Preorder I] S {a b c d} ha hb hab hcd =>
  Eq.casesOn (motive := fun a_1 t => c = a_1 → ha ≍ t → S.map a b hab ≍ S.map c d hcd) ha
    (fun h =>
      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {c} => ∀ (ha : a = c) (hcd : c ≤ d), ha ≍ Eq.refl a → S.map a b hab ≍ S.map c d hcd)
        (fun ha hcd h =>
          Eq.casesOn (motive := fun a_1 t => d = a_1 → hb ≍ t → S.map a b hab ≍ S.map a d hcd) hb
            (fun h =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {d} =>
                ∀ (hb : b = d) (hcd : a ≤ d), hb ≍ Eq.refl b → S.map a b hab ≍ S.map a d hcd) (fun hb hcd h => HEq.rfl)
                (Eq.symm h) hb hcd)
            (Eq.refl d) (HEq.refl hb))
        (Eq.symm h) ha hcd)
    (Eq.refl c) (HEq.refl ha)

  let d := Erdos597Object.TransfiniteSystems.inductionData hsize next;
  id
    (have h := default.map_succ i (Order.lt_succ_of_not_isMax (not_isMax i));
    id
      (fun h =>
        have hc :=
          CategoryTheory.Functor.WellOrderInductionData.Extension.compatibility default default (Order.le_succ i);

@Erdos597Object.PosetStageCapture.coefficient_index_card_le : ∀ {I D : Type},
  Cardinal.mk I ≤ Cardinal.aleph 1 →
    Cardinal.mk D ≤ Cardinal.aleph 1 → Cardinal.mk (I ⊕ I × I ⊕ D × I) ≤ Cardinal.aleph 1
theorem Erdos597Object.PosetStageCapture.coefficient_index_card_le : ∀ {I D : Type},
  Cardinal.mk I ≤ Cardinal.aleph 1 →
    Cardinal.mk D ≤ Cardinal.aleph 1 → Cardinal.mk (I ⊕ I × I ⊕ D × I) ≤ Cardinal.aleph 1 :=
fun {I D} hI hD =>
  have hinfinite := Cardinal.aleph0_le_aleph 1;
  have hII :=
    Trans.trans
      (Trans.trans
        (of_eq_true
          (Eq.trans
            (congrFun'
              (congrArg Eq
                (Eq.trans (Cardinal.mk_prod I I)
                  (congr (congrArg HMul.hMul (Cardinal.lift_id (Cardinal.mk I))) (Cardinal.lift_id (Cardinal.mk I)))))
              (Cardinal.mk I * Cardinal.mk I))
            (eq_self (Cardinal.mk I * Cardinal.mk I))))
        (mul_le_mul' hI hI))
      (Cardinal.mul_eq_self hinfinite);
  have hDI :=
    Trans.trans
      (Trans.trans
        (of_eq_true
          (Eq.trans
            (congrFun'
              (congrArg Eq
                (Eq.trans (Cardinal.mk_prod D I)
                  (congr (congrArg HMul.hMul (Cardinal.lift_id (Cardinal.mk D))) (Cardinal.lift_id (Cardinal.mk I)))))
              (Cardinal.mk D * Cardinal.mk I))
            (eq_self (Cardinal.mk D * Cardinal.mk I))))
        (mul_le_mul' hD hI))
      (Cardinal.mul_eq_self hinfinite);
  Trans.trans
    (Trans.trans
      (of_eq_true
        (Eq.trans
          (congrFun'
            (congrArg Eq
              (Eq.trans (Cardinal.mk_sum I (I × I ⊕ D × I))
                (congr (congrArg HAdd.hAdd (Cardinal.lift_id (Cardinal.mk I)))
                  (Eq.trans
                    (congrArg Cardinal.lift.{0, 0}
                      (Eq.trans (Cardinal.mk_sum (I × I) (D × I))
                        (congr (congrArg HAdd.hAdd (Cardinal.lift_id (Cardinal.mk (I × I))))
                          (Cardinal.lift_id (Cardinal.mk (D × I))))))
                    (Cardinal.lift_id (Cardinal.mk (I × I) + Cardinal.mk (D × I)))))))
            (Cardinal.mk I + (Cardinal.mk (I × I) + Cardinal.mk (D × I))))
          (eq_self (Cardinal.mk I + (Cardinal.mk (I × I) + Cardinal.mk (D × I))))))
      (add_le_add hI (add_le_add hII hDI)))
    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => Cardinal.aleph 1 + _a = Cardinal.aleph 1) (Cardinal.add_eq_self hinfinite)))
      (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = Cardinal.aleph 1) (Cardinal.add_eq_self hinfinite)))
        (Eq.refl (Cardinal.aleph 1))))
'Erdos597Object.PosetStageCapture.coefficient_index_card_le' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]

Erdos597Object.BookkeepingSchedule.schedule_fibre : ∀ (stage code rank : Erdos597Object.CanonicalIteration.Index),
  Erdos597Object.BookkeepingSchedule.schedule
      (Erdos597Object.BookkeepingSchedule.tripleEquiv.symm (stage, code, rank)) =
    (stage, code)
theorem Erdos597Object.BookkeepingSchedule.schedule_fibre : ∀
  (stage code rank : Erdos597Object.CanonicalIteration.Index),
  Erdos597Object.BookkeepingSchedule.schedule
      (Erdos597Object.BookkeepingSchedule.tripleEquiv.symm (stage, code, rank)) =
    (stage, code) :=
fun stage code rank =>
  of_eq_true
    (Eq.trans
      (congrFun'
        (congrArg Eq
          (congr
            (congrArg Prod.mk
              (congrArg Prod.fst
                (Equiv.apply_symm_apply Erdos597Object.BookkeepingSchedule.tripleEquiv (stage, code, rank))))
            (congrArg Prod.fst
              (congrArg Prod.snd
                (Equiv.apply_symm_apply Erdos597Object.BookkeepingSchedule.tripleEquiv (stage, code, rank))))))
        (stage, code))
      (eq_self (stage, code)))

Erdos597Object.BookkeepingSchedule.cofinally_scheduled : ∀ (stage code bound : Erdos597Object.CanonicalIteration.Index),
  ∃ i, bound < i ∧ Erdos597Object.BookkeepingSchedule.schedule i = (stage, code)
theorem Erdos597Object.BookkeepingSchedule.cofinally_scheduled : ∀
  (stage code bound : Erdos597Object.CanonicalIteration.Index),
  ∃ i, bound < i ∧ Erdos597Object.BookkeepingSchedule.schedule i = (stage, code) :=
fun stage code bound =>
  Decidable.byContradiction fun h =>
    let fibre := fun rank => Erdos597Object.BookkeepingSchedule.tripleEquiv.symm (stage, code, rank);
    have hfibre := fun ⦃i j⦄ hij =>
      have h := congrArg (⇑Erdos597Object.BookkeepingSchedule.tripleEquiv) hij;
      Eq.mp
        (Eq.trans
          (Eq.trans
            (congr
              (congrArg Eq (Equiv.apply_symm_apply Erdos597Object.BookkeepingSchedule.tripleEquiv (stage, code, i)))
              (Equiv.apply_symm_apply Erdos597Object.BookkeepingSchedule.tripleEquiv (stage, code, j)))
            (Prod.mk.injEq stage (code, i) stage (code, j)))
          (Eq.trans
            (congr (congrArg And (eq_self stage))
              (Eq.trans (Prod.mk.injEq code i code j)
                (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg And (eq_self code)) (i = j)) (true_and (i = j)))))
            (true_and (i = j))))
        h;
    have hbound := fun rank =>
      le_of_not_gt fun hlt =>
        h (Exists.intro (fibre rank) ⟨hlt, Erdos597Object.BookkeepingSchedule.schedule_fibre stage code rank⟩);
    let into := fun rank => ⟨fibre rank, hbound rank⟩;
    have hinj := fun i j hij => hfibre (congrArg Subtype.val hij);
    have hcard :=
      Eq.mp (congrFun' (congrArg LE.le Erdos597Object.CanonicalIteration.index_card) (Cardinal.mk ↑(Set.Iic bound)))
        (Cardinal.mk_le_of_injective hinj);
    LT.lt.not_ge (Erdos597Object.BookkeepingSchedule.initial_segment_card_lt bound) hcard

  (stage code bound : Erdos597Object.CanonicalIteration.Index),

      Cardinal.mk D ≤ Cardinal.aleph 1 →

          Erdos597Object.IterationCardinals.iterationSize
theorem Erdos597Object.RequirementCodes.raw_card_le : ∀ {B I D : Type} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B],
  Cardinal.mk B ≤ Erdos597Object.IterationCardinals.iterationSize →
    Cardinal.mk I ≤ Cardinal.aleph 1 →
      Cardinal.mk D ≤ Cardinal.aleph 1 →
        Cardinal.mk (Erdos597Object.RequirementCodes.RawRequirement B I D) ≤
          Erdos597Object.IterationCardinals.iterationSize :=
fun {B I D} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] hB hI hD =>
  have hm := Erdos597Object.IterationCardinals.function_card_le hB hI;
  have ho := Erdos597Object.IterationCardinals.function_card_le hm hI;
  have hd := Erdos597Object.IterationCardinals.function_card_le hm hD;
  Trans.trans
    (Trans.trans
      (of_eq_true
        (Eq.trans
          (congrFun'
            (congrArg Eq
              (Eq.trans (Cardinal.mk_prod (I → B) ((I → I → B) × (D → I → B)))
                (congr (congrArg HMul.hMul (Cardinal.lift_id (Cardinal.mk (I → B))))
                  (Eq.trans
                    (congrArg Cardinal.lift.{0, 0}
                      (Eq.trans (Cardinal.mk_prod (I → I → B) (D → I → B))
                        (congr (congrArg HMul.hMul (Cardinal.lift_id (Cardinal.mk (I → I → B))))
                          (Cardinal.lift_id (Cardinal.mk (D → I → B))))))
                    (Cardinal.lift_id (Cardinal.mk (I → I → B) * Cardinal.mk (D → I → B)))))))
            (Cardinal.mk (I → B) * (Cardinal.mk (I → I → B) * Cardinal.mk (D → I → B))))
          (eq_self (Cardinal.mk (I → B) * (Cardinal.mk (I → I → B) * Cardinal.mk (D → I → B))))))
      (mul_le_mul' hm (mul_le_mul' ho hd)))
    (Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg
          (fun _a =>
            Erdos597Object.IterationCardinals.iterationSize * _a = Erdos597Object.IterationCardinals.iterationSize)
          (Cardinal.mul_eq_self Erdos597Object.IterationCardinals.iterationSize_infinite)))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a => _a = Erdos597Object.IterationCardinals.iterationSize)
            (Cardinal.mul_eq_self Erdos597Object.IterationCardinals.iterationSize_infinite)))
        (Eq.refl Erdos597Object.IterationCardinals.iterationSize)))

@Erdos597Object.CompletionGenerators.le_of_principal_refinements : ∀ {P : Type} [inst : PartialOrder P]
  {u v : Erdos597Object.PosetCompletion.Completion P},
  (∀ (p : P),
      Erdos597Object.PosetCompletion.principal p ≤ u → ∃ q ≤ p, Erdos597Object.PosetCompletion.principal q ≤ v) →
    u ≤ v
theorem Erdos597Object.CompletionGenerators.le_of_principal_refinements : ∀ {P : Type} [inst : PartialOrder P]
  {u v : Erdos597Object.PosetCompletion.Completion P},
  (∀ (p : P),
      Erdos597Object.PosetCompletion.principal p ≤ u → ∃ q ≤ p, Erdos597Object.PosetCompletion.principal q ≤ v) →
    u ≤ v :=
fun {P} [PartialOrder P] {u v} h =>
  Decidable.byContradiction fun hle =>
    have hnonzero := fun hzero =>
      hle (Eq.mp (congrArg (LE.le u) (compl_compl v)) (le_compl_iff_disjoint_right.mpr (disjoint_iff.mpr hzero)));
    Exists.casesOn (Erdos597Object.PosetCompletion.principal_dense (u ⊓ vᶜ) hnonzero) fun p hp =>
      Exists.casesOn (h p (LE.le.trans hp inf_le_left)) fun q h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hqp hqv =>
          have hqc := LE.le.trans (Erdos597Object.PosetCompletion.principal_monotone hqp) (LE.le.trans hp inf_le_right);
          Erdos597Object.PosetCompletion.principal_nonzero q

@Erdos597Object.GenericFilterValues.labelValue_meets_dense : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]

    ⨆ i, Erdos597Object.GenericFilterValues.labelValue P i ⊓ Erdos597Object.CompletionEmbedding.baseMap P (dense i) = ⊤
theorem Erdos597Object.GenericFilterValues.labelValue_meets_dense : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (P : Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.BooleanPoset B I) (dense : I → B),
  (∀ (j : I), P.member j ≤ ⨆ i, dense i ⊓ P.leValue i j) →
    ⨆ i, Erdos597Object.GenericFilterValues.labelValue P i ⊓ Erdos597Object.CompletionEmbedding.baseMap P (dense i) =

    (Erdos597Object.CompletionGenerators.le_of_principal_refinements fun p a =>
      have hex :=

          p.nonzero

@Erdos597Object.WeightedFilterModel.orderFilterValue_of_weights : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]

              (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weightedSet Erdos597Object.BooleanPosetCoding.checkLabel weight)
theorem Erdos597Object.WeightedFilterModel.orderFilterValue_of_weights : ∀ {B I : Type}
  [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] (P : Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.BooleanPoset B I) (weight : I → B),
  (∀ (i : I), weight i ≤ P.member i) →
    ⨆ i, weight i = ⊤ →
      (∀ (i j : I), weight i ⊓ P.leValue i j ≤ weight j) →
        (∀ (i j : I), weight i ⊓ weight j ≤ ⨆ k, weight k ⊓ (P.leValue k i ⊓ P.leValue k j)) →
          ⊤ ≤
            Erdos597Object.orderFilterValue (Flypitch.V B)
              (Erdos597Object.BooleanPosetCoding.domainName P Erdos597Object.BooleanPosetCoding.checkLabel)
              (Erdos597Object.BooleanPosetCoding.orderName P Erdos597Object.BooleanPosetCoding.checkLabel)
              (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weightedSet Erdos597Object.BooleanPosetCoding.checkLabel weight) :=

  let filter := Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weightedSet Erdos597Object.BooleanPosetCoding.checkLabel weight;
  have hdiscrete := fun x x_1 h => Erdos597Object.BooleanPosetCoding.checkLabel_discrete h;
  have hedgeLeft := fun y => id Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_pair_mem_left;
  have hedgeRight := fun x => id Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_pair_mem_right;
  have hsub :=
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a => ⊤ ≤ _a)

            (Erdos597Object.BooleanPosetCoding.domainName P Erdos597Object.BooleanPosetCoding.checkLabel))))

              (Erdos597Object.BooleanPosetCoding.domainName_member P Erdos597Object.BooleanPosetCoding.checkLabel

            (Erdos597Object.subsetValue (Flypitch.V B)

              (Erdos597Object.BooleanPosetCoding.domainName P Erdos597Object.BooleanPosetCoding.checkLabel)))
          (congrArg

              (Erdos597Object.nonemptyValue (Flypitch.V B)
                (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weightedSet Erdos597Object.BooleanPosetCoding.checkLabel weight)))

                (congrArg iInf
                  (funext fun x =>
                    congrArg
                      (max
                        (Flypitch.bSet.mem x

                          sup_assoc
                            (Flypitch.bSet.mem y
                                (Erdos597Object.BooleanPosetCoding.domainName P
                                  Erdos597Object.BooleanPosetCoding.checkLabel))ᶜ
                            (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B)

                                weight)))))))

                                Flypitch.lattice.imp
