@Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.fibers_separated : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] {context : B}
  (domain relation : Flypitch.bSet B) (label : I → Flypitch.bSet B),
  (∀ (i j : I), i ≠ j → (label i).bv_eq (label j) = ⊥) →
    context ≤ Erdos597Object.singleValuedValue (Flypitch.V B) relation →
      ∀ (i j : I),
        i ≠ j →
          Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.fiberWeight context domain relation label i ⊓
                Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.fiberWeight context domain relation label j ⊓
              (Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.fiberElement context domain relation label i).bv_eq
                (Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.fiberElement context domain relation label j) =
            ⊥
theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.fibers_separated : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  {context : B} (domain relation : Flypitch.bSet B) (label : I → Flypitch.bSet B),
  (∀ (i j : I), i ≠ j → (label i).bv_eq (label j) = ⊥) →
    context ≤ Erdos597Object.singleValuedValue (Flypitch.V B) relation →
      ∀ (i j : I),
        i ≠ j →
          Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.fiberWeight context domain relation label i ⊓
                Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.fiberWeight context domain relation label j ⊓
              (Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.fiberElement context domain relation label i).bv_eq
                (Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.fiberElement context domain relation label j) =
            ⊥ :=
fun {B I} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] {context} domain relation label hdiscrete hsingle i j hij =>
  let part :=
    Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.fiberWeight context domain relation label i ⊓
        Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.fiberWeight context domain relation label j ⊓
      (Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.fiberElement context domain relation label i).bv_eq
        (Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.fiberElement context domain relation label j);
  have hcontext := LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_left) inf_le_left;
  have hi :=
    LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_left)
      (LE.le.trans (Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.fiberElement_spec context domain relation label i) inf_le_right);
  have hj :=
    LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_right)
      (LE.le.trans (Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.fiberElement_spec context domain relation label j) inf_le_right);
  have htransfer :=
    LE.le.trans (le_inf inf_le_right hi)
      (Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.edge_left_ext relation (label i)
        (Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.fiberElement context domain relation label i)
        (Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.fiberElement context domain relation label j));
  have heq :=
    LE.le.trans (le_inf hcontext (le_inf htransfer hj))
      (Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.singleValued_outputs relation hsingle
        (Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.fiberElement context domain relation label j) (label i) (label j));
  bot_unique (LE.le.trans_eq heq (hdiscrete i j hij))

@Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.fibers_cover : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] {context : B}
  (domain relation : Flypitch.bSet B) (label : I → Flypitch.bSet B),

      Erdos597Object.functionFromValue (Flypitch.V B) domain (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weightedSet label fun x => ⊤)

              (Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.fiberElement context domain relation label)
              (Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.fiberWeight context domain relation label))
theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.fibers_cover : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] {context : B}
  (domain relation : Flypitch.bSet B) (label : I → Flypitch.bSet B),
  context ≤
      Erdos597Object.functionFromValue (Flypitch.V B) domain (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weightedSet label fun x => ⊤)
        relation →
    context ≤ Erdos597Object.injectiveValue (Flypitch.V B) relation →
      ∀ (x : Flypitch.bSet B),
        context ⊓ x.mem domain ≤
          x.mem
            (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weightedSet
              (Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.fiberElement context domain relation label)
              (Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.fiberWeight context domain relation label)) :=
fun {B I} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] {context} domain relation label hfunction hinjective x =>
  let element := Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.fiberElement context domain relation label;
  let weight := Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.fiberWeight context domain relation label;
  have htotal := Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.totalAt_labels domain relation label hfunction x;
  have hpart := fun i =>
    let part := context ⊓ x.mem domain ⊓ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation x (label i);
    have hweight :=
      le_inf (LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_left)
        (le_iSup_of_le x (le_inf (LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_right) inf_le_right));
    have hedge :=
      LE.le.trans hweight
        (LE.le.trans (Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.fiberElement_spec context domain relation label i) inf_le_right);
    have heq :=
      LE.le.trans (le_inf (LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_left) (le_inf inf_le_right hedge))
        (Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.injective_outputs relation hinjective x (element i) (label i));
    LE.le.trans (le_inf hweight heq) (le_iSup (fun i => weight i ⊓ x.bv_eq (element i)) i);
  Trans.trans
    (Trans.trans (Eq.symm (inf_eq_left.mpr htotal))
      (inf_iSup_eq (context ⊓ x.mem domain) fun i => Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation x (label i)))
    (iSup_le hpart)

@Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.presentation_of_injection : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  {context : B} (domain : Flypitch.bSet B) (label : I → Flypitch.bSet B),
  (∀ (i j : I), i ≠ j → (label i).bv_eq (label j) = ⊥) →
    context ≤
        Erdos597Object.injectsIntoValue (Flypitch.V B) domain
          (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weightedSet label fun x => ⊤) →
      ∃ element weight,
        (∀ (i : I), weight i ≤ context ∧ weight i ≤ (element i).mem domain) ∧
          (∀ (i j : I), i ≠ j → weight i ⊓ weight j ⊓ (element i).bv_eq (element j) = ⊥) ∧
            context ≤ domain.bv_eq (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weightedSet element weight)
theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.presentation_of_injection : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  {context : B} (domain : Flypitch.bSet B) (label : I → Flypitch.bSet B),
  (∀ (i j : I), i ≠ j → (label i).bv_eq (label j) = ⊥) →
    context ≤
        Erdos597Object.injectsIntoValue (Flypitch.V B) domain
          (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weightedSet label fun x => ⊤) →
      ∃ element weight,
        (∀ (i : I), weight i ≤ context ∧ weight i ≤ (element i).mem domain) ∧
          (∀ (i j : I), i ≠ j → weight i ⊓ weight j ⊓ (element i).bv_eq (element j) = ⊥) ∧
            context ≤ domain.bv_eq (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weightedSet element weight) :=
fun {B I} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] {context} domain label hdiscrete hinjects =>

    fun relation h =>
    And.casesOn h fun hfunction hinjective =>
      let element := Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.fiberElement context domain relation label;
      let weight := Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.fiberWeight context domain relation label;
      have hmember := fun i =>
        LE.le.trans (Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.fiberElement_spec context domain relation label i) inf_le_left;

        (Exists.intro weight
          ⟨fun i => ⟨inf_le_left, hmember i⟩,
            ⟨Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.fibers_separated domain relation label hdiscrete
                (LE.le.trans hfunction (LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_left)),

                (Flypitch.bSet.subset_unfold'.mpr
                  (le_iInf fun x =>
                    Flypitch.lattice.le_imp_iff.mpr
                      (Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.fibers_cover domain relation label hfunction hinjective x)))
                (Flypitch.bSet.subset_intro fun i => LE.le.trans inf_le_right (hmember i))⟩⟩)

@Erdos597Object.PresentedPosets.antisymmetric_at : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] {context : B}
  (domain relation x y : Flypitch.bSet B),
  context ≤ Erdos597Object.partialOrderValue (Flypitch.V B) domain relation →
    context ≤ x.mem domain →
      context ≤ y.mem domain →
        context ≤ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation x y →
          context ≤ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation y x → context ≤ x.bv_eq y
theorem Erdos597Object.PresentedPosets.antisymmetric_at : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] {context : B}
  (domain relation x y : Flypitch.bSet B),
  context ≤ Erdos597Object.partialOrderValue (Flypitch.V B) domain relation →
    context ≤ x.mem domain →
      context ≤ y.mem domain →
        context ≤ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation x y →
          context ≤ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation y x → context ≤ x.bv_eq y :=
fun {B} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] {context} domain relation x y horder hx hy hxy hyx =>
  have h :=
    have hpart := LE.le.trans horder (LE.le.trans inf_le_right (LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_left));
    id
      (Eq.mp
        (congrArg (LE.le context)
          (congrArg (max (x.mem domain)ᶜ)
            (congrArg iInf
              (funext fun y =>
                sup_assoc (Flypitch.bSet.mem y domain)ᶜ
                  (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation x y ⊓
                      Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation y x)ᶜ
                  (x.bv_eq y)))))
        (LE.le.trans hpart
          (iInf_le
            (fun x =>
              (Erdos597Object.memberValue (Flypitch.V B) x domain)ᶜ ⊔
                ⨅ y,
                  (Erdos597Object.memberValue (Flypitch.V B) y domain)ᶜ ⊔
                      (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation x y ⊓
                          Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation y x)ᶜ ⊔
                    (Flypitch.V B).eq x y)
            x)));
  have hfirst := Flypitch.lattice.bv_context_apply h hx;
  have hsecond :=
    Flypitch.lattice.bv_context_apply
      (LE.le.trans hfirst
        (iInf_le
          (fun y =>
            Flypitch.lattice.imp (y.mem domain)
              (Flypitch.lattice.imp
                (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation x y ⊓
                  Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation y x)
                (x.bv_eq y)))
          y))
      hy;
  Flypitch.lattice.bv_context_apply hsecond (le_inf hxy hyx)
'Erdos597Object.PresentedPosets.antisymmetric_at' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
@Erdos597Object.PresentedPosets.transitive_at : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] {context : B}
  (domain relation x y z : Flypitch.bSet B),
  context ≤ Erdos597Object.partialOrderValue (Flypitch.V B) domain relation →
    context ≤ x.mem domain →
      context ≤ y.mem domain →
        context ≤ z.mem domain →
          context ≤ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation x y →
            context ≤ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation y z →
              context ≤ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation x z
theorem Erdos597Object.PresentedPosets.transitive_at : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] {context : B}
  (domain relation x y z : Flypitch.bSet B),
  context ≤ Erdos597Object.partialOrderValue (Flypitch.V B) domain relation →
    context ≤ x.mem domain →
      context ≤ y.mem domain →
        context ≤ z.mem domain →
          context ≤ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation x y →
            context ≤ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation y z →
              context ≤ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation x z :=
fun {B} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] {context} domain relation x y z horder hx hy hz hxy hyz =>
  have h :=
    have hpart := LE.le.trans horder (LE.le.trans inf_le_right (LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_right));
    id
      (Eq.mp
        (congrArg (LE.le context)
          (congrArg (max (x.mem domain)ᶜ)
            (congrArg iInf
              (funext fun y =>
                congrArg (max (Flypitch.bSet.mem y domain)ᶜ)
                  (congrArg iInf
                    (funext fun z =>
                      sup_assoc (Flypitch.bSet.mem z domain)ᶜ
                        (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation x y ⊓
                            Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation y z)ᶜ
                        (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation x z)))))))
        (LE.le.trans hpart
          (iInf_le
            (fun x =>
              (Erdos597Object.memberValue (Flypitch.V B) x domain)ᶜ ⊔
                ⨅ y,
                  (Erdos597Object.memberValue (Flypitch.V B) y domain)ᶜ ⊔
                    ⨅ z,
                      (Erdos597Object.memberValue (Flypitch.V B) z domain)ᶜ ⊔
                          (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation x y ⊓
                              Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation y z)ᶜ ⊔
                        Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation x z)
            x)));
  have hfirst := Flypitch.lattice.bv_context_apply h hx;
  have hsecond :=
    Flypitch.lattice.bv_context_apply
      (LE.le.trans hfirst
        (iInf_le
          (fun y =>
            Flypitch.lattice.imp (y.mem domain)
              (⨅ z,
                Flypitch.lattice.imp (z.mem domain)
                  (Flypitch.lattice.imp
                    (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation x y ⊓
                      Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation y z)
                    (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation x z))))
          y))
      hy;
  have hthird :=
    Flypitch.lattice.bv_context_apply
      (LE.le.trans hsecond
        (iInf_le
          (fun z =>
            Flypitch.lattice.imp (z.mem domain)
              (Flypitch.lattice.imp
                (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation x y ⊓
                  Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation y z)
                (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation x z)))
          z))
      hz;
  Flypitch.lattice.bv_context_apply hthird (le_inf hxy hyz)

@Erdos597Object.PresentedPosets.poset_presentation : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] {context : B}
  (domain relation : Flypitch.bSet B) (label : I → Flypitch.bSet B),
  (∀ (i j : I), i ≠ j → (label i).bv_eq (label j) = ⊥) →
    context ≤
        Erdos597Object.injectsIntoValue (Flypitch.V B) domain
          (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weightedSet label fun x => ⊤) →
      context ≤ Erdos597Object.partialOrderValue (Flypitch.V B) domain relation →
        context ≤ Erdos597Object.nonemptyValue (Flypitch.V B) domain →
          ∃ element P,
            ⨆ i, P.member i = context ∧
              (∀ (i : I), P.member i ≤ context ∧ P.member i ≤ (element i).mem domain) ∧
                (∀ (i j : I), i ≠ j → P.member i ⊓ P.member j ⊓ (element i).bv_eq (element j) = ⊥) ∧

                    ∀ (i j : I),
                      P.leValue i j =
                        P.member i ⊓ P.member j ⊓
                          Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element i) (element j)

  {context : B} (domain relation : Flypitch.bSet B) (label : I → Flypitch.bSet B),

    context ≤
        Erdos597Object.injectsIntoValue (Flypitch.V B) domain
          (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weightedSet label fun x => ⊤) →
      context ≤ Erdos597Object.partialOrderValue (Flypitch.V B) domain relation →
        context ≤ Erdos597Object.nonemptyValue (Flypitch.V B) domain →
          ∃ element P,
            ⨆ i, P.member i = context ∧
              (∀ (i : I), P.member i ≤ context ∧ P.member i ≤ (element i).mem domain) ∧
                (∀ (i j : I), i ≠ j → P.member i ⊓ P.member j ⊓ (element i).bv_eq (element j) = ⊥) ∧
                  context ≤ domain.bv_eq (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weightedSet element P.member) ∧
                    ∀ (i j : I),
                      P.leValue i j =
                        P.member i ⊓ P.member j ⊓
                          Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element i) (element j) :=

    fun element h =>

      And.casesOn h fun hvalid right =>
        And.casesOn right fun hseparate heq =>
          let P :=
            Erdos597Object.PresentedPosets.ofNames context domain relation element weight hvalid hseparate horder;

              ⟨le_antisymm (iSup_le fun i => (hvalid i).left)

                    LE.le.trans (le_inf heq hnonempty)

                      Eq.mp
                        (congrArg (fun _a => context ≤ _a)
                          (Erdos597Object.PresentedPosets.weighted_nonempty element weight))
                        h)
                    h),
                ⟨hvalid, ⟨hseparate, ⟨heq, fun x x_1 => rfl⟩⟩⟩⟩)

@Erdos597Object.PresentedCompatibility.ofNames_compatibility : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (context : B) (domain relation : Flypitch.bSet B) (element : I → Flypitch.bSet B) (weight : I → B)
  (hvalid : ∀ (i : I), weight i ≤ context ∧ weight i ≤ (element i).mem domain)

      (Erdos597Object.PresentedPosets.ofNames context domain relation element weight hvalid hseparate horder) i j =

      ⨆ k,
        weight k ⊓
          (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element k) (element i) ⊓
            Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element k) (element j))
theorem Erdos597Object.PresentedCompatibility.ofNames_compatibility : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (context : B) (domain relation : Flypitch.bSet B) (element : I → Flypitch.bSet B) (weight : I → B)
  (hvalid : ∀ (i : I), weight i ≤ context ∧ weight i ≤ (element i).mem domain)
  (hseparate : ∀ (i j : I), i ≠ j → weight i ⊓ weight j ⊓ (element i).bv_eq (element j) = ⊥)

  Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.compatibleValue
      (Erdos597Object.PresentedPosets.ofNames context domain relation element weight hvalid hseparate horder) i j =
    weight i ⊓ weight j ⊓
      ⨆ k,
        weight k ⊓
          (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element k) (element i) ⊓
            Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element k) (element j)) :=
fun {B I} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] context domain relation element weight hvalid hseparate horder i j =>
  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrArg
        (Eq
          (⨆ k,
            weight k ⊓ weight i ⊓ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element k) (element i) ⊓
              (weight k ⊓ weight j ⊓ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element k) (element j))))
        (inf_iSup_eq (weight i ⊓ weight j) fun i_1 =>
          weight i_1 ⊓
            (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element i_1) (element i) ⊓
              Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element i_1) (element j)))))
    (iSup_congr fun k =>
      of_eq_true
        (Eq.trans
          (congr
            (congrArg Eq
              (Eq.trans
                (Eq.trans
                  (congr
                    (congrArg min
                      (Eq.trans
                        (congrFun' (congrArg min (inf_comm (weight k) (weight i)))
                          (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element k) (element i)))
                        (inf_assoc (weight i) (weight k)
                          (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element k) (element i)))))
                    (Eq.trans
                      (congrFun' (congrArg min (inf_comm (weight k) (weight j)))
                        (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element k) (element j)))
                      (inf_assoc (weight j) (weight k)
                        (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element k) (element j)))))
                  (inf_left_comm
                    (weight i ⊓ (weight k ⊓ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element k) (element i)))
                    (weight j) (weight k ⊓ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element k) (element j))))
                (Eq.trans
                  (congrArg (min (weight j))
                    (Eq.trans
                      (inf_left_comm
                        (weight i ⊓
                          (weight k ⊓ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element k) (element i)))
                        (weight k) (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element k) (element j)))
                      (Eq.trans
                        (Eq.trans
                          (congrArg (min (weight k))
                            (Eq.trans
                              (inf_comm
                                (weight i ⊓
                                  (weight k ⊓ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element k) (element i)))

                                  (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element k) (element j)) (weight i)
                                  (weight k ⊓ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element k) (element i)))

                                      (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element k) (element j))
                                      (weight k)

                                    (congrArg (min (weight k))

                                        (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element k) (element j))
                                        (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element k)
                                          (element i)))))))))
                          (inf_left_comm (weight k) (weight i)
                            (weight k ⊓
                              (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element k) (element i) ⊓

                      (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element k) (element i) ⊓
                        Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element k) (element j)))))))

  (element : I → Flypitch.bSet B) (weight : I → B) (domain : Flypitch.bSet B),

      (∀ (i j : I), i ≠ j → weight i ⊓ weight j ⊓ (element i).bv_eq (element j) = ⊥) →

theorem Erdos597Object.ContextualCCC.cover_of_injected_members : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  {context : B} (element : I → Flypitch.bSet B) (weight : I → B) (domain : Flypitch.bSet B),
  (∀ (i : I), weight i ≤ context) →
    (∀ (i : I), weight i ≤ (element i).mem domain) →
      (∀ (i j : I), i ≠ j → weight i ⊓ weight j ⊓ (element i).bv_eq (element j) = ⊥) →
        context ≤ Erdos597Object.injectsIntoValue (Flypitch.V B) domain Flypitch.bSet.omega →
          Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.HasCountableCover weight :=
fun {B I} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] {context} element weight domain hcontext hmembers hseparate hinjects =>
  Exists.casesOn (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.injectsInto_witness domain Flypitch.bSet.omega hinjects) fun relation h =>
    And.casesOn h fun hfunction hinjective =>
      let rows := fun n i =>
        weight i ⊓ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element i) (Flypitch.bSet.ofNat n);
      Exists.intro rows
        ⟨fun n i j hij =>
          let part := rows n i ⊓ rows n j;
          have hi := LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_left;
          have hj := LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_left;
          have hei := LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_right;
          have hej := LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_right;
          have heq :=

          fun i =>

              hfunction (element i);

              (id

                    (inf_iSup_eq (weight i) fun n =>
                      Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element i) (Flypitch.bSet.ofNat n)))))

  (context : B) (domain relation : Flypitch.bSet B) (element : I → Flypitch.bSet B) (weight values : I → B),
  context ≤ domain.bv_eq (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weightedSet element weight) →

theorem Erdos597Object.PresentedFilters.orderFilter_from_weights : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (context : B) (domain relation : Flypitch.bSet B) (element : I → Flypitch.bSet B) (weight values : I → B),
  context ≤ domain.bv_eq (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weightedSet element weight) →
    (∀ (i : I), values i ≤ (element i).mem domain) →
      context ≤ ⨆ i, values i →
        (∀ (i j : I),
            values i ⊓ weight j ⊓ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element i) (element j) ≤ values j) →
          (∀ (i j : I),
              values i ⊓ values j ≤
                ⨆ k,
                  values k ⊓
                    (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element k) (element i) ⊓
                      Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element k) (element j))) →
            context ≤
              Erdos597Object.orderFilterValue (Flypitch.V B) domain relation
                (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weightedSet element values) :=
fun {B I} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] context domain relation element weight values heq hmembers hcover hup hdir =>
  let filter := Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weightedSet element values;
  have hsub :=
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a => context ≤ _a)
          (Erdos597Object.BooleanAntichains.weighted_subset_value element values domain)))
      (le_iInf fun i => Flypitch.lattice.le_imp_iff.mpr (LE.le.trans inf_le_right (hmembers i)));
  have hnonempty :=
    Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (LE.le context) (Erdos597Object.PresentedPosets.weighted_nonempty element values))) hcover;
  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrArg (LE.le context)
        (congrArg
          (min
            (Erdos597Object.subsetValue (Flypitch.V B) (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weightedSet element values) domain))
          (congrArg
            (min (Erdos597Object.nonemptyValue (Flypitch.V B) (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weightedSet element values)))
            (congrFun'
              (congrArg min
                (congrArg iInf
                  (funext fun x =>
                    congrArg (max (Flypitch.bSet.mem x (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weightedSet element values))ᶜ)
                      (congrArg iInf
                        (funext fun y =>
                          sup_assoc (Flypitch.bSet.mem y domain)ᶜ
                            (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation x y)ᶜ
                            (Flypitch.bSet.mem y (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weightedSet element values)))))))

  (context : B) (domain relation subset : Flypitch.bSet B) (element : I → Flypitch.bSet B) (weight : I → B),

@Erdos597Object.BooleanFilterSemantics.orderFilter_ext : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (domain relation : Flypitch.bSet B),
  Flypitch.bSet.B_ext fun filter => Erdos597Object.orderFilterValue (Flypitch.V B) domain relation filter
theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanFilterSemantics.orderFilter_ext : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (domain relation : Flypitch.bSet B),
  Flypitch.bSet.B_ext fun filter => Erdos597Object.orderFilterValue (Flypitch.V B) domain relation filter :=
fun {B} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] domain relation =>
  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrArg Flypitch.bSet.B_ext
        (funext fun filter =>
          congrArg (min (⨅ z, (Flypitch.bSet.mem z filter)ᶜ ⊔ Flypitch.bSet.mem z domain))
            (congrArg (min (⨆ x, Flypitch.bSet.mem x filter))
              (congrFun'
                (congrArg min
                  (congrArg iInf
                    (funext fun x =>
                      congrArg (max (Flypitch.bSet.mem x filter)ᶜ)
                        (congrArg iInf
                          (funext fun y =>
                            sup_assoc (Flypitch.bSet.mem y domain)ᶜ
                              (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation x y)ᶜ (Flypitch.bSet.mem y filter))))))
                (⨅ x,
                  (Flypitch.bSet.mem x filter)ᶜ ⊔
                    ⨅ y,
                      (Flypitch.bSet.mem y filter)ᶜ ⊔
                        ⨆ z,
                          Flypitch.bSet.mem z filter ⊓
                            (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation z x ⊓
                              Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation z y)))))))
    (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_inf
      (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_iInf fun x =>
        Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_sup (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_compl (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_mem_right x))
          (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_const (Flypitch.bSet.mem x domain)))
      (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_inf (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_iSup fun x => Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_mem_right x)
        (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_inf
          (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_iInf fun x =>
            Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_sup (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_compl (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_mem_right x))
              (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_iInf fun y =>
                Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_sup (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_const (Flypitch.bSet.mem y domain)ᶜ)
                  (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_sup
                    (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_const (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation x y)ᶜ)
                    (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_mem_right y))))
          (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_iInf fun x =>
            Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_sup (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_compl (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_mem_right x))
              (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_iInf fun y =>
                Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_sup (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_compl (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_mem_right y))
                  (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_iSup fun z =>
                    Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_inf (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_mem_right z)
                      (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_const
                        (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation z x ⊓
                          Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation z y))))))))

@Erdos597Object.BooleanFilterSemantics.filter_upward : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] {context : B}
  (domain relation filter x y : Flypitch.bSet B),
  context ≤ Erdos597Object.orderFilterValue (Flypitch.V B) domain relation filter →
    context ≤ x.mem filter →
      context ≤ y.mem domain → context ≤ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation x y → context ≤ y.mem filter
theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanFilterSemantics.filter_upward : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  {context : B} (domain relation filter x y : Flypitch.bSet B),
  context ≤ Erdos597Object.orderFilterValue (Flypitch.V B) domain relation filter →
    context ≤ x.mem filter →
      context ≤ y.mem domain →
        context ≤ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation x y → context ≤ y.mem filter :=
fun {B} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] {context} domain relation filter x y hfilter hx hy hxy =>
  have hup :=
    LE.le.trans
      (Eq.mp
        (congrArg (LE.le context)
          (congrArg (min (Erdos597Object.subsetValue (Flypitch.V B) filter domain))
            (congrArg (min (Erdos597Object.nonemptyValue (Flypitch.V B) filter))
              (congrFun'
                (congrArg min
                  (congrArg iInf
                    (funext fun x =>
                      congrArg (max (Flypitch.bSet.mem x filter)ᶜ)
                        (congrArg iInf
                          (funext fun y =>
                            sup_assoc (Flypitch.bSet.mem y domain)ᶜ
                              (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation x y)ᶜ (Flypitch.bSet.mem y filter))))))
                (⨅ x,
                  (Flypitch.bSet.mem x filter)ᶜ ⊔
                    ⨅ y,
                      (Flypitch.bSet.mem y filter)ᶜ ⊔
                        ⨆ z,
                          Flypitch.bSet.mem z filter ⊓
                            (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation z x ⊓
                              Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation z y))))))
        hfilter)
      (LE.le.trans inf_le_right (LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_left));
  have hxImp :=
    Flypitch.lattice.bv_context_apply
      (LE.le.trans hup
        (iInf_le
          (fun x =>
            (Flypitch.bSet.mem x filter)ᶜ ⊔
              ⨅ y,
                (Flypitch.bSet.mem y domain)ᶜ ⊔
                  ((Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation x y)ᶜ ⊔ Flypitch.bSet.mem y filter))
          x))
      hx;
  have hyImp :=
    Flypitch.lattice.bv_context_apply
      (LE.le.trans hxImp
        (iInf_le
          (fun y =>
            (Flypitch.bSet.mem y domain)ᶜ ⊔
              ((Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation x y)ᶜ ⊔ Flypitch.bSet.mem y filter))
          y))
      hy;
  Flypitch.lattice.bv_context_apply hyImp hxy

@Erdos597Object.OutsideRestriction.restricted_cover : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] (context : B)
  (P : Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.BooleanPoset B I) (weight : Option I → B),
  (∀ (i : Option I), weight i ≤ (Erdos597Object.ContextCompletion.withOutside context P).member i) →
    ⨆ i, weight i = ⊤ → context ≤ ⨆ i, weight (some i)
theorem Erdos597Object.OutsideRestriction.restricted_cover : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (context : B) (P : Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.BooleanPoset B I) (weight : Option I → B),
  (∀ (i : Option I), weight i ≤ (Erdos597Object.ContextCompletion.withOutside context P).member i) →
    ⨆ i, weight i = ⊤ → context ≤ ⨆ i, weight (some i) :=
fun {B I} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] context P weight hvalid hcover =>
  have htotal := Eq.trans (Eq.symm (iSup_option weight)) hcover;
  have hzero :=
    bot_unique (LE.le.trans_eq (le_inf inf_le_left (LE.le.trans inf_le_right (hvalid none))) inf_compl_eq_bot);
  Trans.trans
    (Trans.trans
      (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => context = context ⊓ _a) htotal))
        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => context = _a) (inf_top_eq context))) (Eq.refl context)))
      (inf_sup_left context (weight none) (⨆ i, weight (some i))))
    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ⊔ context ⊓ ⨆ i, weight (some i) ≤ ⨆ i, weight (some i)) hzero))
      (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ≤ ⨆ i, weight (some i)) (bot_sup_eq (context ⊓ ⨆ i, weight (some i)))))
        inf_le_right))

@Erdos597Object.OutsideRestriction.restricted_directed : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] (context : B)
  (P : Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.BooleanPoset B I) (weight : Option I → B),
  (∀ (i j : Option I),
      weight i ⊓ weight j ≤
        ⨆ k,
          weight k ⊓
            ((Erdos597Object.ContextCompletion.withOutside context P).leValue k i ⊓
              (Erdos597Object.ContextCompletion.withOutside context P).leValue k j)) →
    ∀ (i j : I), weight (some i) ⊓ weight (some j) ≤ ⨆ k, weight (some k) ⊓ (P.leValue k i ⊓ P.leValue k j)
theorem Erdos597Object.OutsideRestriction.restricted_directed : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (context : B) (P : Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.BooleanPoset B I) (weight : Option I → B),
  (∀ (i j : Option I),
      weight i ⊓ weight j ≤
        ⨆ k,
          weight k ⊓
            ((Erdos597Object.ContextCompletion.withOutside context P).leValue k i ⊓
              (Erdos597Object.ContextCompletion.withOutside context P).leValue k j)) →
    ∀ (i j : I), weight (some i) ⊓ weight (some j) ≤ ⨆ k, weight (some k) ⊓ (P.leValue k i ⊓ P.leValue k j) :=
fun {B I} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] context P weight hdir i j =>
  Eq.mp
    (congrArg (LE.le (weight (some i) ⊓ weight (some j)))
      (Eq.trans
        (iSup_option fun o =>
          weight o ⊓
            ((match o, some i with
              | none, none => contextᶜ
              | some i, some j => P.leValue i j
              | x, x_1 => ⊥) ⊓
              match o, some j with
              | none, none => contextᶜ
              | some i, some j => P.leValue i j
              | x, x_1 => ⊥))
        (Eq.trans
          (congrFun' (congrArg max (Eq.trans (congrArg (min (weight none)) (inf_bot_eq ⊥)) (inf_bot_eq (weight none))))
            (⨆ b, weight (some b) ⊓ (P.leValue b i ⊓ P.leValue b j)))
          (bot_sup_eq (⨆ b, weight (some b) ⊓ (P.leValue b i ⊓ P.leValue b j))))))
    (hdir (some i) (some j))

@Erdos597Object.OutsideRestriction.restricted_meets : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (context active : B) (P : Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.BooleanPoset B I) (weight : Option I → B) (dense : I → B),
  active ≤ context →
    ⨆ i, weight i ⊓ Erdos597Object.CodedDensity.outsideDense context active P dense i = ⊤ →
      active ≤ ⨆ i, weight (some i) ⊓ dense i
theorem Erdos597Object.OutsideRestriction.restricted_meets : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (context active : B) (P : Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.BooleanPoset B I) (weight : Option I → B) (dense : I → B),
  active ≤ context →
    ⨆ i, weight i ⊓ Erdos597Object.CodedDensity.outsideDense context active P dense i = ⊤ →
      active ≤ ⨆ i, weight (some i) ⊓ dense i :=
fun {B I} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] context active P weight dense hactive hmeets =>
  have h :=
    Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => active ≤ active ⊓ _a) hmeets))
      (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => active ≤ _a) (inf_top_eq active))) (le_refl active));
  LE.le.trans
    (Eq.mp
      (congrArg (fun _a => active ≤ _a)
        (inf_iSup_eq active fun i => weight i ⊓ Erdos597Object.CodedDensity.outsideDense context active P dense i))
      h)
    (iSup_le fun i =>
      Option.casesOn (motive := fun t =>
        i = t →
          active ⊓ (weight i ⊓ Erdos597Object.CodedDensity.outsideDense context active P dense i) ≤
            ⨆ i, weight (some i) ⊓ dense i)
        i
        (fun h =>
          Eq.symm h ▸
            have hbot := le_inf (LE.le.trans inf_le_left hactive) (LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_right);
            LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans_eq hbot inf_compl_eq_bot) bot_le)
        (fun i_1 h =>
          Eq.symm h ▸
            le_iSup_of_le i_1
              (id
                (Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg (fun _a => _a ≤ weight (some i_1) ⊓ dense i_1)
                      (Eq.symm (inf_assoc active (weight (some i_1)) (activeᶜ ⊓ P.member i_1 ⊔ dense i_1)))))
                  (Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg (fun _a => _a ≤ weight (some i_1) ⊓ dense i_1)
                        (inf_sup_left (active ⊓ weight (some i_1)) (activeᶜ ⊓ P.member i_1) (dense i_1))))
                    (sup_le
                      (have hbot := le_inf (LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_left) (LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_left);
                      LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans_eq hbot inf_compl_eq_bot) bot_le)
                      (le_inf (LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_right) inf_le_right))))))
        (Eq.refl i))

  (∀ (i : I), weight i ≤ (element i).mem domain) →
    context ≤ domain.bv_eq (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weightedSet element weight) →
      context ≤ Erdos597Object.denseValue (Flypitch.V B) domain relation subset →

theorem Erdos597Object.ContextualDensity.dense_coefficients : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (context : B) (domain relation subset : Flypitch.bSet B) (element : I → Flypitch.bSet B) (weight : I → B),
  (∀ (i : I), weight i ≤ (element i).mem domain) →
    context ≤ domain.bv_eq (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weightedSet element weight) →
      context ≤ Erdos597Object.denseValue (Flypitch.V B) domain relation subset →
        ∀ (j : I),

            ⨆ i,

                (weight i ⊓ weight j ⊓ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element i) (element j)) :=
fun {B I} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] context domain relation subset element weight hmembers heq hdense j =>

    Erdos597Object.PresentedSubsets.dense_presentation context domain relation subset element weight heq hdense;

                  (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weightedSet element fun i => weight i ⊓ (element i).mem subset) ⊓
                Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation y x)
        (element j));
  have hex := Flypitch.lattice.bv_context_apply himp (LE.le.trans inf_le_right (hmembers j));
  id

      Trans.trans

            (Eq.mp
              (congrArg (fun _a => context ⊓ weight j ≤ _a)
                (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weighted_bounded_exists element (fun i => weight i ⊓ (element i).mem subset)
                  (fun x => Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation x (element j))
                  (Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.edge_left_ext relation (element j))))
              hex))
          (inf_iSup_eq (weight j) fun i =>
            weight i ⊓ (element i).mem subset ⊓
              Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element i) (element j)))
        (iSup_congr fun i =>
          of_eq_true
            (Eq.trans
              (congr
                (congrArg Eq
                  (congrArg (min (weight j))
                    (Eq.trans
                      (inf_comm (weight i ⊓ (element i).mem subset)
                        (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element i) (element j)))
                      (inf_left_comm (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element i) (element j))
                        (weight i) ((element i).mem subset)))))
                (Eq.trans
                  (Eq.trans
                    (congrArg (min (weight i ⊓ (element i).mem subset))
                      (Eq.trans
                        (congrFun' (congrArg min (inf_comm (weight i) (weight j)))
                          (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element i) (element j)))
                        (inf_assoc (weight j) (weight i)
                          (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element i) (element j)))))
                    (inf_comm (weight i ⊓ (element i).mem subset)
                      (weight j ⊓
                        (weight i ⊓ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element i) (element j)))))
                  (Eq.trans
                    (inf_left_comm
                      (weight j ⊓ (weight i ⊓ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element i) (element j)))
                      (weight i) ((element i).mem subset))
                    (Eq.trans
                      (Eq.trans
                        (congrArg (min (weight i))
                          (Eq.trans
                            (inf_assoc (weight j)
                              (weight i ⊓ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element i) (element j))
                              ((element i).mem subset))
                            (congrArg (min (weight j))
                              (inf_assoc (weight i)
                                (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element i) (element j))
                                ((element i).mem subset)))))
                        (inf_left_comm (weight i) (weight j)
                          (weight i ⊓
                            (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element i) (element j) ⊓
                              (element i).mem subset))))
                      (congrArg (min (weight j))
                        (inf_left_idem (weight i)
                          (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element i) (element j) ⊓
                            (element i).mem subset)))))))
              (eq_self
                (weight j ⊓
                  (weight i ⊓
                    (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element i) (element j) ⊓
                      (element i).mem subset)))))))
    hex

@Erdos597Object.RelabeledFilters.pull_coefficients : ∀ {B I J D : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] (e : J ≃ I)

theorem Erdos597Object.RelabeledFilters.pull_coefficients : ∀ {B I J D : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (e : J ≃ I) (P : Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.BooleanPoset B I) (dense : D → I → B) (weight : J → B),
  (∀ (j : J), weight j ≤ (Erdos597Object.PosetRelabeling.relabel e P).member j) →
    ⨆ j, weight j = ⊤ →
      (∀ (j k : J), weight j ⊓ (Erdos597Object.PosetRelabeling.relabel e P).leValue j k ≤ weight k) →
        (∀ (j k : J),
            weight j ⊓ weight k ≤
              ⨆ l,
                weight l ⊓
                  ((Erdos597Object.PosetRelabeling.relabel e P).leValue l j ⊓
                    (Erdos597Object.PosetRelabeling.relabel e P).leValue l k)) →
          (∀ (d : D), ⨆ j, weight j ⊓ dense d (e j) = ⊤) →
            ∃ value,

                (Function.Surjective.iSup_comp (Equiv.surjective e) fun k =>
                  weight (e.symm k) ⊓ (P.leValue k i ⊓ P.leValue k j));
            LE.le.trans_eq

                (congrArg (LE.le (weight (e.symm i) ⊓ weight (e.symm j)))
                  (congrArg iSup

                        (congr (congrArg min (congrArg (P.leValue (e l)) ((fun x => Equiv.apply_symm_apply e x) i)))

Erdos597Object.ContextualMartinModel.contextual_coefficients : ∀
  (context : Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.finalAlgebra.Carrier)
  (P :
    Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.BooleanPoset Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.finalAlgebra.Carrier
      Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.Labels)
  (active : Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.Labels → Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.finalAlgebra.Carrier)
  (dense :
    Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.Labels →
      Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.Labels → Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.finalAlgebra.Carrier),
  Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.BooleanCountableChainCondition P →
    ⨆ i, P.member i = context →
      (∀ (d : Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.Labels), active d ≤ context) →
        (∀ (d i : Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.Labels), dense d i ≤ P.member i) →
          (∀ (d j : Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.Labels), active d ⊓ P.member j ≤ ⨆ i, dense d i ⊓ P.leValue i j) →

                        weight i ⊓ weight j ≤ ⨆ k, weight k ⊓ (P.leValue k i ⊓ P.leValue k j)) ∧
                      ∀ (d : Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.Labels), active d ≤ ⨆ i, weight i ⊓ dense d i
theorem Erdos597Object.ContextualMartinModel.contextual_coefficients : ∀
  (context : Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.finalAlgebra.Carrier)
  (P :
    Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.BooleanPoset Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.finalAlgebra.Carrier
      Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.Labels)
  (active : Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.Labels → Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.finalAlgebra.Carrier)
  (dense :
    Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.Labels →
      Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.Labels → Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.finalAlgebra.Carrier),
  Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.BooleanCountableChainCondition P →
    ⨆ i, P.member i = context →
      (∀ (d : Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.Labels), active d ≤ context) →
        (∀ (d i : Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.Labels), dense d i ≤ P.member i) →
          (∀ (d j : Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.Labels), active d ⊓ P.member j ≤ ⨆ i, dense d i ⊓ P.leValue i j) →
            ∃ weight,
              (∀ (i : Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.Labels), weight i ≤ P.member i) ∧
                context ≤ ⨆ i, weight i ∧
                  (∀ (i j : Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.Labels), weight i ⊓ P.leValue i j ≤ weight j) ∧
                    (∀ (i j : Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.Labels),
                        weight i ⊓ weight j ≤ ⨆ k, weight k ⊓ (P.leValue k i ⊓ P.leValue k j)) ∧
                      ∀ (d : Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.Labels), active d ≤ ⨆ i, weight i ⊓ dense d i :=
fun context P active dense hP hcover hactive hsubset hdense =>
  let wide := Erdos597Object.ContextCompletion.withOutside context P;
  let wideDense := fun d => Erdos597Object.CodedDensity.outsideDense context (active d) P (dense d);
  let e := (Erdos597Object.PosetRelabeling.optionEquiv Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.Labels).symm;
  let Q := Erdos597Object.PosetRelabeling.relabel e wide;
  let Qdense := fun d j => wideDense d (e j);
  have hQccc :=
    Erdos597Object.PosetRelabeling.relabel_ccc Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.finalAlgebra.ccc e wide
      (Erdos597Object.ContextCompletion.withOutside_booleanCCC context P hP);
  have hQcover :=
    Eq.trans (Erdos597Object.PosetRelabeling.relabel_members e wide)
      (Erdos597Object.ContextCompletion.withOutside_cover context P hcover);
  have hQdense := fun d =>
    Erdos597Object.CodedDensity.denseValue_of_coefficients Q (Qdense d)
      (fun j => Erdos597Object.CodedDensity.outsideDense_subset context (active d) P (dense d) (hsubset d) (e j))
      (Erdos597Object.CodedDensity.relabel_dense e wide (wideDense d)
        (Erdos597Object.CodedDensity.outsideDense_dense context (active d) P (dense d) (hdense d)));
  Exists.casesOn (Erdos597Object.FilterCoefficients.final_coefficients Q Qdense hQccc hQcover hQdense) fun weight h =>
    And.casesOn h fun hweight right =>
      And.casesOn right fun htotal right =>
        And.casesOn right fun hup right =>
          And.casesOn right fun hdir hmeets =>
            Exists.casesOn
              (Erdos597Object.RelabeledFilters.pull_coefficients e wide wideDense weight hweight htotal hup hdir hmeets)
              fun wideWeight h =>
              And.casesOn h fun hwide right =>
                And.casesOn right fun hwideTotal right =>
                  And.casesOn right fun hwideUp right =>
                    And.casesOn right fun hwideDir hwideMeets =>
                      Exists.intro (fun i => wideWeight (some i))
                        ⟨fun i => hwide (some i),
                          ⟨Erdos597Object.OutsideRestriction.restricted_cover context P wideWeight hwide hwideTotal,
                            ⟨Erdos597Object.OutsideRestriction.restricted_upward context P wideWeight hwideUp,
                              ⟨Erdos597Object.OutsideRestriction.restricted_directed context P wideWeight hwideDir,
                                fun d =>
                                Erdos597Object.OutsideRestriction.restricted_meets context (active d) P wideWeight
                                  (dense d) (hactive d) (hwideMeets d)⟩⟩⟩⟩

@Erdos597Object.BooleanFunctionBridge.product_membership : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (domain codomain entry : Flypitch.bSet B),
  entry.mem (domain.prod codomain) = ⨆ x, x.mem domain ⊓ ⨆ y, y.mem codomain ⊓ entry.bv_eq (x.pair y)
theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanFunctionBridge.product_membership : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (domain codomain entry : Flypitch.bSet B),
  entry.mem (domain.prod codomain) = ⨆ x, x.mem domain ⊓ ⨆ y, y.mem codomain ⊓ entry.bv_eq (x.pair y) :=
fun {B} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] domain codomain entry =>
  Trans.trans
    (Trans.trans
      (Trans.trans
        (id
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg
                (fun _a =>
                  _a = ⨆ i, ⨆ j, domain.bval i ⊓ codomain.bval j ⊓ entry.bv_eq ((domain.func i).pair (codomain.func j)))
                iSup_prod))
            (Eq.refl
              (⨆ i,
                ⨆ j,
                  domain.bval (i, j).1 ⊓ codomain.bval (i, j).2 ⊓
                    entry.bv_eq ((domain.func (i, j).1).pair (codomain.func (i, j).2))))))
        (of_eq_true
          (Eq.trans
            (congr
              (congrArg Eq
                (congrArg iSup
                  (funext fun i =>
                    congrArg iSup
                      (funext fun j =>
                        inf_assoc (domain.bval i) (codomain.bval j)
                          (entry.bv_eq ((domain.func i).pair (codomain.func j)))))))
              (congrArg iSup
                (funext fun i =>
                  inf_iSup_eq (domain.bval i) fun i_1 =>
                    codomain.bval i_1 ⊓ entry.bv_eq ((domain.func i).pair (codomain.func i_1)))))
            (eq_self
              (⨆ i, ⨆ j, domain.bval i ⊓ (codomain.bval j ⊓ entry.bv_eq ((domain.func i).pair (codomain.func j))))))))
      (iSup_congr fun i =>
        Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                domain.bval i ⊓ _a = domain.bval i ⊓ ⨆ y, y.mem codomain ⊓ entry.bv_eq ((domain.func i).pair y))
              (Flypitch.bSet.bounded_exists codomain (fun z => entry.bv_eq ((domain.func i).pair z))
                (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_pair_right (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_eq_right entry) (domain.func i)))))
          (Eq.refl (domain.bval i ⊓ ⨆ y, y.mem codomain ⊓ entry.bv_eq ((domain.func i).pair y)))))
    (Flypitch.bSet.bounded_exists domain (fun x => ⨆ i, i.mem codomain ⊓ entry.bv_eq (x.pair i))
      (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_iSup fun y =>
        Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_inf (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_const (y.mem codomain))
          (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_pair_left (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_eq_right entry) y)))

  (relation : Flypitch.bSet B), Erdos597Object.singleValuedValue (Flypitch.V B) relation = relation.is_func :=

  le_antisymm
    (id
      (le_iInf fun x =>
        le_iInf fun y =>
          le_iInf fun u =>
            le_iInf fun v =>
              Flypitch.lattice.bv_imp_intro
                (Flypitch.lattice.bv_imp_intro
                  (let part :=
                    Erdos597Object.singleValuedValue (Flypitch.V B) relation ⊓
                        (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation x u ⊓
                          Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation y v) ⊓
                      x.bv_eq y;
                  have hxu := LE.le.trans inf_le_left (LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_left);
                  have hyv := LE.le.trans inf_le_left (LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_right);
                  have hyu :=
                    LE.le.trans (le_inf inf_le_right hxu)
                      (Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.edge_left_ext relation u x y);
                  LE.le.trans (le_inf (LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_left) (le_inf hyu hyv))
                    (Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.singleValued_outputs relation le_rfl y u v)))))
    (id
      (le_iInf fun x =>
        le_iInf fun y =>
          le_iInf fun z =>
            Flypitch.lattice.bv_imp_intro
              (have h :=
                LE.le.trans inf_le_left

                    (iInf_le
                      (fun w₁ =>
                        ⨅ w₂,
                          ⨅ v₁,
                            ⨅ v₂,

                        (fun w₂ =>
                          ⨅ v₁,
                            ⨅ v₂,
                              Flypitch.lattice.imp ((Flypitch.bSet.pair x v₁).mem relation ⊓ (w₂.pair v₂).mem relation)
                                (Flypitch.lattice.imp (Flypitch.bSet.bv_eq x w₂) (v₁.bv_eq v₂)))
                        x)

                        (iInf_le
                          (fun v₁ =>
                            ⨅ v₂,
                              Flypitch.lattice.imp
                                ((Flypitch.bSet.pair x v₁).mem relation ⊓ (Flypitch.bSet.pair x v₂).mem relation)

                          (fun v₂ =>
                            Flypitch.lattice.imp
                              ((Flypitch.bSet.pair x y).mem relation ⊓ (Flypitch.bSet.pair x v₂).mem relation)

                          z))));
              Flypitch.lattice.bv_context_apply (Flypitch.lattice.bv_context_apply h inf_le_right)

theorem Erdos597Object.PosetNameWitnesses.exists_total_witness : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  {context : B} (domain seed : Flypitch.bSet B),
  context ≤ seed.mem domain →
    ∀ (active : B) (predicate : Flypitch.bSet B → B),
      Flypitch.bSet.B_ext predicate →
        context ⊓ active ≤ ⨆ x, x.mem domain ⊓ predicate x →
          ∃ witness, context ≤ witness.mem domain ∧ context ⊓ active ≤ predicate witness :=

    (Flypitch.bSet.exists_convert hexists (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_inf (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_mem_left domain) hext))
    fun witness hwitness =>
    let totalPredicate := fun x => x.mem domain ⊓ Flypitch.lattice.imp active (predicate x);
    have hpositive :=
      le_iSup_of_le witness
        (le_inf (LE.le.trans hwitness inf_le_left) (LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans hwitness inf_le_right) le_sup_right));
    have hnegative :=
      le_iSup_of_le seed (le_inf (LE.le.trans inf_le_left hseed) (LE.le.trans inf_le_right le_sup_left));
    have htotal :=
      Trans.trans
        (Trans.trans
          (of_eq_true
            (Eq.trans
              (congrArg (Eq context)
                (Eq.trans (congrArg (min context) sup_compl_eq_top) (inf_of_le_left (of_eq_true le_top._simp_2))))
              (eq_self context)))
          (inf_sup_left context active activeᶜ))
        (sup_le hpositive hnegative);
    Exists.casesOn
      (Flypitch.bSet.exists_convert htotal
        (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_inf (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_mem_left domain)
          (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_imp (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_const active) hext)))
      fun chosen hchosen =>
      Exists.intro chosen
        ⟨LE.le.trans hchosen inf_le_left, Flypitch.lattice.le_imp_iff.mp (LE.le.trans hchosen inf_le_right)⟩

  (hvalid : ∀ (i : I), weight i ≤ context ∧ weight i ≤ (element i).mem domain)

  (domain relation : Flypitch.bSet B) (element : I → Flypitch.bSet B) (weight : I → B)
  (hvalid : ∀ (i : I), weight i ≤ context ∧ weight i ≤ (element i).mem domain)
  (hseparate : ∀ (i j : I), i ≠ j → weight i ⊓ weight j ⊓ (element i).bv_eq (element j) = ⊥)
  (horder : context ≤ Erdos597Object.partialOrderValue (Flypitch.V B) domain relation),
  (∀ (i : I), context ≤ (element i).mem (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weightedSet element weight)) →
    (∀ (i j : I),
        ∃ k,
          context ⊓ Erdos597Object.compatibleValue (Flypitch.V B) domain relation (element i) (element j) ≤
            Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element k) (element i) ⊓
              Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (element k) (element j)) →

          Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.compatibleValue
            (Erdos597Object.PresentedPosets.ofNames context domain relation element weight hvalid hseparate horder) i

fun {B I} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] context domain relation element weight hvalid hseparate horder hcover hcommon i
    j =>

    weight i ⊓ weight j ⊓ Erdos597Object.compatibleValue (Flypitch.V B) domain relation (element i) (element j);
  have hi := LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_left;
  have hj := LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_right;
  have hc := LE.le.trans hi (hvalid i).left;
  Exists.casesOn (hcommon i j) fun k hk =>
    have hsum :=
      Erdos597Object.HullCoefficients.covered_predicate element weight (element k)
        (fun z =>
          Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation z (element i) ⊓
            Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation z (element j))
        (Erdos597Object.BooleanAntichains.compatibleWitness_ext relation (element i) (element j))
        (LE.le.trans hc (hcover k)) (LE.le.trans (le_inf hc inf_le_right) hk);

                Erdos597Object.compatibleValue (Flypitch.V B) domain relation (element i) (element j) ≤
              _a)
          (Erdos597Object.PresentedCompatibility.ofNames_compatibility context domain relation element weight hvalid

@Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.finite_decisions : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] (values : I → B)
  (indices : Finset I), ⊤ ≤ ⨆ choice, ⨅ i ∈ indices, if choice i = true then values i else (values i)ᶜ
theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.finite_decisions : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (values : I → B) (indices : Finset I),
  ⊤ ≤ ⨆ choice, ⨅ i ∈ indices, if choice i = true then values i else (values i)ᶜ :=
fun {B I} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] values indices =>
  Finset.induction_on indices
    (of_eq_true
      (Eq.trans
        (congrArg (LE.le ⊤)
          (Eq.trans
            (congrArg iSup
              (funext fun choice =>
                Eq.trans
                  (congrArg iInf
                    (funext fun i =>
                      Eq.trans
                        (Eq.trans
                          (iInf_congr_Prop (Iff.of_eq (Finset.notMem_empty._simp_1 i)) fun x =>
                            Eq.refl (if choice i = true then values i else (values i)ᶜ))
                          (iInf_of_isEmpty fun x => if choice i = true then values i else (values i)ᶜ))
                        sInf_empty))
                  iInf_top))
            ciSup_const))
        (Std.le_refl._simp_1 ⊤)))
    fun a indices ha ih =>
    LE.le.trans ih
      (iSup_le fun choice =>
        let rest := ⨅ i ∈ indices, if choice i = true then values i else (values i)ᶜ;
        have hcase := fun b =>
          le_iSup_of_le (Function.update choice a b)
            (le_iInf fun i =>
              le_iInf fun hi =>
                Or.casesOn (Finset.mem_insert.mp hi)
                  (fun hia =>
                    Eq.ndrec (motive := fun i =>
                      i ∈ insert a indices →
                        (rest ⊓ if b = true then values a else (values a)ᶜ) ≤
                          if Function.update choice a b i = true then values i else (values i)ᶜ)
                      (fun hi =>
                        Eq.mpr
                          (id
                            (congrArg (LE.le (rest ⊓ if b = true then values a else (values a)ᶜ))
                              (ite_congr (congrFun' (congrArg Eq (Function.update_self a b choice)) true)
                                (fun a_1 => Eq.refl (values a)) fun a_1 => Eq.refl (values a)ᶜ)))
                          inf_le_right)
                      (Eq.symm hia) hi)
                  fun hi =>
                  have hia := fun h => ha (h ▸ hi);
                  Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg
                        (fun _a =>
                          (rest ⊓ if b = true then values a else (values a)ᶜ) ≤
                            if _a = true then values i else (values i)ᶜ)
                        (Function.update_of_ne hia b choice)))
                    (LE.le.trans inf_le_left
                      (LE.le.trans
                        (iInf_le (fun i => ⨅ (_ : i ∈ indices), if choice i = true then values i else (values i)ᶜ) i)
                        (iInf_le (fun h => if choice i = true then values i else (values i)ᶜ) hi))));
        LE.le.trans (Eq.le (Eq.symm sup_inf_inf_compl)) (sup_le (hcase true) (hcase false)))

theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.pair_witnesses : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (label : I → Flypitch.bSet B) (entry : Flypitch.bSet B),
  ⨆ x,
      x.mem (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.labelDomain label) ⊓
        ⨆ y, y.mem (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.labelDomain label) ⊓ entry.bv_eq (x.pair y) =
    ⨆ ij, entry.bv_eq (Erdos597Object.BooleanPosetCoding.pairLabels label ij) :=
fun {B I} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] label entry =>
  have hext :=
    Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_iSup fun y =>
      Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_inf (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_const (y.mem (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.labelDomain label)))
        (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_pair_left (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_eq_right entry) y);
  id
    (Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a => _a = ⨆ ij, entry.bv_eq (Erdos597Object.BooleanPosetCoding.pairLabels label ij))
          (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weighted_bounded_exists label (fun x => ⊤)
            (fun x => ⨆ y, y.mem (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weightedSet label fun x => ⊤) ⊓ entry.bv_eq (x.pair y))
            hext)))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrFun'
            (congrArg Eq
              (congrArg iSup
                (funext fun i =>
                  top_inf_eq
                    (⨆ y,
                      y.mem (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weightedSet label fun x => ⊤) ⊓
                        entry.bv_eq ((label i).pair y)))))
            (⨆ ij, entry.bv_eq (Erdos597Object.BooleanPosetCoding.pairLabels label ij))))
        (have inner := fun i =>
          Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun _a => _a = ⨆ j, entry.bv_eq ((label i).pair (label j)))
                (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weighted_bounded_exists label (fun x => ⊤)
                  (fun z => entry.bv_eq ((label i).pair z))
                  (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_pair_right (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_eq_right entry) (label i)))))
            (of_eq_true
              (Eq.trans
                (congrFun'
                  (congrArg Eq
                    (congrArg iSup (funext fun i_1 => top_inf_eq (entry.bv_eq ((label i).pair (label i_1))))))
                  (⨆ i_1, entry.bv_eq ((label i).pair (label i_1))))
                (eq_self (⨆ i_1, entry.bv_eq ((label i).pair (label i_1))))));
        Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrFun' (congrArg Eq (congrArg iSup (funext fun i => (fun i => inner i) i)))
              (⨆ ij, entry.bv_eq (Erdos597Object.BooleanPosetCoding.pairLabels label ij))))
          (Eq.symm iSup_prod))))

@Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.chosen_coefficients : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] (context : B)
  (label : I → Flypitch.bSet B) (relation : Flypitch.bSet B),
  context ≤ Erdos597Object.graphValue (Flypitch.V B) (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.labelDomain label) relation →
    ∀ (choice : I × I → Bool) (i j : I),
      context ⊓
            Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.decisionValue
              (fun ij => Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (label ij.1) (label ij.2)) choice ⊓
          Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (label i) (label j) =
        context ⊓
            Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.decisionValue
              (fun ij => Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (label ij.1) (label ij.2)) choice ⊓
          Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.graphCoefficient (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.chosenGraph choice)
            (i, j)
theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.chosen_coefficients : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (context : B) (label : I → Flypitch.bSet B) (relation : Flypitch.bSet B),
  context ≤ Erdos597Object.graphValue (Flypitch.V B) (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.labelDomain label) relation →
    ∀ (choice : I × I → Bool) (i j : I),
      context ⊓
            Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.decisionValue
              (fun ij => Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (label ij.1) (label ij.2)) choice ⊓
          Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (label i) (label j) =
        context ⊓
            Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.decisionValue
              (fun ij => Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (label ij.1) (label ij.2)) choice ⊓
          Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.graphCoefficient (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.chosenGraph choice)
            (i, j) :=
fun {B I} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] context label relation hgraph choice i j =>
  let values := fun ij => Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (label ij.1) (label ij.2);
  let bound := context ⊓ Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.decisionValue values choice;
  id
    (if hadj : (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.chosenGraph choice).Adj i j then
      Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => bound ⊓ values (i, j) = bound ⊓ _a) (if_pos hadj)))
        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => bound ⊓ values (i, j) = _a) (inf_top_eq bound)))
          (inf_eq_left.mpr
            (LE.le.trans inf_le_right
              (Eq.mp
                (congrArg (LE.le (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.decisionValue values choice))
                  (ite_eq_left_of_eq_true (values (i, j)) (values (i, j))ᶜ
                    (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg Eq hadj.right.left) true) (eq_self true))))
                (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.decision_le values choice (i, j))))))
    else
      Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => bound ⊓ values (i, j) = bound ⊓ _a) (if_neg hadj)))
        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => bound ⊓ values (i, j) = _a) (inf_bot_eq bound)))
          (bot_unique
            (let part := bound ⊓ values (i, j);
            have hc := LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_left;
            have hd := LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_right;
            have he := inf_le_right;
            if hij : i = j then
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun j =>
                ¬(Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.chosenGraph choice).Adj i j →
                  let part := bound ⊓ values (i, j);
                  part ≤ context →
                    part ≤ Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.decisionValue values choice →
                      part ≤ values (i, j) → bound ⊓ values (i, j) ≤ ⊥)
                (fun hadj =>
                  let part := bound ⊓ values (i, i);
                  fun hc hd he =>
                  LE.le.trans
                    (le_inf he
                      (LE.le.trans hc
                        (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.graph_loopless context label relation hgraph i)))
                    (Eq.mpr (id (congrFun' (congrArg LE.le inf_compl_eq_bot) ⊥)) le_rfl))

  (predicate : Flypitch.bSet B → B),

    ⨅ x, Flypitch.lattice.imp (x.mem Flypitch.bSet.omega) (predicate x) = ⨅ n, predicate (Flypitch.bSet.ofNat n) :=

      le_iInf fun host =>

            le_iInf fun redOrder =>
              Flypitch.lattice.bv_imp_intro
                (let context :=
                  Erdos597Object.finitePartitionValue (Flypitch.V B) Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.squareDomain
                      Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockDomain Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.squareOrder

                    (Erdos597Object.omegaOneValue (Flypitch.V B) kappa ⊓
                      (Erdos597Object.cartesianProductValue (Flypitch.V B) kappa kappa host ⊓

                          (Erdos597Object.lexOrderValue (Flypitch.V B) host hostOrder ⊓
                            Erdos597Object.lexOrderValue (Flypitch.V B) redDomain redOrder))));
                id
                  (have hk := LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_left) (hUnique kappa);

                      (Erdos597Object.CanonicalRelations.cartesianProduct_eq kappa kappa host);

                  have hh :=

                        Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockDomain);

                    Erdos597Object.CanonicalRelations.lexOrder_eq_name Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.squareLabel
                      hostOrder hho;

                    Erdos597Object.CanonicalRelations.lexOrder_eq_name Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockLabel

theorem Erdos597Object.FiniteCliqueReduction.graphName_mono : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (label : I → Flypitch.bSet B) (left right : SimpleGraph I),
  left ≤ right →
    ⊤ ≤
      (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.graphName label left).subset
        (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.graphName label right) :=
fun {B I} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] label left right hgraphs =>
  Erdos597Object.FiniteCliqueReduction.relationName_mono label
    (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.graphCoefficient left)
    (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.graphCoefficient right) fun ij =>
    if h : left.Adj ij.1 ij.2 then
      have hright := hgraphs h;
      of_eq_true
        (Eq.trans
          (congr (congrArg LE.le (ite_eq_left_of_eq_true ⊤ ⊥ (eq_true h)))
            (ite_eq_left_of_eq_true ⊤ ⊥ (eq_true hright)))
          (Std.le_refl._simp_1 ⊤))
    else
      of_eq_true
        (Eq.trans
          (congrFun' (congrArg LE.le (ite_eq_right_of_eq_false ⊤ ⊥ (eq_false h)))
            (if right.Adj ij.1 ij.2 then ⊤ else ⊥))
          bot_le._simp_1)

  [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B],
  Flypitch.BA_CCC B →

      context ≠ ⊥ →
        ∀ (label : I → Flypitch.bSet B),
          (∀ (i j : I), i ≠ j → context ⊓ (label i).bv_eq (label j) = ⊥) →

              (∀ (i : I), context ≤ (label i).mem domain) →

theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanLocalGraphs.countable_of_contextually_injected : ∀ {B I : Type}
  [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B],
  Flypitch.BA_CCC B →
    ∀ (context : B),
      context ≠ ⊥ →
        ∀ (label : I → Flypitch.bSet B),
          (∀ (i j : I), i ≠ j → context ⊓ (label i).bv_eq (label j) = ⊥) →
            ∀ (domain : Flypitch.bSet B),
              (∀ (i : I), context ≤ (label i).mem domain) →
                context ≤ Erdos597Object.injectsIntoValue (Flypitch.V B) domain Flypitch.bSet.omega → Countable I :=
fun {B I} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] hB context hne label hdiscrete domain hmembers hinjects =>
  have hseparate :=
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (forall_congr fun i =>
          forall_congr fun j =>
            implies_congr (Eq.refl (i ≠ j))
              (congrFun' (congrArg Eq (congrFun' (congrArg min (inf_idem context)) ((label i).bv_eq (label j)))) ⊥)))
      hdiscrete;
  have hcover :=

theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanLocalGraphs.subsetName_independent : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (context : B) (label : I → Flypitch.bSet B) (indices : Set I) (relation : Flypitch.bSet B),
  (indices.Pairwise fun i j => context ⊓ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (label i) (label j) = ⊥) →
    context ≤
      Erdos597Object.BooleanLocalGraphs.independentValue
        (Erdos597Object.BooleanLocalGraphs.subsetName context label indices) relation :=
fun {B I} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] context label indices relation hnone =>
  let body := fun x y => x.bv_eq y ⊔ (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation x y)ᶜ;
  have hleft := fun y =>
    Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_sup (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_eq_left y)
      (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_compl (Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.edge_left_ext relation y));
  have hright := fun x =>
    Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_sup (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_eq_right x)
      (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_compl (Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.edge_right_ext relation x));
  id
    (id
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a => context ≤ _a)
            (Erdos597Object.BooleanPosetModel.weighted_forall_two (fun i => label ↑i) (fun x => context) body hleft
              hright)))
        (le_iInf fun i =>
          Flypitch.lattice.bv_imp_intro
            (le_iInf fun j =>
              Flypitch.lattice.bv_imp_intro
                (id
                  (if hij : ↑i = ↑j then
                    Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congrArg
                          (fun _a =>
                            context ⊓ context ⊓ context ≤
                              (label _a).bv_eq (label ↑j) ⊔
                                (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (label _a) (label ↑j))ᶜ)
                          hij))
                      (le_sup_of_le_left Flypitch.bSet.bv_refl)
                  else
                    have hred :=
                      Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a) (propext le_compl_iff_disjoint_right)))
                        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a) (propext disjoint_iff)))
                          (hnone i.property j.property hij));
                    LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_left) hred) le_sup_right))))))

theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanCountableNames.weighted_countable : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  [Countable I] (label : I → Flypitch.bSet B),
  (∀ (i j : I), i ≠ j → (label i).bv_eq (label j) = ⊥) →
    ∀ (weight : I → B),
      ⊤ ≤
        Erdos597Object.injectsIntoValue (Flypitch.V B) (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weightedSet label weight)
          Flypitch.bSet.omega :=
fun {B I} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] [Countable I] label hdiscrete weight =>
  let encode := Classical.choose (exists_injective_nat I);
  have hinjective := Classical.choose_spec (exists_injective_nat I);
  let index := fun i => { down := encode i };
  have hext := fun i j {part} heq =>
    if hij : i = j then
      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun j =>
        part ≤ (label i).bv_eq (label j) →
          part ≤ (Flypitch.bSet.ofNat (encode i)).bv_eq (Flypitch.bSet.ofNat (encode j)))
        (fun heq => Flypitch.bSet.bv_refl) hij heq

    if hij : i = j then
      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun j =>
        part ≤ (Flypitch.bSet.ofNat (encode i)).bv_eq (Flypitch.bSet.ofNat (encode j)) →
          part ≤ (label i).bv_eq (label j))
        (fun heq => Flypitch.bSet.bv_refl) hij heq
    else
      have hcode := fun h => hij (hinjective h);
      LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans_eq heq (Flypitch.bSet.ofNat_inj hcode)) bot_le;

    (id
      (congrArg (fun _a => ⊤ ≤ _a)
        (Erdos597Object.BooleanFunctionBridge.injectsInto_eq_injects_into
          (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weightedSet label weight) Flypitch.bSet.omega)))
    (Flypitch.bSet.injects_into_of_injection_into
      (le_iSup_of_le (Flypitch.bSet.function.mk' index fun x => ⊤)
        (le_inf (Flypitch.bSet.function.mk'_is_function index (fun x => ⊤) hext fun x x_1 x_2 => ⟨le_top, le_top⟩)
          (Flypitch.bSet.function.mk'_is_inj index (fun x => ⊤) hinj))))

theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanCountableNames.uncountable_member_outside_countable : ∀ {B : Type}
  [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] (context : B) (domain small : Flypitch.bSet B),
  context ≤ (Erdos597Object.injectsIntoValue (Flypitch.V B) domain Flypitch.bSet.omega)ᶜ →
    context ≤ Erdos597Object.injectsIntoValue (Flypitch.V B) small Flypitch.bSet.omega →
      ∃ name, context ≤ name.mem domain ⊓ (name.mem small)ᶜ :=

  let outside := ⨆ name, name.mem domain ⊓ (name.mem small)ᶜ;
  have hsubset :=
    Flypitch.bSet.subset_unfold'.mpr
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrFun'
            (congrArg LE.le
              (Eq.trans compl_iSup
                (congrArg iInf
                  (funext fun i => Eq.trans compl_inf (congrArg (max (i.mem domain)ᶜ) (compl_compl (i.mem small)))))))
            (⨅ i, (i.mem domain)ᶜ ⊔ i.mem small)))

          (congr
            (congrArg LE.le
              (Eq.trans compl_iSup
                (congrArg iInf
                  (funext fun i => Eq.trans compl_inf (congrArg (max (i.mem domain)ᶜ) (compl_compl (i.mem small)))))))
            (Eq.trans compl_iSup
              (congrArg iInf
                (funext fun i => Eq.trans compl_inf (congrArg (max (i.mem domain)ᶜ) (compl_compl (i.mem small)))))))
          le_rfl));
  have hbot :=
    have hinjects :=
      Erdos597Object.BooleanCountableNames.subset_countable domain small (LE.le.trans inf_le_right hsubset)
        (LE.le.trans inf_le_left hsmall);
    LE.le.trans_eq (le_inf hinjects (LE.le.trans inf_le_left hlarge)) inf_compl_eq_bot;
  have houtside :=
    have h := le_compl_iff_disjoint_right.mpr (disjoint_iff.mpr (le_antisymm hbot bot_le));

    (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_inf (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_mem_left domain)
      (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_compl (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_mem_left small)))

theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanGraphNeighborhoods.graph_symmetry : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (context : B) (ambient relation x y : Flypitch.bSet B),
  context ≤ Erdos597Object.graphValue (Flypitch.V B) ambient relation →
    context ≤ x.mem ambient →
      context ≤ y.mem ambient →
        context ⊓ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation x y ≤
          Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation y x :=
fun {B} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] context ambient relation x y hgraph hx hy =>
  have hsym := LE.le.trans hgraph (LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_right);
  have hleft :=
    Flypitch.lattice.bv_context_apply
      (LE.le.trans hsym
        (iInf_le
          (fun x =>
            (Erdos597Object.memberValue (Flypitch.V B) x ambient)ᶜ ⊔
              ⨅ y,
                (Erdos597Object.memberValue (Flypitch.V B) y ambient)ᶜ ⊔

theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanGraphMaps.map_singleValued : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (context : B) (input output : I → Flypitch.bSet B),
  (∀ (i j : I), i ≠ j → context ⊓ (input i).bv_eq (input j) = ⊥) →
    context ≤ Erdos597Object.singleValuedValue (Flypitch.V B) (Erdos597Object.BooleanGraphMaps.mapName input output) :=
