  le_iInf fun x =>
    le_iInf fun y =>
      le_iInf fun z =>
        Flypitch.lattice.bv_imp_intro
          (Erdos597Object.BooleanGraphMaps.map_pair_cases input output
            (context ⊓
              (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) (Erdos597Object.BooleanGraphMaps.mapName input output) x y ⊓
                Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) (Erdos597Object.BooleanGraphMaps.mapName input output) x z))
            ((Flypitch.V B).eq y z) x y x z (LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_left)
            (LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_right) fun i j =>
            let part :=
              context ⊓
                    (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) (Erdos597Object.BooleanGraphMaps.mapName input output) x
                        y ⊓
                      Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) (Erdos597Object.BooleanGraphMaps.mapName input output) x
                        z) ⊓
                  (Flypitch.bSet.bv_eq x (input i) ⊓ Flypitch.bSet.bv_eq y (output i)) ⊓
                (Flypitch.bSet.bv_eq x (input j) ⊓ Flypitch.bSet.bv_eq z (output j));
            id
              (have hx := LE.le.trans inf_le_left (LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_left);
              have hy := LE.le.trans inf_le_left (LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_right);
              have hx' := LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_left;
              have hz := LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_right;

                    let part :=
                      context ⊓
                            (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B)
                                (Erdos597Object.BooleanGraphMaps.mapName input output) x y ⊓
                              Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B)

                          (Flypitch.bSet.bv_eq x (input i) ⊓ Flypitch.bSet.bv_eq y (output i)) ⊓
                        (Flypitch.bSet.bv_eq x (input i) ⊓ Flypitch.bSet.bv_eq z (output i));

theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanGraphMaps.map_preserves : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] (context : B)
  (input output : I → Flypitch.bSet B) (source target : Flypitch.bSet B),
  (∀ (i j : I),
      context ⊓ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) source (input i) (input j) ≤
        Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) target (output i) (output j)) →
    context ≤
      Erdos597Object.preservesRelationValue (Flypitch.V B) source target
        (Erdos597Object.BooleanGraphMaps.mapName input output) :=
fun {B I} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] context input output source target hpreserves =>
  le_iInf fun x =>
    le_iInf fun y =>
      le_iInf fun a =>
        le_iInf fun b =>
          Flypitch.lattice.bv_imp_intro
            (Flypitch.lattice.bv_imp_intro
              (Erdos597Object.BooleanGraphMaps.map_pair_cases input output
                (context ⊓
                    (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) (Erdos597Object.BooleanGraphMaps.mapName input output) x
                        a ⊓
                      Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) (Erdos597Object.BooleanGraphMaps.mapName input output) y
                        b) ⊓
                  Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) source x y)
                (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) target a b) x a y b
                (LE.le.trans inf_le_left (LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_left))
                (LE.le.trans inf_le_left (LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_right)) fun i j =>
                let base :=
                  context ⊓
                      (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) (Erdos597Object.BooleanGraphMaps.mapName input output) x
                          a ⊓
                        Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) (Erdos597Object.BooleanGraphMaps.mapName input output) y
                          b) ⊓
                    Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) source x y;
                let part :=
                  base ⊓ (Flypitch.bSet.bv_eq x (input i) ⊓ Flypitch.bSet.bv_eq a (output i)) ⊓
                    (Flypitch.bSet.bv_eq y (input j) ⊓ Flypitch.bSet.bv_eq b (output j));
                id
                  (have hbase := LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_left;
                  have hx := LE.le.trans inf_le_left (LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_left);
                  have ha := LE.le.trans inf_le_left (LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_right);
                  have hy := LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_left;
                  have hb := LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_right;
                  have hsource :=
                    Flypitch.bSet.subst_congr_mem_left' (Flypitch.bSet.pair_congr hx hy)
                      (LE.le.trans hbase inf_le_right);
                  have htarget :=
                    LE.le.trans (le_inf (LE.le.trans hbase (LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_left)) hsource)
                      (hpreserves i j);
                  Flypitch.bSet.subst_congr_mem_left'
                    (Flypitch.bSet.pair_congr (Flypitch.bSet.bv_symm ha) (Flypitch.bSet.bv_symm hb)) htarget)))

@Erdos597Object.BooleanCliqueCopies.cliqueMap_to_blueCopy : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] (context : B)
  (ambient domain relation : Flypitch.bSet B) (n : ℕ),
  context ≤ domain.subset ambient →
    context ≤ Erdos597Object.graphValue (Flypitch.V B) ambient relation →
      context ⊓ Erdos597Object.BooleanUncountableRamsey.cliqueMapValue domain relation n ≤
        Erdos597Object.blueCopyValue (Flypitch.V B) (Flypitch.bSet.ofNat n) ambient
          (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.graphName Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.naturalLabel ⊤) relation
theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanCliqueCopies.cliqueMap_to_blueCopy : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (context : B) (ambient domain relation : Flypitch.bSet B) (n : ℕ),
  context ≤ domain.subset ambient →
    context ≤ Erdos597Object.graphValue (Flypitch.V B) ambient relation →
      context ⊓ Erdos597Object.BooleanUncountableRamsey.cliqueMapValue domain relation n ≤
        Erdos597Object.blueCopyValue (Flypitch.V B) (Flypitch.bSet.ofNat n) ambient
          (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.graphName Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.naturalLabel ⊤) relation :=
fun {B} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] context ambient domain relation n hsubset hgraph =>
  id
    (Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg
          (fun _a =>
            _a ≤
              Erdos597Object.blueCopyValue (Flypitch.V B) (Flypitch.bSet.ofNat n) ambient
                (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.graphName Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.naturalLabel ⊤)
                relation)
          (inf_iSup_eq context fun names =>
            (⨅ i, (names i).mem domain) ⊓
              ⨅ i, ⨅ j, ⨅ (_ : i ≠ j), Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (names i) (names j))))
      (iSup_le fun names =>
        let part :=
          context ⊓
            ((⨅ i, (names i).mem domain) ⊓
              ⨅ i, ⨅ j, ⨅ (_ : i ≠ j), Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (names i) (names j));
        id
          (have hdomain := fun i =>
            LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_left) (iInf_le (fun i => (names i).mem domain) i);
          have hmembers := fun i => Flypitch.bSet.mem_of_mem_subset' (LE.le.trans inf_le_left hsubset) (hdomain i);
          have hedges := fun i j hij =>
            LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_right)
              (LE.le.trans
                (iInf_le
                  (fun i => ⨅ j, ⨅ (_ : i ≠ j), Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (names i) (names j)) i)
                (LE.le.trans
                  (iInf_le
                    (fun j => ⨅ (_ : i ≠ j), Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (names i) (names j)) j)
                  (iInf_le (fun x => Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (names i) (names j)) hij)));
          have houtput := fun i j hij =>
            have hloop :=
              Erdos597Object.BooleanCliqueCopies.graph_irreflexive part ambient relation (names i)
                (LE.le.trans inf_le_left hgraph) (hmembers i);
            have hedge :=
              LE.le.trans (le_inf (Flypitch.bSet.bv_symm inf_le_right) (LE.le.trans inf_le_left (hedges i j hij)))
                (Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.edge_right_ext relation (names i) (names j) (names i));
            bot_unique (LE.le.trans_eq (le_inf hedge (LE.le.trans inf_le_left hloop)) inf_compl_eq_bot);
          have hinput := fun i j hij =>
            Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg (fun _a => part ⊓ _a = ⊥) (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.naturalLabel_discrete i j hij)))
              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = ⊥) (inf_bot_eq part))) (Eq.refl ⊥));
          have hpreserves := fun i j =>
            if hij : i = j then
              hij ▸
                Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg
                      (fun _a => part ⊓ _a ≤ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (names i) (names i))
                      (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.natural_graph_edge ⊤ i i)))
                  (of_eq_true
                    (Eq.trans
                      (congrFun'
                        (congrArg LE.le
                          (Eq.trans (congrArg (min part) (ite_eq_right_of_eq_false ⊤ ⊥ (SimpleGraph.irrefl._simp_1 ⊤)))
                            (inf_of_le_right (of_eq_true bot_le._simp_1))))
                        (((names i).pair (names i)).mem relation))
                      bot_le._simp_1))
            else LE.le.trans inf_le_left (hedges i j hij);
          have hcopy :=
            le_iSup_of_le
              (Erdos597Object.BooleanGraphMaps.mapName Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.naturalLabel names)
              (le_inf
                (Erdos597Object.BooleanGraphMaps.map_function part Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.naturalLabel names
                  ambient hinput hmembers)
                (le_inf
                  (Erdos597Object.BooleanGraphMaps.map_injective part Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.naturalLabel
                    names houtput)
                  (Erdos597Object.BooleanGraphMaps.map_preserves part Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.naturalLabel
                    names
                    (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.graphName Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.naturalLabel ⊤)
                    relation hpreserves)));
          LE.le.trans
            (le_inf (LE.le.trans le_top (Flypitch.bSet.bv_symm (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.natural_domain n)))
              hcopy)
            (Erdos597Object.FinitePartitionReduction.blueCopy_vertices_ext ambient
              (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.graphName Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.naturalLabel ⊤) relation
              (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.labelDomain Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.naturalLabel)
              (Flypitch.bSet.ofNat n)))))

@Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseyTree.infinite_inf_const : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] (weight : ℕ → B)
  (value : B),
  (Erdos597Object.BooleanInfiniteSets.infiniteValue fun n => weight n ⊓ value) =
    Erdos597Object.BooleanInfiniteSets.infiniteValue weight ⊓ value
theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseyTree.infinite_inf_const : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (weight : ℕ → B) (value : B),
  (Erdos597Object.BooleanInfiniteSets.infiniteValue fun n => weight n ⊓ value) =
    Erdos597Object.BooleanInfiniteSets.infiniteValue weight ⊓ value :=

  have htail := fun bound =>
    id
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a => ⨆ n, ⨆ (_ : bound ≤ n), (fun n => weight n ⊓ value) n = _a)
            (iSup_inf_eq (fun n => ⨆ (_ : bound ≤ n), weight n) value)))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrFun'
              (congrArg Eq
                (congrArg iSup
                  (funext fun n =>
                    iSup_congr_Prop (Iff.of_eq (Eq.refl (bound ≤ n))) fun x => Eq.refl (weight n ⊓ value))))
              (⨆ i, (⨆ (_ : bound ≤ i), weight i) ⊓ value)))
          (of_eq_true
            (Eq.trans
              (congrArg (Eq (⨆ n, ⨆ (_ : bound ≤ n), weight n ⊓ value))
                (congrArg iSup (funext fun i => iSup_inf_eq (fun i_1 => weight i) value)))
              (eq_self (⨆ n, ⨆ (_ : bound ≤ n), weight n ⊓ value))))));

        ((⨅ x, Erdos597Object.BooleanInfiniteSets.tailValue weight x) ⊓ value))
      (eq_self ((⨅ x, Erdos597Object.BooleanInfiniteSets.tailValue weight x) ⊓ value)))

  (color : Finset ℕ → B) (points : Finset ℕ) (current : ℕ → B) (choice : Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseyTree.Choice)

@Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseyTree.step_point_extension : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] (arity : ℕ)

        (Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseyTree.stepWeight arity color points current (next, marked))
theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseyTree.step_point_extension : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (arity : ℕ) (color : Finset ℕ → B) (points : Finset ℕ) (current : ℕ → B) (next : ℕ),
  Erdos597Object.BooleanInfiniteSets.infiniteValue current ⊓ current next ≤
    ⨆ marked,
      Erdos597Object.BooleanInfiniteSets.infiniteValue
        (Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseyTree.stepWeight arity color points current (next, marked)) :=
fun {B} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] arity color points current next =>
  let base := Erdos597Object.BooleanInfiniteSets.fromWeight (fun n => current n ⊓ current next) (next + 1);
  have hbase :=
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a => _a = Erdos597Object.BooleanInfiniteSets.infiniteValue current ⊓ current next)
          (Erdos597Object.BooleanInfiniteSets.infinite_from (fun n => current n ⊓ current next) (next + 1))))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a => _a = Erdos597Object.BooleanInfiniteSets.infiniteValue current ⊓ current next)
            (Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseyTree.infinite_inf_const current (current next))))
        (Eq.refl (Erdos597Object.BooleanInfiniteSets.infiniteValue current ⊓ current next)));
  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrArg
        (fun _a =>
          _a ≤
            ⨆ marked,
              Erdos597Object.BooleanInfiniteSets.infiniteValue
                (Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseyTree.stepWeight arity color points current (next, marked)))
        (Eq.symm hbase)))
    (LE.le.trans
      (Erdos597Object.BooleanInfiniteSets.finite_decisions base (fun s n => color (insert n s))
        (Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseyTree.constraints arity points next))
      (iSup_le fun choice =>
        let marked := {s ∈ Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseyTree.constraints arity points next | choice s = true};
        le_iSup_of_le marked
          (Erdos597Object.BooleanInfiniteSets.infinite_mono fun n =>
            le_inf inf_le_left
              (le_iInf fun s =>
                le_iInf fun hs =>
                  have hchoice :=
                    Bool.casesOn (motive := fun t => choice s = t → decide (s ∈ marked) = choice s) (choice s)
                      (fun h =>
                        Eq.ndrec (motive := fun x => choice s = x → decide (s ∈ marked) = x)
                          (fun hc =>
                            of_eq_true
                              (Eq.trans
                                (congrFun'
                                  (congrArg Eq
                                    (Eq.trans
                                      (Decidable.decide.congr_simp (s ∈ marked) False
                                        (Eq.trans Finset.mem_filter._simp_1
                                          (Eq.trans
                                            (congr (congrArg And (eq_true hs))
                                              (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg Eq hc) true) Bool.false_eq_true))
                                            (and_false True))))
                                      (decide_false instDecidableFalse)))
                                  false)
                                (eq_self false)))
                          (Eq.symm h) (Eq.refl (choice s)))
                      (fun h =>
                        Eq.ndrec (motive := fun x => choice s = x → decide (s ∈ marked) = x)
                          (fun hc =>
                            of_eq_true
                              (Eq.trans
                                (congrFun'
                                  (congrArg Eq
                                    (Eq.trans
                                      (Decidable.decide.congr_simp (s ∈ marked) True
                                        (Eq.trans Finset.mem_filter._simp_1
                                          (Eq.trans
                                            (congr (congrArg And (eq_true hs))
                                              (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg Eq hc) true) (eq_self true)))
                                            (and_self True))))
                                      (decide_true instDecidableTrue)))
                                  true)
                                (eq_self true)))
                          (Eq.symm h) (Eq.refl (choice s)))
                      (Eq.refl (choice s));
                  id
                    (Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congrArg
                          (fun _a =>
                            (base n ⊓
                                ⨅ i ∈ Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseyTree.constraints arity points next,
                                  if choice i = true then (fun s n => color (insert n s)) i n
                                  else ((fun s n => color (insert n s)) i n)ᶜ) ≤
                              if _a = true then color (insert n s) else (color (insert n s))ᶜ)
                          hchoice))
                      (LE.le.trans inf_le_right
                        (LE.le.trans
                          (iInf_le
                            (fun i =>
                              ⨅ (_ : i ∈ Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseyTree.constraints arity points next),
                                if choice i = true then (fun s n => color (insert n s)) i n
                                else ((fun s n => color (insert n s)) i n)ᶜ)
                            s)
                          (iInf_le
                            (fun h =>
                              if choice s = true then (fun s n => color (insert n s)) s n
                              else ((fun s n => color (insert n s)) s n)ᶜ)
                            hs))))))))

  Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteRamsey.Homogeneous context 0 color initial (color ∅) :=

  have hempty := Finset.card_eq_zero.mp hcard;
  Eq.ndrec (motive := fun subset =>
    subset.card = 0 →
      context ⊓ (subset.inf initial ⊓ color ∅) ≤ color subset ∧
        context ⊓ (subset.inf initial ⊓ (color ∅)ᶜ) ≤ (color subset)ᶜ)

            (congrArg And

@Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteRamsey.lift_homogeneous : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] (context : B)
  (arity : ℕ) (color : Finset ℕ → B) (initial : ℕ → B) (filter : Flypitch.bSet B),

      Erdos597Object.orderFilterValue (Flypitch.V B)

            Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteRamsey.Homogeneous context (arity + 1) color selected side
theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteRamsey.lift_homogeneous : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (context : B) (arity : ℕ) (color : Finset ℕ → B) (initial : ℕ → B) (filter : Flypitch.bSet B),
  context ≤
      Erdos597Object.orderFilterValue (Flypitch.V B)
        (Erdos597Object.BooleanPosetCoding.domainName (Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseyForcing.forcing arity color initial)
          Erdos597Object.BooleanPosetCoding.checkLabel)
        (Erdos597Object.BooleanPosetCoding.orderName (Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseyForcing.forcing arity color initial)
          Erdos597Object.BooleanPosetCoding.checkLabel)
        filter →
    0 < arity →
      ∀ (selected : ℕ → B) (side : B),
        (∀ (n : ℕ), selected n ≤ Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseySelection.selectedWeight arity color initial filter n) →
          Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteRamsey.Homogeneous context arity
              (Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseyRecorded.recordedValue arity color initial filter) selected side →
            Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteRamsey.Homogeneous context (arity + 1) color selected side :=
fun {B} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] context arity color initial filter hfilter hpositive selected side hsub hhomogeneous
    subset hcard =>
  have hnonempty :=
    Finset.card_pos.mp
      (Decidable.byContradiction fun a =>
        Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteRamsey.lift_homogeneous._proof_1_1 arity hpositive subset hcard a);
  let n := subset.max' hnonempty;
  let earlier := subset.erase n;
  have hn := Finset.max'_mem subset hnonempty;
  have hinsert := Finset.insert_erase hn;
  have hearlier :=
    id
      (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = arity) (Finset.card_erase_of_mem hn)))
        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a - 1 = arity) hcard))
          (Decidable.byContradiction fun a =>
            Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteRamsey.lift_homogeneous._proof_1_2 arity hpositive subset hcard a)));
  have hbefore := fun x hx =>
    have hx' := Finset.mem_erase.mp hx;
    lt_of_le_of_ne (Finset.le_max' subset x hx'.right) hx'.left;
  have hselected := Finset.le_inf fun x hx => LE.le.trans (Finset.inf_le hx) (hsub x);
  have hdrop := Finset.le_inf fun x hx => Finset.inf_le (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hx);
  And.casesOn (hhomogeneous earlier hearlier) fun htrue hfalse =>
    have htrueRule :=
      Eq.mp
        (congr
          (congrArg LE.le
            (congrArg (min context)
              (congrFun'
                (congrArg min
                  (congrFun' (congrArg Finset.inf hinsert)
                    (Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseySelection.selectedWeight arity color initial filter)))
                (Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseyRecorded.recordedValue arity color initial filter earlier))))
          (congrArg color hinsert))
        (Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseyEndHomogeneous.selected_true context arity color initial filter hfilter hpositive
          earlier n hearlier hbefore);
    have hfalseRule :=
      Eq.mp
        (congr
          (congrArg LE.le
            (congrArg (min context)
              (congrFun'
                (congrArg min
                  (congrFun' (congrArg Finset.inf hinsert)
                    (Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseySelection.selectedWeight arity color initial filter)))
                (Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseyRecorded.recordedValue arity color initial filter earlier)ᶜ)))
          (congrArg compl (congrArg color hinsert)))
        (Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseyEndHomogeneous.selected_false context arity color initial filter hfilter hpositive
          earlier n hearlier hbefore);
    ⟨LE.le.trans
        (le_inf inf_le_left
          (le_inf (LE.le.trans inf_le_right (LE.le.trans inf_le_left hselected))
            (LE.le.trans
              (le_inf inf_le_left
                (le_inf (LE.le.trans inf_le_right (LE.le.trans inf_le_left hdrop))
                  (LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_right)))
              htrue)))
        htrueRule,
      LE.le.trans
        (le_inf inf_le_left
          (le_inf (LE.le.trans inf_le_right (LE.le.trans inf_le_left hselected))
            (LE.le.trans
              (le_inf inf_le_left
                (le_inf (LE.le.trans inf_le_right (LE.le.trans inf_le_left hdrop))
                  (LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_right)))
              hfalse)))
        hfalseRule⟩
'Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteRamsey.lift_homogeneous' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteRamsey.exists_homogeneous : ∀
  (context : Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.finalAlgebra.Carrier) (arity : ℕ)
  (color : Finset ℕ → Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.finalAlgebra.Carrier)
  (initial : ℕ → Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.finalAlgebra.Carrier),
  context ≤ Erdos597Object.BooleanInfiniteSets.infiniteValue initial →
    ∃ selected side,
      (∀ (n : ℕ), selected n ≤ initial n) ∧
        context ≤ Erdos597Object.BooleanInfiniteSets.infiniteValue selected ∧
          Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteRamsey.Homogeneous context arity color selected side
theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteRamsey.exists_homogeneous : ∀
  (context : Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.finalAlgebra.Carrier) (arity : ℕ)
  (color : Finset ℕ → Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.finalAlgebra.Carrier)
  (initial : ℕ → Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.finalAlgebra.Carrier),
  context ≤ Erdos597Object.BooleanInfiniteSets.infiniteValue initial →
    ∃ selected side,
      (∀ (n : ℕ), selected n ≤ initial n) ∧
        context ≤ Erdos597Object.BooleanInfiniteSets.infiniteValue selected ∧
          Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteRamsey.Homogeneous context arity color selected side :=
fun context arity color initial hinfinite =>
  Nat.recAux (motive := fun arity =>
    ∀ (context : Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.finalAlgebra.Carrier)
      (color : Finset ℕ → Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.finalAlgebra.Carrier)
      (initial : ℕ → Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.finalAlgebra.Carrier),
      context ≤ Erdos597Object.BooleanInfiniteSets.infiniteValue initial →
        ∃ selected side,
          (∀ (n : ℕ), selected n ≤ initial n) ∧
            context ≤ Erdos597Object.BooleanInfiniteSets.infiniteValue selected ∧
              Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteRamsey.Homogeneous context arity color selected side)
    (fun context color initial hinfinite =>
      Exists.intro initial
        (Exists.intro (color ∅)
          ⟨fun x => le_rfl, ⟨hinfinite, Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteRamsey.zero_homogeneous context color initial⟩⟩))
    (fun arity ih context color initial hinfinite =>
      if hzero : arity = 0 then
        Eq.ndrec (motive := fun arity =>
          (∀ (context : Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.finalAlgebra.Carrier)
              (color : Finset ℕ → Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.finalAlgebra.Carrier)
              (initial : ℕ → Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.finalAlgebra.Carrier),
              context ≤ Erdos597Object.BooleanInfiniteSets.infiniteValue initial →
                ∃ selected side,
                  (∀ (n : ℕ), selected n ≤ initial n) ∧
                    context ≤ Erdos597Object.BooleanInfiniteSets.infiniteValue selected ∧
                      Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteRamsey.Homogeneous context arity color selected side) →
            ∃ selected side,
              (∀ (n : ℕ), selected n ≤ initial n) ∧
                context ≤ Erdos597Object.BooleanInfiniteSets.infiniteValue selected ∧
                  Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteRamsey.Homogeneous context (arity + 1) color selected side)
          (fun ih => Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteRamsey.exists_one context color initial hinfinite) (Eq.symm hzero) ih
      else
        have hpositive := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hzero;
        Exists.casesOn (Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseySelection.selection_exists context arity color initial hinfinite)
          fun filter h =>
          And.casesOn h fun hfilter right =>
            And.casesOn right fun hselected hinfiniteSelected =>
              Exists.casesOn
                (ih context (Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseyRecorded.recordedValue arity color initial filter)
                  (Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseySelection.selectedWeight arity color initial filter) hinfiniteSelected)
                fun selected h =>
                Exists.casesOn h fun side h =>
                  And.casesOn h fun hsub right =>
                    And.casesOn right fun hinfiniteFinal hhomogeneous =>
                      Exists.intro selected
                        (Exists.intro side
                          ⟨fun n => LE.le.trans (hsub n) (hselected n),
                            ⟨hinfiniteFinal,
                              Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteRamsey.lift_homogeneous context arity color initial filter
                                hfilter hpositive selected side hsub hhomogeneous⟩⟩))
    arity context color initial hinfinite

              ⨅ smallRight,
                (Erdos597Object.BooleanRectangles.largeSubset right smallRight)ᶜ ⊔

            ⨅ smallRight,

                Erdos597Object.BooleanRectangles.rectangleEdge relation smallLeft smallRight)))

          ∃ smallRight,

              context ≤ Erdos597Object.BooleanPairDecisions.decisions relation left smallRight indices)

      Flypitch.lattice.context_or_elim' (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => context ≤ _a) sup_compl_eq_top)) le_top)

          (Erdos597Object.BooleanPairDecisions.decisions_ext relation left (insert i indices))))

theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanCountableRectangles.subsetName_empty_rectangle : ∀ {B I J : Type}
  [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] (context : B) (relation : Flypitch.bSet B) (leftNames : I → Flypitch.bSet B)
  (rightNames : J → Flypitch.bSet B) (leftIndices : Set I) (rightIndices : Set J),
  (∀ i ∈ leftIndices,
      ∀ j ∈ rightIndices, context ⊓ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (leftNames i) (rightNames j) = ⊥) →
    context ≤
      Erdos597Object.BooleanRectangles.emptyRectangle relation
        (Erdos597Object.BooleanLocalGraphs.subsetName context leftNames leftIndices)
        (Erdos597Object.BooleanLocalGraphs.subsetName context rightNames rightIndices) :=

  Eq.mpr

      (congrArg (fun _a => context ≤ _a)
        (Erdos597Object.BooleanRectangles.emptyRectangle_spec relation
          (Erdos597Object.BooleanLocalGraphs.subsetName context leftNames leftIndices)
          (Erdos597Object.BooleanLocalGraphs.subsetName context rightNames rightIndices))))
    (id
      (Eq.mpr

          (congrArg (fun _a => context ≤ _a)
            (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weighted_bounded_forall (fun i => leftNames ↑i) (fun x => context)
              (fun x =>
                ⨅ i,
                  Flypitch.lattice.imp
                    (i.mem (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weightedSet (fun i => rightNames ↑i) fun x => context))
                    (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation x i)ᶜ)

                Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_imp
                  (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_const
                    (y.mem (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weightedSet (fun i => rightNames ↑i) fun x => context)))
                  (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_compl (Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.edge_left_ext relation y))))))
        (le_iInf fun i =>
          Flypitch.lattice.bv_imp_intro
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg (fun _a => context ⊓ context ≤ _a)
                  (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weighted_bounded_forall (fun i => rightNames ↑i) (fun x => context)
                    (fun x => (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation (leftNames ↑i) x)ᶜ)
                    (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_compl
                      (Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.edge_right_ext relation (leftNames ↑i))))))
              (le_iInf fun j =>

theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.exists_decision : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (context : B) (domain : ℕ → Flypitch.bSet B) (relation : ℕ → ℕ → Flypitch.bSet B),
  (∀ (r : ℕ), context ≤ (Erdos597Object.injectsIntoValue (Flypitch.V B) (domain r) Flypitch.bSet.omega)ᶜ) →
    ∀ (r : ℕ) (old : Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.Before context domain r),
      Nonempty (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.Decision context domain relation r old) :=
fun {B} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] context domain relation hlarge r old =>
  let this := Fintype.ofFinite (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.Prior r);
  Exists.casesOn
    (Erdos597Object.BooleanPairDecisions.all_finite_decisions context
      (fun s => relation (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.first (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.priorIndex s)) r)
      (fun s => (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.previous old s).name) (domain r)
      (fun s => (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.previous old s).uncountable) (hlarge r))
    fun right h =>
    And.casesOn h fun hright hleft =>
      (fun left x =>
          Nonempty.intro
            {
              right :=
                { name := right, uncountable := LE.le.trans hright inf_le_right,
                  subset := LE.le.trans hright inf_le_left },
              left := fun s =>
                { name := left s, uncountable := LE.le.trans ((fun i => (x i).left) s) inf_le_right,
                  subset :=
                    Erdos597Object.BooleanUncountableRamsey.subset_trans
                      (LE.le.trans ((fun i => (x i).left) s) inf_le_left)
                      (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.previous old s).subset },
              contained := fun s => LE.le.trans ((fun i => (x i).left) s) inf_le_left, status := fun i => (x i).right })
        (fun i => Classical.choose (hleft i)) fun i => Classical.choose_spec (hleft i)

@Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakPrefixes.sets_subset_of_prefix : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] (context : B)
  (domain : ℕ → Flypitch.bSet B) (relation : ℕ → ℕ → Flypitch.bSet B)
  (hlarge : ∀ (r : ℕ), context ≤ (Erdos597Object.injectsIntoValue (Flypitch.V B) (domain r) Flypitch.bSet.omega)ᶜ)
  (s t : Erdos597.WeakFamilies.Index),
  ↑t ⊆ ↑s →
    (∀ a ∈ ↑t, ∀ b ∈ ↑s, b ∉ ↑t → a < b) →
      context ≤
        (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets context domain relation hlarge s).subset
          (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets context domain relation hlarge t)
theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakPrefixes.sets_subset_of_prefix : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (context : B) (domain : ℕ → Flypitch.bSet B) (relation : ℕ → ℕ → Flypitch.bSet B)
  (hlarge : ∀ (r : ℕ), context ≤ (Erdos597Object.injectsIntoValue (Flypitch.V B) (domain r) Flypitch.bSet.omega)ᶜ)
  (s t : Erdos597.WeakFamilies.Index),
  ↑t ⊆ ↑s →
    (∀ a ∈ ↑t, ∀ b ∈ ↑s, b ∉ ↑t → a < b) →
      context ≤
        (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets context domain relation hlarge s).subset
          (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets context domain relation hlarge t) :=
fun {B} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] context domain relation hlarge s t ht hbefore =>
  have aux := fun m =>
    Nat.strong_induction_on m fun m ih s hcard t ht hbefore =>
      if heq : ↑s = ↑t then
        have hs := Subtype.ext heq;
        Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                context ≤
                  (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets context domain relation hlarge _a).subset
                    (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets context domain relation hlarge t))
              hs))
          Flypitch.bSet.subset_self
      else
        have hout :=
          Decidable.byContradiction fun hn =>
            heq
              (Finset.Subset.antisymm
                (Eq.mp
                  (Eq.trans (Mathlib.Tactic.Push.not_exists._simp_1 fun b => b ∈ ↑s ∧ b ∉ ↑t)
                    (forall_congr fun b =>
                      Eq.trans (Mathlib.Tactic.Push.not_and_eq (b ∈ ↑s) (b ∉ ↑t))
                        (implies_congr (Eq.refl (b ∈ ↑s)) Classical.not_not._simp_2)))
                  hn)
                ht);
        Exists.casesOn hout fun b h =>
          And.casesOn h fun hb hbt =>
            have hlast := fun hlast =>
              have hlt := hbefore (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.last s) hlast b hb hbt;
              not_lt_of_ge (Finset.le_max' (↑s) b hb) hlt;
            have herase :=
              Exists.casesOn t.property fun a ha =>
                Exists.intro a (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨fun h => hlast (h ▸ ha), ht ha⟩);
            let p := Erdos597.WeakFamilies.priorIndex (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.erasePrior s rfl herase);
            have hpcard :=
              Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (↑p).card < _a) (Eq.symm hcard)))
                (Finset.card_erase_lt_of_mem (Finset.max'_mem (↑s) s.property));
            have htp := fun ⦃a⦄ ha => Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨fun h => hlast (h ▸ ha), ht ha⟩;
            have hbefore' := fun a ha b hb hbt => hbefore a ha b (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hb) hbt;
            Erdos597Object.BooleanUncountableRamsey.subset_trans
              (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets_shrink context domain relation hlarge s herase)
              (ih (↑p).card hpcard p rfl t htp hbefore');
  aux (↑s).card s rfl t ht hbefore

@Erdos597Object.BooleanTupleRamsey.setColor_tuple : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] (n : ℕ)

theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanTupleRamsey.setColor_tuple : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] (n : ℕ)
  (color : (Fin n → ℕ) → B) (tuple : Fin n → ℕ),
  StrictMono tuple →
    Erdos597Object.BooleanTupleRamsey.setColor n color (Finset.image tuple Finset.univ) = color tuple :=

  have hcard :=
    Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = n) (Finset.card_image_of_injective Finset.univ (StrictMono.injective hmono))))
      (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = n) Finset.card_univ))
        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = n) (Fintype.card_fin n))) (Eq.refl n)));
  have hmembers := fun i => Finset.mem_image.mpr (Exists.intro i ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, rfl⟩);
  have hcanonical := Finset.orderEmbOfFin_unique hcard hmembers hmono;
  of_eq_true
    (Eq.trans
      (congrFun'
        (congrArg Eq
          (Eq.trans

              (Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodBlocks.goodHalves context domain relation hlarge (j - i) ⋯
                  (Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodBlocks.adjacentBlocks f i j))ᶜ →
            part ≤
              Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodPairs.badPair (relation (f i) (f j))
                (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets context domain relation hlarge
                  (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.intervalIndex f i n ⋯))
                (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets context domain relation hlarge
                  (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.intervalIndex f j n hjn))
theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodBlocks.bad_interval_pair : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (context part : B),
  part ≤ context →
    ∀ (domain : ℕ → Flypitch.bSet B) (relation : ℕ → ℕ → Flypitch.bSet B)
      (hlarge : ∀ (r : ℕ), context ≤ (Erdos597Object.injectsIntoValue (Flypitch.V B) (domain r) Flypitch.bSet.omega)ᶜ)
      (f : ℕ → ℕ),
      StrictMono f →
        ∀ (i j n : ℕ) (hij : i < j) (hjn : j < n),
          part ≤
              (Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodBlocks.goodHalves context domain relation hlarge (j - i) ⋯
                  (Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodBlocks.adjacentBlocks f i j))ᶜ →
            part ≤
              Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodPairs.badPair (relation (f i) (f j))
                (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets context domain relation hlarge
                  (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.intervalIndex f i n ⋯))
                (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets context domain relation hlarge
                  (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.intervalIndex f j n hjn)) :=
fun {B} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] context part hpart domain relation hlarge f hf i j n hij hjn hnotGood =>
  let k := j - i;
  have hk := Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hij;
  let left := fun a => f (i + ↑a);
  let right := fun a => f (j + ↑a);
  have hright := fun a b hab => hf (Nat.add_lt_add_left hab j);
  have htLeft := funext fun a => Erdos597.WeakFamilies.appendTuple_left (fun a => f (i + ↑a)) (fun a => f (j + ↑a)) a;
  have htRight := funext fun a => Erdos597.WeakFamilies.appendTuple_right (fun a => f (i + ↑a)) (fun a => f (j + ↑a)) a;
  let leftIndex := Erdos597.WeakFamilies.intervalIndex f i j hij;
  let rightIndex := Erdos597.WeakFamilies.tupleIndex hk right;
  have hleftIndex := Erdos597.WeakFamilies.shifted_tuple_index f i j hij;
  have hfirstLeft := Erdos597.WeakFamilies.first_interval f hf i j hij;
  have hfirstRight :=
    Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = f j) (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.first_tuple hk right hright)))
      (Eq.refl (right ⟨0, hk⟩));
  have hnot :=
    have h := hnotGood;
    id
      (fun h =>
        id
          (fun h =>
            Eq.mp
              (congrArg
                (fun _a =>
                  part ≤
                    (Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodPairs.goodPair (relation (f i) _a)
                        (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets context domain relation hlarge leftIndex)
                        (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets context domain relation hlarge rightIndex))ᶜ)
                hfirstRight)
              (Eq.mp
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a =>
                    part ≤
                      (Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodPairs.goodPair (relation _a (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.first rightIndex))
                          (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets context domain relation hlarge leftIndex)
                          (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets context domain relation hlarge rightIndex))ᶜ)
                  hfirstLeft)
                h))
          (Eq.mp
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                part ≤
                  (Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodPairs.goodPair
                      (relation (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.first _a)
                        (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.first (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.tupleIndex hk right)))
                      (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets context domain relation hlarge _a)
                      (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets context domain relation hlarge
                        (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.tupleIndex hk right)))ᶜ)
              hleftIndex)
            (Eq.mp
              (congrArg
                (fun _a =>
                  part ≤
                    (Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodPairs.goodPair
                        (relation (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.first (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.tupleIndex hk left))
                          (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.first (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.tupleIndex hk _a)))
                        (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets context domain relation hlarge
                          (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.tupleIndex hk left))
                        (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets context domain relation hlarge
                          (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.tupleIndex hk _a)))ᶜ)
                htRight)
              (Eq.mp
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a =>
                    part ≤
                      (Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodPairs.goodPair
                          (relation (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.first (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.tupleIndex hk _a))
                            (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.first
                              (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.tupleIndex hk fun i_1 =>
                                Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodBlocks.adjacentBlocks f i j (Fin.natAdd k i_1))))
                          (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets context domain relation hlarge
                            (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.tupleIndex hk _a))
                          (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets context domain relation hlarge
                            (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.tupleIndex hk fun i_1 =>
                              Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodBlocks.adjacentBlocks f i j (Fin.natAdd k i_1))))ᶜ)
                  htLeft)
                h))))
      h;
  have hrightSubset :=
    Eq.mp
      (congrArg (LE.le part)
        (congrArg (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets context domain relation hlarge rightIndex).subset
          (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets.congr_simp context context (Eq.refl context) domain domain
            (Eq.refl domain) relation relation (Eq.refl relation) hlarge
            (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.singleton (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.first rightIndex))
            (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.singleton (f j)) (congrArg Erdos597.WeakFamilies.singleton hfirstRight))))
      (LE.le.trans hpart
        (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilyContexts.sets_to_first context domain relation hlarge rightIndex));
  have hnotSingleton :=
    Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilyContexts.goodPair_forbidden_on_larger part (relation (f i) (f j))
      (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets context domain relation hlarge leftIndex)
      (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets context domain relation hlarge rightIndex)
      (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets context domain relation hlarge (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.singleton (f j)))
      hrightSubset hnot;
  let chain := Erdos597.WeakFamilies.intervalIndex f i (j + 1) (LT.lt.trans hij (Nat.lt_succ_self j));
  have hlast := Erdos597.WeakFamilies.last_interval_succ f hf i j (LT.lt.le hij);
  have herase :=
    Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (↑chain).erase _a = ↑leftIndex) hlast))
      (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.erase_last_interval f hf i j hij);
  have he := Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a.Nonempty) herase)) leftIndex.property;
  have hprior := Subtype.ext herase;
  have hbad :=
    have hin :=
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (LE.le part)
            (congrArg compl
              (congr
                (congr
                  (congrArg Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodPairs.goodPair
                    (congr (congrArg relation (Eq.trans (congrArg Erdos597.WeakFamilies.first hprior) hfirstLeft))
                      hlast))
                  (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets.congr_simp context context (Eq.refl context) domain domain
                    (Eq.refl domain) relation relation (Eq.refl relation) hlarge
                    (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.priorIndex (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.erasePrior chain rfl he)) leftIndex
                    hprior))
                (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets.congr_simp context context (Eq.refl context) domain domain
                  (Eq.refl domain) relation relation (Eq.refl relation) hlarge
                  (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.singleton (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.last chain))
                  (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.singleton (f j)) (congrArg Erdos597.WeakFamilies.singleton hlast))))))
        hnotSingleton;
    have h :=
      Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilyContexts.sets_bad_extension_at context part hpart domain relation hlarge chain he
        hin;
    Eq.mp
      (congrArg (LE.le part)
        (congr
          (congrFun'
            (congrArg Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodPairs.badPair
              (congr (congrArg relation (Eq.trans (congrArg Erdos597.WeakFamilies.first hprior) hfirstLeft)) hlast))
            (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets context domain relation hlarge chain))
          (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets.congr_simp context context (Eq.refl context) domain domain
            (Eq.refl domain) relation relation (Eq.refl relation) hlarge
            (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.singleton (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.last chain)) (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.singleton (f j))
            (congrArg Erdos597.WeakFamilies.singleton hlast))))
      h;
  Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodPairs.badPair_restrict part (relation (f i) (f j))
    (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets context domain relation hlarge chain)
    (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets context domain relation hlarge (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.singleton (f j)))
    (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets context domain relation hlarge
      (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.intervalIndex f i n (LT.lt.trans hij hjn)))
    (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets context domain relation hlarge
      (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.intervalIndex f j n hjn))
    (LE.le.trans hpart
      (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilyContexts.sets_interval_prefix context domain relation hlarge f hf i (j + 1) n
        (LT.lt.trans hij (Nat.lt_succ_self j)) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hjn)))
    (Eq.mp
      (congrArg (LE.le part)
        (congrArg
          (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets context domain relation hlarge
              (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.intervalIndex f j n hjn)).subset
          (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets.congr_simp context context (Eq.refl context) domain domain
            (Eq.refl domain) relation relation (Eq.refl relation) hlarge
            (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.singleton
              (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.first (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.intervalIndex f j n hjn)))
            (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.singleton (f j))
            (congrArg Erdos597.WeakFamilies.singleton (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.first_interval f hf j n hjn)))))
      (LE.le.trans hpart
        (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilyContexts.sets_to_first context domain relation hlarge
          (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.intervalIndex f j n hjn))))
    hbad

@Erdos597Object.BooleanBadBlocks.adjacentBlocks_weight_le : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]

theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanBadBlocks.adjacentBlocks_weight_le : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (weight : ℕ → B) (n : ℕ) (frame : Fin (n + n) → ℕ) (i j : Fin n),
  i < j →
    Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteSelections.tupleWeight weight frame ≤
      Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteSelections.tupleWeight weight
        (Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodBlocks.adjacentBlocks (Erdos597Object.BooleanTupleExtensions.extend frame) ↑i ↑j) :=

  Finset.le_inf fun a a_1 =>
    id

        (if ha : ↑a < ↑j - ↑i then
          Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (LE.le (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteSelections.tupleWeight weight frame))
                (congrArg weight (dite_eq_left ha))))
            (have hbound :=
              have hi := i.isLt;
              have hj := j.isLt;
              Decidable.byContradiction fun a_2 =>
                Erdos597Object.BooleanBadBlocks.adjacentBlocks_weight_le._proof_1_1 n i j hij a a_2;
            id
              (Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg (fun _a => Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteSelections.tupleWeight weight frame ≤ weight _a)
                    (Erdos597Object.BooleanTupleExtensions.extend_at frame (↑i + ↑a) hbound)))
                (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteSelections.tupleWeight_le weight frame ⟨↑i + ↑a, hbound⟩)))
        else
          Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (LE.le (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteSelections.tupleWeight weight frame))

fun {B} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] hB base context hcontext n ambient relation domain label hdiscrete hsubset hambient
    hlarge hgraph hfibres selected hinfinite hbad =>
  have hcover :=
    LE.le.trans hinfinite (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteSelections.increasing_tuples_cover selected (n + n));
  LE.le.trans (le_inf le_rfl hcover)
    (Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg
          (fun _a =>
            _a ≤
              Erdos597Object.blueCopyValue (Flypitch.V B) (Flypitch.bSet.ofNat n) ambient
                (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.graphName Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.naturalLabel ⊤)
                relation)
          (inf_iSup_eq context fun tuple =>
            if StrictMono tuple then Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteSelections.tupleWeight selected tuple else ⊥)))
      (iSup_le fun frame =>
        if hframe : StrictMono frame then
          Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrFun'
                (congrArg LE.le
                  (congrArg (min context)
                    (ite_eq_left_of_eq_true (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteSelections.tupleWeight selected frame) ⊥
                      (eq_true hframe))))
                (Erdos597Object.blueCopyValue (Flypitch.V B) (Flypitch.bSet.ofNat n) ambient
                  (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.graphName Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.naturalLabel ⊤)
                  relation)))
            (let part := context ⊓ Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteSelections.tupleWeight selected frame;
            let f := Erdos597Object.BooleanTupleExtensions.extend frame;
            have hf := Erdos597Object.BooleanTupleExtensions.extend_strict frame hframe;
            let rows := fun i =>
              Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets base domain (fun x x_1 => relation) hlarge
                (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.intervalIndex f (↑i) n i.isLt);
            have hrowSubset := fun i =>
              id
                (Eq.mp
                  (congrArg (LE.le base)
                    (congrArg
                      (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets base domain (fun x x_1 => relation) hlarge

                  (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets_subset base domain (fun x x_1 => relation) hlarge
                    (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.intervalIndex f (↑i) n i.isLt)));
            have hrowLarge := fun i =>
              LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans inf_le_left hcontext)
                (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeakFamilies.sets_uncountable base domain (fun x x_1 => relation) hlarge
                  (Erdos597.WeakFamilies.intervalIndex f (↑i) n i.isLt));
            have hrowBad := fun i j hij =>
              have hk := Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hij;
              have hkn := LE.le.trans (Nat.sub_le ↑j ↑i) (LT.lt.le j.isLt);
              have hnot :=
                LE.le.trans
                  (le_inf inf_le_left
                    (LE.le.trans inf_le_right
                      (Erdos597Object.BooleanBadBlocks.adjacentBlocks_weight_le selected n frame i j hij)))
                  (hbad (↑j - ↑i) hk hkn
                    (Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodBlocks.adjacentBlocks
                      (Erdos597Object.BooleanTupleExtensions.extend frame) ↑i ↑j)
                    (Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodBlocks.adjacentBlocks_strict f hf (↑i) (↑j) hij));
              Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodBlocks.bad_interval_pair base part (LE.le.trans inf_le_left hcontext) domain
                (fun x x_1 => relation) hlarge f hf (↑i) (↑j) n hij j.isLt hnot;
            Or.casesOn hfibres
              (fun hbackward =>
                have hrowBackward := fun i j hij y =>
                  let piece := part ⊓ y.mem (rows j);
                  have hy :=
                    Flypitch.bSet.mem_of_mem_subset'
                      (LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_left) hcontext) (hrowSubset j))
                      inf_le_right;
                  have hcount :=
                    LE.le.trans (le_inf (LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_left) hcontext) hy)
                      (hbackward (f ↑i) (f ↑j) (hf hij) y);
                  Erdos597Object.BooleanCountableNames.subset_countable
                    (Erdos597Object.BooleanCountableRectangles.predecessors (rows i) relation y)
                    (Erdos597Object.BooleanCountableRectangles.predecessors (domain (f ↑i)) relation y)
                    (Erdos597Object.BooleanBadFibres.predecessors_mono piece relation (rows i) (domain (f ↑i)) y
                      (LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_left) hcontext) (hrowSubset i)))
                    hcount;
                Erdos597Object.BooleanBadCliques.blueCopy_of_bad_pairs hB part n ambient relation rows
                  (fun i => label (f ↑i)) (fun i => hdiscrete (f ↑i))
                  (fun i =>
                    Erdos597Object.BooleanUncountableRamsey.subset_trans
                      (LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans inf_le_left hcontext) (hrowSubset i))
                      (LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans inf_le_left hcontext) (hsubset (f ↑i))))
                  (fun i =>

                  hrowLarge (LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans inf_le_left hcontext) hgraph) hrowBad hrowBackward)
              fun hforward =>
              have hrowForward := fun i j hij x =>

                    (LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_left) hcontext) (hrowSubset i))
                    inf_le_right;

                  LE.le.trans (le_inf (LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_left) hcontext) hx)
                    (hforward (f ↑i) (f ↑j) (hf hij) x);
                Erdos597Object.BooleanCountableNames.subset_countable
                  (Erdos597Object.BooleanGraphNeighborhoods.neighborhood (rows j) relation x)
                  (Erdos597Object.BooleanGraphNeighborhoods.neighborhood (domain (f ↑j)) relation x)
                  (Erdos597Object.BooleanSymmetricPairs.neighborhood_mono piece relation (rows j) (domain (f ↑j)) x
                    (LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_left) hcontext) (hrowSubset j)))
                  hcount;
              Erdos597Object.BooleanReversedCliques.blueCopy_of_forward_pairs hB part n ambient relation rows
                (fun i => label (f ↑i)) (fun i => hdiscrete (f ↑i))
                (fun i =>
                  Erdos597Object.BooleanUncountableRamsey.subset_trans
                    (LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans inf_le_left hcontext) (hrowSubset i))
                    (LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans inf_le_left hcontext) (hsubset (f ↑i))))
                (fun i =>
                  Erdos597Object.BooleanUncountableRamsey.subset_trans
                    (LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans inf_le_left hcontext) (hrowSubset i))
                    (LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans inf_le_left hcontext) (hambient (f ↑i))))
                hrowLarge (LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans inf_le_left hcontext) hgraph) hrowBad hrowForward)
        else
          of_eq_true
            (Eq.trans
              (congrFun'
                (congrArg LE.le
                  (Eq.trans
                    (congrArg (min context)
                      (ite_eq_right_of_eq_false (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteSelections.tupleWeight selected frame) ⊥
                        (eq_false hframe)))
                    (inf_bot_eq context)))

                  relation))

@Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseyAlternatives.negative_of_avoiding_support : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (context : B) (n : ℕ) (color : (Fin n → ℕ) → B) (selected : ℕ → B) (side : B),

    Erdos597Object.BooleanTupleRamsey.Homogeneous context n color selected side →

          StrictMono tuple →
            context ⊓ Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteSelections.tupleWeight selected tuple ≤ (color tuple)ᶜ
theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseyAlternatives.negative_of_avoiding_support : ∀ {B : Type}
  [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] (context : B) (n : ℕ) (color : (Fin n → ℕ) → B) (selected : ℕ → B) (side : B),
  context ≤ Erdos597Object.BooleanInfiniteSets.infiniteValue selected →
    Erdos597Object.BooleanTupleRamsey.Homogeneous context n color selected side →
      context ≤ (Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseyAlternatives.goodSupport n color)ᶜ →
        ∀ (tuple : Fin n → ℕ),
          StrictMono tuple →
            context ⊓ Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteSelections.tupleWeight selected tuple ≤ (color tuple)ᶜ :=
fun {B} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] context n color selected side hinfinite hhomogeneous havoid =>
  have hside :=
    have hgood :=
      Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseyAlternatives.positive_side_le context n color selected side hinfinite hhomogeneous;
    have hboth := le_inf hgood (LE.le.trans inf_le_left havoid);
    Eq.mp (congrArg (LE.le (context ⊓ side)) inf_compl_eq_bot) hboth;
  have hnegative :=
    Trans.trans
      (Trans.trans
        (Trans.trans
          (of_eq_true
            (Eq.trans (congrArg (Eq context) (Eq.trans (congrArg (min context) sup_compl_eq_top) (inf_top_eq context)))
              (eq_self context)))
          (of_eq_true
            (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg Eq (inf_sup_left context side sideᶜ)) (context ⊓ side ⊔ context ⊓ sideᶜ))
              (eq_self (context ⊓ side ⊔ context ⊓ sideᶜ)))))
        (sup_le_sup hside inf_le_right))
      (bot_sup_eq sideᶜ);
  fun tuple htuple =>
  le_trans (le_inf inf_le_left (le_inf inf_le_right (LE.le.trans inf_le_left hnegative)))
    (hhomogeneous tuple htuple).right

fun base n ambient relation domain label hdiscrete hsubset hambient hlarge hgraph hfibres hnoBlue =>
  let blue :=
    Erdos597Object.blueCopyValue (Flypitch.V Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.finalAlgebra.Carrier)
      (Flypitch.bSet.ofNat n) ambient
      (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.graphName Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.naturalLabel ⊤) relation;
  have hcover :=
    Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodSupport.good_or_blue_oriented base n ambient relation domain label hdiscrete hsubset
      hambient hlarge hgraph hfibres;
  have hempty :=
    have hboth := le_inf inf_le_right (LE.le.trans inf_le_left hnoBlue);
    Eq.mp (congrArg (LE.le (base ⊓ blue)) inf_compl_eq_bot) hboth;
  Trans.trans
    (Trans.trans
      (Trans.trans (le_inf le_rfl hcover)
        (of_eq_true
          (Eq.trans
            (congrFun'
              (congrArg Eq
                (inf_sup_left base (Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodSupport.blockSupport base domain relation hlarge n) blue))
              (base ⊓ Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodSupport.blockSupport base domain relation hlarge n ⊔ base ⊓ blue))
            (eq_self
              (base ⊓ Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodSupport.blockSupport base domain relation hlarge n ⊔ base ⊓ blue)))))
      (sup_le_sup inf_le_right hempty))
    (sup_bot_eq (Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodSupport.blockSupport base domain relation hlarge n))

@Erdos597Object.BooleanHistoryBlocks.cover_le_long : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] (arity : ℕ)
  (color : Finset ℕ → B) (initial : ℕ → B) (filter : Flypitch.bSet B) (bound : ℕ) (subset : Finset ℕ),
  bound ≤ subset.card →
    Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseyFiniteCover.coverValue arity color initial filter subset ≤
      Erdos597Object.BooleanHistoryBlocks.longValue arity color initial filter bound
theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanHistoryBlocks.cover_le_long : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] (arity : ℕ)
  (color : Finset ℕ → B) (initial : ℕ → B) (filter : Flypitch.bSet B) (bound : ℕ) (subset : Finset ℕ),
  bound ≤ subset.card →
    Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseyFiniteCover.coverValue arity color initial filter subset ≤
      Erdos597Object.BooleanHistoryBlocks.longValue arity color initial filter bound :=
fun {B} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] arity color initial filter bound subset hsize =>
  iSup_le fun history =>
    if hsub : subset ⊆ Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseyHistories.points history then
      have hlength :=
        LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans hsize (Finset.card_le_card hsub))
          (id
            (Eq.mp (congrArg (LE.le (List.map Prod.fst history).toFinset.card) (List.length_map Prod.fst))
              (List.toFinset_card_le (List.map Prod.fst history))));
      le_iSup_of_le history
        (of_eq_true
          (Eq.trans
            (congr
              (congrArg LE.le
                ((fun x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3 => (fun x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3 => ite_eq_left hsub) x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3)
                  (subset.instDecidableLE (Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseyHistories.points history)) B
                  (Erdos597Object.FilterCoefficients.values
                    (Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseyForcing.forcing arity color initial) filter history)
                  ⊥))
              ((fun x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3 => (fun x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3 => ite_eq_left hlength) x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3)
                (bound.decLe history.length) B
                (Erdos597Object.FilterCoefficients.values
                  (Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseyForcing.forcing arity color initial) filter history)
                ⊥))
            (Erdos597Object.BooleanHistoryBlocks.cover_le_long._simp_1_1
              (Erdos597Object.FilterCoefficients.values
                (Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseyForcing.forcing arity color initial) filter history))))
    else
      of_eq_true
        (Eq.trans
          (congrFun'
            (congrArg LE.le
              ((fun x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3 => (fun x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3 => ite_eq_right hsub) x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3)
                (subset.instDecidableLE (Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseyHistories.points history)) B
                (Erdos597Object.FilterCoefficients.values
                  (Erdos597Object.BooleanRamseyForcing.forcing arity color initial) filter history)
                ⊥))
            (Erdos597Object.BooleanHistoryBlocks.longValue arity color initial filter bound))

  (context : B) (order : Flypitch.bSet B) (left : I → Flypitch.bSet B) (right : J → Flypitch.bSet B),
  (∀ (i : I) (j : J), context ≤ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) order (left i) (right j)) →
    context ≤
      Erdos597Object.BooleanRowOrder.allBefore order (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.labelDomain left)
        (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.labelDomain right) :=
fun {B I J} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] context order left right hlabels =>
  Erdos597Object.BooleanRowOrder.allBefore_intro context order (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.labelDomain left)
    (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.labelDomain right) fun x y =>
    id
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              context ⊓ (_a ⊓ y.mem (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weightedSet right fun x => ⊤)) ≤
                Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) order x y)
            (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.member_weightedSet left (fun x => ⊤) x)))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                context ⊓ ((⨆ i, ⊤ ⊓ x.bv_eq (left i)) ⊓ _a) ≤ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) order x y)
              (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.member_weightedSet right (fun x => ⊤) y)))
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrFun'
                (congrArg LE.le
                  (Eq.trans
                    (Eq.trans
                      (congrArg (min context)
                        (Eq.trans
                          (Eq.trans
                            (congr (congrArg min (congrArg iSup (funext fun i => top_inf_eq (x.bv_eq (left i)))))
                              (congrArg iSup (funext fun i => top_inf_eq (y.bv_eq (right i)))))
                            (inf_iSup_eq (⨆ i, x.bv_eq (left i)) fun i => y.bv_eq (right i)))
                          (congrArg iSup
                            (funext fun i => iSup_inf_eq (fun i => x.bv_eq (left i)) (y.bv_eq (right i))))))
                      (inf_iSup_eq context fun i => ⨆ i_1, x.bv_eq (left i_1) ⊓ y.bv_eq (right i)))
                    (congrArg iSup
                      (funext fun i => inf_iSup_eq context fun i_1 => x.bv_eq (left i_1) ⊓ y.bv_eq (right i)))))
                (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) order x y)))
            (iSup_le fun j =>
              iSup_le fun i =>
                have hleft :=
                  LE.le.trans
                    (le_inf (Flypitch.bSet.bv_symm (LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_left))
                      (LE.le.trans inf_le_left (hlabels i j)))
                    (Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.edge_left_ext order (right j) (left i) x);
                LE.le.trans (le_inf (Flypitch.bSet.bv_symm (LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_right)) hleft)
                  (Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.edge_right_ext order x (right j) y)))))

theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanMaskedGraphs.masked_graph : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] (context : B)

            Eq.mpr

@Erdos597Object.BooleanBlockOrder.lexLess_pair : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (a b c d : Flypitch.bSet B),

theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanBlockOrder.lexLess_pair : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (a b c d : Flypitch.bSet B),
  Erdos597Object.lexLessValue (Flypitch.V B) (a.pair b) (c.pair d) = a.mem c ⊔ a.bv_eq c ⊓ b.mem d :=
fun {B} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] a b c d =>
  le_antisymm
    (iSup_le fun a' =>
      iSup_le fun b' =>
        iSup_le fun c' =>
          iSup_le fun d' =>
            id
              (let part :=
                (a.pair b).bv_eq (Flypitch.bSet.pair a' b') ⊓
                  ((c.pair d).bv_eq (Flypitch.bSet.pair c' d') ⊓
                    (Flypitch.bSet.mem a' c' ⊔ Flypitch.bSet.bv_eq a' c' ⊓ Flypitch.bSet.mem b' d'));
              have ha := Flypitch.bSet.eq_of_eq_pair_left' inf_le_left;
              have hb := Flypitch.bSet.eq_of_eq_pair_right' inf_le_left;
              have hc := Flypitch.bSet.eq_of_eq_pair_left' (LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_left);
              have hd := Flypitch.bSet.eq_of_eq_pair_right' (LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_left);
              have hcase := LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_right;
              LE.le.trans (le_inf le_rfl hcase)
                (Flypitch.lattice.bv_or_elim_right
                  (le_sup_of_le_left
                    (Flypitch.bSet.subst_congr_mem_right' (Flypitch.bSet.bv_symm (LE.le.trans inf_le_left hc))
                      (Flypitch.bSet.subst_congr_mem_left' (Flypitch.bSet.bv_symm (LE.le.trans inf_le_left ha))
                        inf_le_right)))
                  (le_sup_of_le_right
                    (le_inf
                      (Flypitch.bSet.bv_trans (LE.le.trans inf_le_left ha)
                        (Flypitch.bSet.bv_trans (LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_left)
                          (Flypitch.bSet.bv_symm (LE.le.trans inf_le_left hc))))
                      (Flypitch.bSet.subst_congr_mem_right' (Flypitch.bSet.bv_symm (LE.le.trans inf_le_left hd))
                        (Flypitch.bSet.subst_congr_mem_left' (Flypitch.bSet.bv_symm (LE.le.trans inf_le_left hb))
                          (LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_right))))))))

      (le_iSup_of_le b
        (le_iSup_of_le c (le_iSup_of_le d (le_inf Flypitch.bSet.bv_refl (le_inf Flypitch.bSet.bv_refl le_rfl))))))

  (predicate : Flypitch.bSet B → B),
  Flypitch.bSet.B_ext predicate →
    context ≤ domain.subset (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.labelDomain label) →
      (∀ (i : I), context ⊓ (label i).mem domain ≤ predicate (label i)) →
        ∀ (name : Flypitch.bSet B), context ⊓ name.mem domain ≤ predicate name :=
fun {B I} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] context label domain predicate hext hsubset hlabel name =>
  let body := fun x => Flypitch.lattice.imp (x.mem domain) (predicate x);
  have hbody := Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_imp (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_mem_left domain) hext;
  have hall :=
    id
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a => context ≤ _a)
            (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weighted_bounded_forall label (fun x => ⊤) body hbody)))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg (LE.le context)
              (congrArg iInf
                (funext fun i =>
                  Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg max compl_top) (body (label i))) (bot_sup_eq (body (label i)))))))
          (le_iInf fun i => Flypitch.lattice.bv_imp_intro (hlabel i))));
  have hmember := Flypitch.bSet.mem_of_mem_subset' (LE.le.trans inf_le_left hsubset) inf_le_right;
  have hbodyName :=
    Flypitch.lattice.bv_context_apply
      (LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans inf_le_left hall)
        (iInf_le (fun x => Flypitch.lattice.imp (x.mem (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.labelDomain label)) (body x))
          name))
      hmember;
  Flypitch.lattice.bv_context_apply hbodyName inf_le_right

theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanPartsGood.parts_cover : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] (context : B)
  (relation x y : Flypitch.bSet B),
  context ≤ x.mem Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockDomain →
    context ≤ y.mem Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockDomain →
      context ⊓ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation x y ≤
        Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) (Erdos597Object.BooleanOrientedGraphs.upPart relation) x y ⊔
          Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) (Erdos597Object.BooleanOrientedGraphs.downPart relation) x y :=
fun {B} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] context relation x y hx hy =>
  let body := fun x y =>
    Flypitch.lattice.imp (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation x y)
      (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) (Erdos597Object.BooleanOrientedGraphs.upPart relation) x y ⊔
        Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) (Erdos597Object.BooleanOrientedGraphs.downPart relation) x y);
  have hleft := fun y =>
    Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_imp (Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.edge_left_ext relation y)
      (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_sup
        (Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.edge_left_ext (Erdos597Object.BooleanOrientedGraphs.upPart relation) y)
        (Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.edge_left_ext (Erdos597Object.BooleanOrientedGraphs.downPart relation) y));
  have hright := fun x =>
    Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_imp (Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.edge_right_ext relation x)
      (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_sup
        (Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.edge_right_ext (Erdos597Object.BooleanOrientedGraphs.upPart relation) x)
        (Erdos597Object.BooleanInjections.edge_right_ext (Erdos597Object.BooleanOrientedGraphs.downPart relation) x));
  have hall :=
    id
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a => ⊤ ≤ _a)
            (Erdos597Object.BooleanPosetModel.weighted_forall_two Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockLabel
              (fun x => ⊤) body hleft hright)))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg (LE.le ⊤)
              (congrArg iInf
                (funext fun i =>
                  Eq.trans
                    (congr (congrArg max compl_top)
                      (congrArg iInf
                        (funext fun j =>
                          Eq.trans
                            (congrFun' (congrArg max compl_top)
                              (body (Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockLabel i)
                                (Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockLabel j)))
                            (bot_sup_eq
                              (body (Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockLabel i)
                                (Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockLabel j))))))
                    (bot_sup_eq
                      (⨅ j,
                        body (Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockLabel i)
                          (Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockLabel j)))))))
          (le_iInf fun i =>
            le_iInf fun j =>
              id
                (Flypitch.lattice.bv_imp_intro
                  (Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg
                        (fun _a =>
                          ⊤ ⊓
                              Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation
                                (Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockLabel i)
                                (Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockLabel j) ≤
                            _a)
                        (Erdos597Object.BooleanOrientedGraphs.parts_cover_labels relation i j)))
                    inf_le_right)))));
  have hfirst :=
    Flypitch.lattice.bv_context_apply
      (LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans le_top hall)
        (iInf_le
          (fun x =>
            Flypitch.lattice.imp (x.mem Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockDomain)
              (⨅ y, Flypitch.lattice.imp (y.mem Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockDomain) (body x y)))
          x))
      hx;
  have hsecond :=
    Flypitch.lattice.bv_context_apply
      (LE.le.trans hfirst
        (iInf_le (fun y => Flypitch.lattice.imp (y.mem Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockDomain) (body x y)) y))
      hy;

          Erdos597Object.BooleanRectangles.emptyRectangle (Erdos597Object.BooleanOrientedGraphs.upPart relation) left
            right →

            Erdos597Object.BooleanRectangles.emptyRectangle (Erdos597Object.BooleanOrientedGraphs.downPart relation)
              left right →

theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanPartsGood.emptyRectangle_of_parts : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (context : B) (relation left right : Flypitch.bSet B),
  context ≤ left.subset Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockDomain →
    context ≤ right.subset Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockDomain →
      context ≤
          Erdos597Object.BooleanRectangles.emptyRectangle (Erdos597Object.BooleanOrientedGraphs.upPart relation) left
            right →
        context ≤
            Erdos597Object.BooleanRectangles.emptyRectangle (Erdos597Object.BooleanOrientedGraphs.downPart relation)
              left right →
          context ≤ Erdos597Object.BooleanRectangles.emptyRectangle relation left right :=
fun {B} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] context relation left right hleft hright hup hdown =>
  Eq.mpr
    (id (congrArg (fun _a => context ≤ _a) (Erdos597Object.BooleanRectangles.emptyRectangle_spec relation left right)))
    (le_iInf fun x =>
      Flypitch.lattice.bv_imp_intro
        (le_iInf fun y =>
          Flypitch.lattice.bv_imp_intro
            (let part := context ⊓ x.mem left ⊓ y.mem right;
            have hx := LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_right;
            have hy := inf_le_right;
            have hcontext := LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_left;
            have hcover :=
              Erdos597Object.BooleanPartsGood.parts_cover part relation x y
                (Flypitch.bSet.mem_of_mem_subset' (LE.le.trans hcontext hleft) hx)
                (Flypitch.bSet.mem_of_mem_subset' (LE.le.trans hcontext hright) hy);
            have hup' :=
              Erdos597Object.BooleanRectangles.emptyRectangle_no_edge part
                (Erdos597Object.BooleanOrientedGraphs.upPart relation) left right x y (LE.le.trans hcontext hup) hx hy;
            have hdown' :=
              Erdos597Object.BooleanRectangles.emptyRectangle_no_edge part
                (Erdos597Object.BooleanOrientedGraphs.downPart relation) left right x y (LE.le.trans hcontext hdown) hx
                hy;
            le_compl_iff_disjoint_right.mpr
              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a) (propext disjoint_iff)))
                (bot_unique
                  (have hsmall :=
                    le_inf hcover
                      (LE.le.trans inf_le_left
                        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => part ≤ _a) compl_sup)) (le_inf hup' hdown')));
                  LE.le.trans_eq hsmall inf_compl_eq_bot))))))
