@Erdos597Object.BooleanPartsGood.goodPair_of_parts : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] (context : B)
  (relation left right : Flypitch.bSet B),
  context ≤ left.subset Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockDomain →
    context ≤ right.subset Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockDomain →
      context ≤
          Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodPairs.goodPair (Erdos597Object.BooleanOrientedGraphs.upPart relation) left right →
        context ≤
            Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodPairs.goodPair (Erdos597Object.BooleanOrientedGraphs.downPart relation) left
              right →
          context ≤ Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodPairs.goodPair relation left right
theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanPartsGood.goodPair_of_parts : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] (context : B)
  (relation left right : Flypitch.bSet B),
  context ≤ left.subset Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockDomain →
    context ≤ right.subset Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockDomain →
      context ≤
          Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodPairs.goodPair (Erdos597Object.BooleanOrientedGraphs.upPart relation) left right →
        context ≤
            Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodPairs.goodPair (Erdos597Object.BooleanOrientedGraphs.downPart relation) left
              right →
          context ≤ Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodPairs.goodPair relation left right :=
fun {B} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] context relation left right hleft hright hup hdown =>
  le_iInf fun testLeft =>
    Flypitch.lattice.bv_imp_intro
      (le_iInf fun testRight =>
        Flypitch.lattice.bv_imp_intro
          (let part :=
            context ⊓ Erdos597Object.BooleanRectangles.largeSubset left testLeft ⊓
              Erdos597Object.BooleanRectangles.largeSubset right testRight;
          have hcontext := LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_left;
          have htestLeft := LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_right;
          have htestRight := inf_le_right;
          Exists.casesOn
            (Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodPairs.goodPair_refine part (Erdos597Object.BooleanOrientedGraphs.upPart relation)
              left right testLeft testRight (LE.le.trans hcontext hup) htestLeft htestRight)
            fun firstLeft h =>
            Exists.casesOn h fun firstRight h =>
              And.casesOn h fun hfirstLeft right_1 =>
                And.casesOn right_1 fun hfirstRight hnoUp =>
                  Exists.casesOn
                    (Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodPairs.goodPair_refine part
                      (Erdos597Object.BooleanOrientedGraphs.downPart relation) left right firstLeft firstRight
                      (LE.le.trans hcontext hdown)
                      (Erdos597Object.BooleanRectangles.largeSubset_trans part left testLeft firstLeft htestLeft
                        hfirstLeft)
                      (Erdos597Object.BooleanRectangles.largeSubset_trans part right testRight firstRight htestRight
                        hfirstRight))
                    fun lastLeft h =>
                    Exists.casesOn h fun lastRight h =>
                      And.casesOn h fun hlastLeft right_2 =>
                        And.casesOn right_2 fun hlastRight hnoDown =>
                          have hlastTestLeft :=
                            Erdos597Object.BooleanRectangles.largeSubset_trans part testLeft firstLeft lastLeft
                              hfirstLeft hlastLeft;
                          have hlastTestRight :=
                            Erdos597Object.BooleanRectangles.largeSubset_trans part testRight firstRight lastRight
                              hfirstRight hlastRight;
                          have hlastBlockLeft :=
                            Erdos597Object.BooleanUncountableRamsey.subset_trans (LE.le.trans hlastTestLeft inf_le_left)
                              (Erdos597Object.BooleanUncountableRamsey.subset_trans (LE.le.trans htestLeft inf_le_left)
                                (LE.le.trans hcontext hleft));
                          have hlastBlockRight :=
                            Erdos597Object.BooleanUncountableRamsey.subset_trans
                              (LE.le.trans hlastTestRight inf_le_left)
                              (Erdos597Object.BooleanUncountableRamsey.subset_trans (LE.le.trans htestRight inf_le_left)
                                (LE.le.trans hcontext hright));
                          le_iSup_of_le lastLeft
                            (le_inf hlastTestLeft
                              (le_iSup_of_le lastRight
                                (le_inf hlastTestRight
                                  (Erdos597Object.BooleanPartsGood.emptyRectangle_of_parts part relation lastLeft
                                    lastRight hlastBlockLeft hlastBlockRight
                                    (LE.le.trans (le_inf le_rfl hnoUp)
                                      (Erdos597Object.BooleanRectangles.emptyRectangle_mono part
                                        (Erdos597Object.BooleanOrientedGraphs.upPart relation) lastLeft lastRight
                                        firstLeft firstRight (LE.le.trans hlastLeft inf_le_left)
                                        (LE.le.trans hlastRight inf_le_left)))
                                    hnoDown))))))

@Erdos597Object.BooleanFamilyMixing.disjoint_cover : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] (weight : I → B),
  ∃ piece, (∀ (i : I), piece i ≤ weight i) ∧ (∀ (i j : I), i ≠ j → piece i ⊓ piece j = ⊥) ∧ ⨆ i, weight i ≤ ⨆ i, piece i
theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanFamilyMixing.disjoint_cover : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (weight : I → B),
  ∃ piece,
    (∀ (i : I), piece i ≤ weight i) ∧ (∀ (i j : I), i ≠ j → piece i ⊓ piece j = ⊥) ∧ ⨆ i, weight i ≤ ⨆ i, piece i :=
fun {B I} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] weight =>
  Exists.casesOn
    (Exists.casesOn (exists_wellFoundedLT I) fun horder h => Exists.intro (fun x1 x2 => x1 < x2) inferInstance)
    fun r hr =>
    let this := hr;
    let earlier := fun i => ⨆ j, weight ↑j;
    let piece := fun i => weight i ⊓ (earlier i)ᶜ;
    have hzero := fun i j hij =>
      bot_unique
        (have hprior := le_iSup_of_le ⟨i, hij⟩ le_rfl;
        have hboth :=
          le_inf (LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_left)
            (LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_right) (compl_le_compl hprior));
        LE.le.trans_eq hboth inf_compl_eq_bot);
    have hcover := fun i =>
      (fun x_0 => WellFounded.induction IsWellOrder.wf) (fun i => weight i ≤ ⨆ j, piece j) i fun i ih =>
        have hearlier := iSup_le fun j => ih (↑j) j.property;
        Trans.trans
          (id
            (Eq.mpr
              (id (congrArg (fun _a => weight i = _a) (Eq.symm (inf_sup_left (weight i) (earlier i)ᶜ (earlier i)))))
              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => weight i = weight i ⊓ _a) compl_sup_eq_top))
                (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => weight i = _a) (inf_top_eq (weight i)))) (Eq.refl (weight i))))))
          (sup_le (le_iSup piece i) (LE.le.trans inf_le_right hearlier));
    Exists.intro piece
      ⟨fun x => inf_le_left,
        ⟨fun i j hij =>
          Or.casesOn (trichotomous i j) (fun hij' => hzero i j hij') fun h =>
            Or.casesOn h (fun heq => False.elim (hij heq)) fun hji =>
              Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = ⊥) (inf_comm (piece i) (piece j)))) (hzero j i hji),
          iSup_le hcover⟩⟩

@Erdos597Object.BooleanFamilyMixing.family_fullness : ∀ {B J : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (property : (J → Flypitch.bSet B) → B),
  (∀ (context : B) (left right : J → Flypitch.bSet B),
      (∀ (j : J), context ≤ (left j).bv_eq (right j)) → context ≤ property left → context ≤ property right) →
    ∀ context ≤ ⨆ family, property family, ∃ family, context ≤ property family
theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanFamilyMixing.family_fullness : ∀ {B J : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (property : (J → Flypitch.bSet B) → B),
  (∀ (context : B) (left right : J → Flypitch.bSet B),
      (∀ (j : J), context ≤ (left j).bv_eq (right j)) → context ≤ property left → context ≤ property right) →
    ∀ context ≤ ⨆ family, property family, ∃ family, context ≤ property family :=
fun {B J} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] property hcongr context hcover =>
  let Index := Set.range property;
  let family := fun i => Classical.choose i.property;
  have hproperty := fun i => Classical.choose_spec i.property;
  Exists.casesOn (Erdos597Object.BooleanFamilyMixing.disjoint_cover fun i => ↑i) fun piece h =>
    And.casesOn h fun hpiece right =>
      And.casesOn right fun hdisjoint hpiecesCover =>
        let mixed := fun j => Flypitch.bSet.mixture piece fun i => family i j;
        have hequal := fun i j =>
          Flypitch.bSet.mixing_lemma' piece (fun i => family i j)
            (fun left right =>
              if h : left = right then h ▸ Flypitch.bSet.bv_refl
              else
                Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ≤ (family left j).bv_eq (family right j)) (hdisjoint left right h)))
                  bot_le)
            i;
        have hresult := fun i =>
          hcongr (piece i) (family i) mixed (fun j => Flypitch.bSet.bv_symm (hequal i j))
            (LE.le.trans_eq (hpiece i) (Eq.symm (hproperty i)));
        have hsmall := iSup_le fun f => le_iSup_of_le ⟨property f, Set.mem_range_self f⟩ le_rfl;
        Exists.intro mixed (LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans hcover hsmall) hpiecesCover) (iSup_le hresult))

                    Erdos597Object.BooleanRowOrder.allBefore order (rows i) (rows j))

@Erdos597Object.BooleanRowValues.rowFamilyValue_congr : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] (context : B)
  (ambient relation order : Flypitch.bSet B) (left right : ℕ → Flypitch.bSet B),

    context ≤ Erdos597Object.BooleanRowValues.rowFamilyValue ambient relation order left →

theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanRowValues.rowFamilyValue_congr : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (context : B) (ambient relation order : Flypitch.bSet B) (left right : ℕ → Flypitch.bSet B),

    context ≤ Erdos597Object.BooleanRowValues.rowFamilyValue ambient relation order left →

fun {B} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] context ambient relation order left right hequal hleft =>

    (le_iInf fun i =>
      have hrow :=
        LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans hleft inf_le_left)
          (iInf_le (fun i => Erdos597Object.BooleanRectangles.largeSubset ambient (left i)) i);
      LE.le.trans (le_inf (hequal i) hrow)
        (Erdos597Object.BooleanRectangles.largeSubset_ext ambient (left i) (right i)))
    (le_iInf fun i =>
      le_iInf fun j =>
        le_iInf fun hij =>
          have hpair :=
            LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans hleft inf_le_right)
              (LE.le.trans
                (iInf_le
                  (fun i =>
                    ⨅ j,
                      ⨅ (_ : i < j),
                        Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodPairs.goodPair relation (left i) (left j) ⊓
                          Erdos597Object.BooleanRowOrder.allBefore order (left i) (left j))
                  i)
                (LE.le.trans
                  (iInf_le
                    (fun j =>
                      ⨅ (_ : i < j),
                        Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodPairs.goodPair relation (left i) (left j) ⊓
                          Erdos597Object.BooleanRowOrder.allBefore order (left i) (left j))
                    j)
                  (iInf_le
                    (fun x =>
                      Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodPairs.goodPair relation (left i) (left j) ⊓
                        Erdos597Object.BooleanRowOrder.allBefore order (left i) (left j))
                    hij)));
          have hgoodLeft :=
            LE.le.trans (le_inf (hequal i) (LE.le.trans hpair inf_le_left))
              (Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodPairs.goodPair_left_ext relation (left j) (left i) (right i));
          have horderLeft :=
            LE.le.trans (le_inf (hequal i) (LE.le.trans hpair inf_le_right))
              (Erdos597Object.BooleanRowOrder.allBefore_left_ext order (left j) (left i) (right i));
          le_inf
            (LE.le.trans (le_inf (hequal j) hgoodLeft)
              (Erdos597Object.BooleanGoodPairs.goodPair_right_ext relation (right i) (left j) (right j)))
            (LE.le.trans (le_inf (hequal j) horderLeft)
              (Erdos597Object.BooleanRowOrder.allBefore_right_ext order (right i) (left j) (right j))))

@Erdos597Object.BooleanIndependentFilters.coefficients_of_equivalences : ∀ {I D : Type}
  (context : Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.finalAlgebra.Carrier)
  (P : Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.BooleanPoset Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.finalAlgebra.Carrier I)
  (index : Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.Labels ≃ I) (requirements : Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.Labels ≃ D)
  (active : D → Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.finalAlgebra.Carrier)
  (dense : D → I → Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.finalAlgebra.Carrier),
  Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.BooleanCountableChainCondition P →
    ⨆ i, P.member i = context →
      (∀ (d : D), active d ≤ context) →
        (∀ (d : D) (i : I), dense d i ≤ P.member i) →
          (∀ (d : D) (j : I), active d ⊓ P.member j ≤ ⨆ i, dense d i ⊓ P.leValue i j) →
            ∃ value,

  (dense : D → I → Erdos597Object.ScheduledIteration.finalAlgebra.Carrier),

    context ≤ Erdos597Object.BooleanLocalGraphs.independentValue large relation →
      context ≤ Erdos597Object.BooleanLocalGraphs.independentValue small relation :=

  le_iInf fun x =>
    Flypitch.lattice.bv_imp_intro
      (le_iInf fun y =>
        Flypitch.lattice.bv_imp_intro
          (have hcontext := LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_left;
          have hx :=
            Flypitch.bSet.mem_of_mem_subset' (LE.le.trans hcontext hsubset) (LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_right);
          have hy := Flypitch.bSet.mem_of_mem_subset' (LE.le.trans hcontext hsubset) inf_le_right;
          have hfirst :=
            Flypitch.lattice.bv_context_apply
              (LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans hcontext hlarge)
                (iInf_le
                  (fun x =>

                        Flypitch.lattice.imp (y.mem large)

                  x))
              hx;
          Flypitch.lattice.bv_context_apply
            (LE.le.trans hfirst
              (iInf_le
                (fun y =>
                  Flypitch.lattice.imp (y.mem large)
                    (x.bv_eq y ⊔ (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) relation x y)ᶜ))

              ⨆ q,

theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanIncreasingSequences.bounded_before_outside : ∀ {B : Type}
  [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] (context : B) (label : Erdos597.One → Flypitch.bSet B) (order : Flypitch.bSet B),
  (∀ (i j : Erdos597.One), i < j → ⊤ ≤ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) order (label i) (label j)) →
    ∀ (bound : Erdos597.One) (x y : Flypitch.bSet B),
      context ≤ x.mem (Erdos597Object.BooleanNameSupports.boundedName label bound) →
        context ≤ y.mem (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.weightedSet label fun x => ⊤) →
          context ≤ (y.mem (Erdos597Object.BooleanNameSupports.boundedName label bound))ᶜ →
            context ≤ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) order x y :=
fun {B} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] context label order horder bound x y hx hy hout =>
  id
    (fun hx =>
      have hy' := Eq.mp (congrArg (LE.le context) (congrArg iSup (funext fun i => top_inf_eq (y.bv_eq (label i))))) hy;
      LE.le.trans (le_inf le_rfl hx)
        (Flypitch.lattice.bv_cases_right fun i =>
          if hi : i < bound then
            Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrFun'
                  (congrArg LE.le
                    (congrArg (min context)
                      (Eq.trans
                        (congrFun'
                          (congrArg min
                            ((fun x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3 => (fun x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3 => ite_eq_left hi) x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3)
                              (LinearOrder.toDecidableLT i bound) B ⊤ ⊥))
                          (x.bv_eq (label i)))
                        (top_inf_eq (x.bv_eq (label i))))))
                  (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) order x y)))
              (LE.le.trans (le_inf le_rfl (LE.le.trans inf_le_left hy'))
                (Flypitch.lattice.bv_cases_right fun j =>
                  let part := context ⊓ x.bv_eq (label i) ⊓ y.bv_eq (label j);
                  id
                    (have hpart := LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_left;
                    if hj : j < bound then
                      have hmember :=
                        le_iSup_of_le j
                          (Eq.mpr
                            (id
                              (congrArg (LE.le part)
                                (Eq.trans
                                  (congrFun'
                                    (congrArg min
                                      ((fun x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3 => (fun x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3 => ite_eq_left hj) x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3)
                                        (LinearOrder.toDecidableLT j bound) B ⊤ ⊥))
                                    (y.bv_eq (label j)))
                                  (top_inf_eq (y.bv_eq (label j))))))
                            inf_le_right);
                      LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans_eq (le_inf hmember (LE.le.trans hpart hout)) inf_compl_eq_bot) bot_le
                    else
                      have hij := LT.lt.trans_le hi (not_lt.mp hj);
                      have hground := LE.le.trans le_top (horder i j hij);
                      Flypitch.bSet.subst_congr_mem_left'
                        (Flypitch.bSet.pair_congr (Flypitch.bSet.bv_symm (LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_right))
                          (Flypitch.bSet.bv_symm inf_le_right))
                        hground)))
          else
            of_eq_true
              (Eq.trans
                (congrFun'
                  (congrArg LE.le
                    (Eq.trans
                      (congrArg (min context)
                        (Eq.trans
                          (congrFun'
                            (congrArg min
                              ((fun x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3 => (fun x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3 => ite_eq_right hi) x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3)
                                (LinearOrder.toDecidableLT i bound) B ⊤ ⊥))
                            (x.bv_eq (label i)))
                          (bot_inf_eq (x.bv_eq (label i)))))
                      (inf_bot_eq context)))
                  (Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) order x y))
                Erdos597Object.BooleanIncreasingSequences.bounded_before_outside._simp_1_1)))
    hx

theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanOrderedSubsets.sequenceValue_spec : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (context : B) (domain order : Flypitch.bSet B) (names : Erdos597.One → Flypitch.bSet B),
  context ≤ Erdos597Object.BooleanOrderedSubsets.sequenceValue domain order names →
    (∀ (i : Erdos597.One), context ≤ (names i).mem domain) ∧
      (∀ (i j : Erdos597.One), i < j → context ≤ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) order (names i) (names j)) ∧
        ∀ (i j : Erdos597.One), i ≠ j → context ⊓ (names i).bv_eq (names j) = ⊥ :=
fun {B} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] context domain order names h =>
  ⟨fun i => LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans h inf_le_left) (iInf_le (fun i => (names i).mem domain) i),
    ⟨fun i j hij =>
      LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans h (LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_left))
        (LE.le.trans
          (iInf_le (fun i => ⨅ j, ⨅ (_ : i < j), Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) order (names i) (names j)) i)
          (LE.le.trans
            (iInf_le (fun j => ⨅ (_ : i < j), Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) order (names i) (names j)) j)
            (iInf_le (fun x => Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) order (names i) (names j)) hij))),
      fun i j hij =>
      have hnot :=
        LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans h (LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_right))
          (LE.le.trans (iInf_le (fun i => ⨅ j, ⨅ (_ : i ≠ j), ((names i).bv_eq (names j))ᶜ) i)
            (LE.le.trans (iInf_le (fun j => ⨅ (_ : i ≠ j), ((names i).bv_eq (names j))ᶜ) j)

@Erdos597Object.BooleanOrderMaps.blockOrder_no_two_way : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] (context : B)
  (x y : Flypitch.bSet B),
  context ≤ x.mem Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockDomain →
    context ≤ y.mem Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockDomain →
      context ⊓ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockOrder x y ⊓
          Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockOrder y x =
        ⊥
theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanOrderMaps.blockOrder_no_two_way : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (context : B) (x y : Flypitch.bSet B),
  context ≤ x.mem Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockDomain →
    context ≤ y.mem Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockDomain →
      context ⊓ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockOrder x y ⊓
          Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockOrder y x =
        ⊥ :=
fun {B} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] context x y hx hy =>
  let part :=
    context ⊓ Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockOrder x y ⊓
      Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockOrder y x;
  have hpart := LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_left;
  have hleft :=
    have h := LE.le.trans hpart hx;
    id
      (fun h =>
        Eq.mp
          (congrArg (LE.le part)
            (congrArg iSup (funext fun i => top_inf_eq (x.bv_eq (Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockLabel i)))))
          h)
      h;
  have hright :=
    have h := LE.le.trans hpart hy;
    id
      (fun h =>
        Eq.mp
          (congrArg (LE.le part)
            (congrArg iSup (funext fun i => top_inf_eq (y.bv_eq (Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockLabel i)))))
          h)
      h;
  bot_unique
    (LE.le.trans (le_inf le_rfl hleft)
      (Flypitch.lattice.bv_cases_right fun i =>
        LE.le.trans (le_inf le_rfl (LE.le.trans inf_le_left hright))
          (Flypitch.lattice.bv_cases_right fun j =>
            let joint :=
              part ⊓ x.bv_eq (Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockLabel i) ⊓
                y.bv_eq (Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockLabel j);
            have hxyOriginal :=
              LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_left) (LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_right);
            have hyxOriginal := LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_left) inf_le_right;
            have hxEqual := LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_right;
            have hyEqual := inf_le_right;
            have hxy := id (Flypitch.bSet.subst_congr_mem_left' (Flypitch.bSet.pair_congr hxEqual hyEqual) hxyOriginal);
            have hyx := id (Flypitch.bSet.subst_congr_mem_left' (Flypitch.bSet.pair_congr hyEqual hxEqual) hyxOriginal);
            if hij : Erdos597Object.BooleanBlockOrder.keyLess i j then
              LE.le.trans_eq hyx
                (of_eq_true
                  (Eq.trans
                    (congrFun'
                      (congrArg Eq
                        (Eq.trans (Erdos597Object.BooleanBlockOrder.blockOrder_edge j i)
                          ((fun x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3 =>

  Erdos597Object.BooleanBlockOrder.keyLess i j ∨ i = j ∨ Erdos597Object.BooleanBlockOrder.keyLess j i :=

          (fun y =>

@Erdos597Object.BooleanCountableDecision.decide_countably : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B],
  Flypitch.has_dense_omega_closed_subset B →
    ∀ (context : B) (weight : ℕ → I → B),
      context ≠ ⊥ →
        (∀ (n : ℕ), context ≤ ⨆ i, weight n i) →
          ∃ lower, lower ≠ ⊥ ∧ lower ≤ context ∧ ∃ choice, ∀ (n : ℕ), lower ≤ weight n (choice n)
theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanCountableDecision.decide_countably : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B],
  Flypitch.has_dense_omega_closed_subset B →
    ∀ (context : B) (weight : ℕ → I → B),
      context ≠ ⊥ →
        (∀ (n : ℕ), context ≤ ⨆ i, weight n i) →
          ∃ lower, lower ≠ ⊥ ∧ lower ≤ context ∧ ∃ choice, ∀ (n : ℕ), lower ≤ weight n (choice n) :=
fun {B I} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] hB context weight hne hcover =>
  Exists.casesOn hB fun D hD =>
    let State := fun n => { s // s.1 ∈ D ∧ s.1 ≤ context ∧ s.1 ≤ weight n s.2 };
    have next := fun n q hq hcontext =>
      Exists.casesOn
        (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeightedSupports.exists_nonzero_intersection q (weight n) hq
          (LE.le.trans hcontext (hcover n)))
        fun i hi =>
        Exists.casesOn (hD.left.right (q ⊓ weight n i) (bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.mpr hi)) fun r h =>
          And.casesOn h fun hr hrle =>
            Exists.intro
              ⟨(r, i), ⟨hr, ⟨LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans hrle inf_le_left) hcontext, LE.le.trans hrle inf_le_right⟩⟩⟩
              (LE.le.trans hrle inf_le_left);
    (fun step step_le =>
        let sequence := fun t =>
          Nat.rec (step 0 context hne le_rfl)
            (fun n previous =>
              step (n + 1) (↑previous).1
                (ne_of_gt (Flypitch.nonzero_of_mem_dense_omega_closed_subset hD previous.property.left))
                previous.property.right.left)
            t;
        have hchain := fun n =>
          step_le (n + 1) (↑(sequence n)).1
            (ne_of_gt (Flypitch.nonzero_of_mem_dense_omega_closed_subset hD (sequence n).property.left))
            (sequence n).property.right.left;
        let lower := ⨅ n, (↑(sequence n)).1;
        have hpositive :=
          Flypitch.nonzero_infi_of_mem_dense_omega_closed_subset hD hchain fun n => (sequence n).property.left;
        Exists.intro lower
          ⟨ne_of_gt hpositive,
            ⟨LE.le.trans (iInf_le (fun n => (↑(sequence n)).1) 0) (sequence 0).property.right.left,
              Exists.intro (fun n => (↑(sequence n)).2) fun n =>
                LE.le.trans (iInf_le (fun n => (↑(sequence n)).1) n) (sequence n).property.right.right⟩⟩)
      (fun n q a a_1 => Classical.choose (next n q a a_1)) fun n q a a_1 => Classical.choose_spec (next n q a a_1)

    (fun h h_1 => Exists.intro context ⟨hne, ⟨le_rfl, Exists.intro (fun j => isEmptyElim j) fun j => isEmptyElim j⟩⟩)

@Erdos597Object.BooleanCountableDecision.countable_of_constant_cover : ∀ {B I : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B],
  Flypitch.has_dense_omega_closed_subset B →
    ∀ (context : B), context ≠ ⊥ → (Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.HasCountableCover fun x => context) → Countable I
theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanCountableDecision.countable_of_constant_cover : ∀ {B I : Type}
  [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B],
  Flypitch.has_dense_omega_closed_subset B →
    ∀ (context : B), context ≠ ⊥ → (Erdos597Object.BooleanIteration.HasCountableCover fun x => context) → Countable I :=
fun {B I} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] hB context hne hcover =>
  Exists.casesOn hcover fun rows h =>
    And.casesOn h fun hdisjoint hrows =>
      let weight := fun n option =>
        match option with
        | none => (⨆ i, rows n i)ᶜ
        | some i => rows n i;
      have hfull := fun n =>
        Trans.trans (of_eq_true (Eq.trans (congrArg (LE.le context) sup_compl_eq_top) le_top._simp_2))
          (sup_le (iSup_le fun i => le_iSup_of_le (some i) le_rfl) (le_iSup_of_le none le_rfl));
      Exists.casesOn (Erdos597Object.BooleanCountableDecision.decide_countably hB context weight hne hfull)
        fun lower h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hlower right =>
          And.casesOn right fun hbase right =>
            Exists.casesOn right fun choice hchoice =>
              have hcovered := fun i =>
                Decidable.byContradiction fun hmissing =>
                  have hzero := fun n =>
                    Option.casesOn (motive := fun t => choice n = t → lower ⊓ rows n i = ⊥) (choice n)
                      (fun h =>
                        Eq.ndrec (motive := fun x => choice n = x → lower ⊓ rows n i = ⊥)
                          (fun hoption =>
                            have hnone :=
                              Eq.mp
                                (congrArg (LE.le lower)
                                  (congrArg
                                    ((fun n option =>
                                        match option with
                                        | none => (⨆ i, rows n i)ᶜ
                                        | some i => rows n i)
                                      n)
                                    hoption))
                                (hchoice n);
                            bot_unique
                              (LE.le.trans_eq
                                (le_inf (LE.le.trans inf_le_left hnone) (LE.le.trans inf_le_right (le_iSup (rows n) i)))
                                compl_inf_eq_bot))
                          (Eq.symm h) (Eq.refl (choice n)))
                      (fun j h =>
                        Eq.ndrec (motive := fun x => choice n = x → lower ⊓ rows n i = ⊥)
                          (fun hoption =>
                            have hji := fun h =>
                              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun j => choice n = some j → False)
                                (fun hoption => hmissing (Exists.intro n hoption)) (Eq.symm h) hoption;
                            have hsome :=
                              Eq.mp
                                (congrArg (LE.le lower)
                                  (congrArg
                                    ((fun n option =>
                                        match option with
                                        | none => (⨆ i, rows n i)ᶜ
                                        | some i => rows n i)
                                      n)
                                    hoption))
                                (hchoice n);
                            bot_unique
                              (LE.le.trans_eq (le_inf (LE.le.trans inf_le_left hsome) inf_le_right)
                                (hdisjoint n j i hji)))
                          (Eq.symm h) (Eq.refl (choice n)))
                      (Eq.refl (choice n));
                  have hle :=
                    Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => lower ≤ _a) (Eq.symm (inf_iSup_eq lower fun n => rows n i))))
                      (le_inf le_rfl (LE.le.trans hbase (hrows i)));
                  hlower
                    (bot_unique
                      (Eq.mp
                        (congrArg (LE.le lower)
                          (Eq.trans (congrArg iSup (funext fun n => (fun n => hzero n) n)) iSup_bot))
                        hle));
              (fun code hcode =>

@Erdos597Object.BooleanFunctionReflection.function_eq_of_total_subset : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (domain codomain f g : Flypitch.bSet B),
  ∀ context ≤ domain.is_function codomain f,
    context ≤ domain.is_total codomain g → context ≤ g.subset f → context ≤ g.bv_eq f
theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanFunctionReflection.function_eq_of_total_subset : ∀ {B : Type}
  [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] (domain codomain f g : Flypitch.bSet B),
  ∀ context ≤ domain.is_function codomain f,
    context ≤ domain.is_total codomain g → context ≤ g.subset f → context ≤ g.bv_eq f :=
fun {B} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] domain codomain f g context hfunction htotal hsubset =>
  Flypitch.bSet.subset_ext hsubset
    (Flypitch.bSet.subset_intro fun i =>
      let base := context ⊓ f.bval i;
      have hbase := inf_le_left;
      have hmem := LE.le.trans inf_le_right (Flypitch.bSet.mem.mk' f i);
      have hprod :=
        Flypitch.bSet.mem_of_mem_subset' (LE.le.trans hbase (Flypitch.bSet.subset_prod_of_is_function hfunction)) hmem;
      LE.le.trans
        (le_inf le_rfl
          (Eq.mp
            (congrArg (fun _a => base ≤ _a)
              (Erdos597Object.BooleanFunctionBridge.product_membership domain codomain (f.func i)))
            hprod))
        (Flypitch.lattice.bv_cases_right fun x =>
          Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrFun'
                (congrArg LE.le
                  (Eq.trans
                    (congrArg (min base)
                      (inf_iSup_eq (x.mem domain) fun i_1 => i_1.mem codomain ⊓ (f.func i).bv_eq (x.pair i_1)))
                    (inf_iSup_eq base fun i_1 => x.mem domain ⊓ (i_1.mem codomain ⊓ (f.func i).bv_eq (x.pair i_1)))))
                ((f.func i).mem g)))
            (iSup_le fun y =>
              let part := base ⊓ (x.mem domain ⊓ (y.mem codomain ⊓ (f.func i).bv_eq (x.pair y)));
              id
                (have hpart := LE.le.trans inf_le_left hbase;
                have hx := LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_left;
                have heq := LE.le.trans inf_le_right (LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_right);
                have hpairF := Flypitch.bSet.subst_congr_mem_left' heq (LE.le.trans inf_le_left hmem);
                have hcover :=
                  Flypitch.lattice.bv_context_apply
                    (LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans hpart htotal)
                      (iInf_le
                        (fun w₁ => Flypitch.lattice.imp (w₁.mem domain) (⨆ w₂, w₂.mem codomain ⊓ (w₁.pair w₂).mem g))
                        x))
                    hx;
                LE.le.trans (le_inf le_rfl hcover)
                  (Flypitch.lattice.bv_cases_right fun output =>
                    let piece := part ⊓ (output.mem codomain ⊓ (x.pair output).mem g);
                    id
                      (have hpiece := LE.le.trans inf_le_left hpart;
                      have hpairG := LE.le.trans inf_le_right inf_le_right;
                      have hpairF' := Flypitch.bSet.mem_of_mem_subset' (LE.le.trans hpiece hsubset) hpairG;
                      have houtput :=
                        Flypitch.bSet.eq_of_is_func_of_eq
                          (Flypitch.bSet.is_func_of_is_func'
                            (Flypitch.bSet.is_func'_of_is_function (LE.le.trans hpiece hfunction)))
                          Flypitch.bSet.bv_refl (LE.le.trans inf_le_left hpairF) hpairF';
                      have hpairEq := Flypitch.bSet.pair_congr Flypitch.bSet.bv_refl houtput;
                      have hzEq := Flypitch.bSet.bv_trans (LE.le.trans inf_le_left heq) hpairEq;
                      Flypitch.bSet.subst_congr_mem_left' (Flypitch.bSet.bv_symm hzEq) hpairG))))))

@Erdos597Object.BooleanFunctionReflection.reflect_function : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B],
  Flypitch.has_dense_omega_closed_subset B →
    ∀ (codomain : Flypitch.pSet) (f : Flypitch.bSet B) (context : B),
      context ≠ ⊥ →
        context ≤ (Flypitch.bSet.check PSet.omega).is_function (Flypitch.bSet.check codomain) f →
          ∃ ground lower,
            lower ≠ ⊥ ∧
              lower ≤ context ∧
                lower ≤ (Flypitch.bSet.check ground).bv_eq f ∧ Flypitch.pSet.is_func PSet.omega codomain ground
theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanFunctionReflection.reflect_function : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B],
  Flypitch.has_dense_omega_closed_subset B →
    ∀ (codomain : Flypitch.pSet) (f : Flypitch.bSet B) (context : B),
      context ≠ ⊥ →
        context ≤ (Flypitch.bSet.check PSet.omega).is_function (Flypitch.bSet.check codomain) f →
          ∃ ground lower,
            lower ≠ ⊥ ∧
              lower ≤ context ∧
                lower ≤ (Flypitch.bSet.check ground).bv_eq f ∧ Flypitch.pSet.is_func PSet.omega codomain ground :=
fun {B} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] hB codomain f context hne hfunction =>
  let weight := fun n j =>
    ((Flypitch.bSet.check (PSet.omega.Func { down := n })).pair (Flypitch.bSet.check (codomain.Func j))).mem f;
  have hcover := fun n =>
    Erdos597Object.BooleanFunctionReflection.checked_total_cover PSet.omega codomain f context hfunction { down := n };
  Exists.casesOn (Erdos597Object.BooleanCountableDecision.decide_countably hB context weight hne hcover) fun lower h =>
    And.casesOn h fun hlower right =>
      And.casesOn right fun hbase right =>
        Exists.casesOn right fun choice hchoice =>
          let ground := Flypitch.pSet.function.mk fun i => codomain.Func (choice i.down);
          have hground :=
            Flypitch.pSet.function.mk_is_func (fun i => codomain.Func (choice i.down)) (fun i => Flypitch.pSet.mem_mk')
              fun i j hij =>
              have heq := Flypitch.pSet.omega_inj hij;
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun j =>
                (PSet.omega.Func i).Equiv (PSet.omega.Func j) →
                  (codomain.Func (choice i.down)).Equiv (codomain.Func (choice j.down)))
                (fun hij => PSet.Equiv.rfl) heq hij;
          have hsubset :=
            Flypitch.bSet.subset_intro fun i =>
              let i' := cast Flypitch.bSet.check_type i;
              id
                (Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg (fun _a => lower ⊓ _a ≤ ((Flypitch.bSet.check ground).func i).mem f)
                      (Flypitch.bSet.check_bval i)))
                  (Eq.mpr
                    (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ≤ ((Flypitch.bSet.check ground).func i).mem f) (inf_top_eq lower)))
                    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => lower ≤ _a.mem f) (Flypitch.bSet.check_func i)))
                      (id
                        (ULift.casesOn (motive := fun t =>
                          i' = t → lower ≤ (Flypitch.bSet.check (ground.Func i')).mem f) i'
                          (fun n h =>
                            Eq.symm h ▸
                              Flypitch.bSet.subst_congr_mem_left' (Flypitch.bSet.bv_symm Flypitch.bSet.check_pair)
                                (hchoice n))
                          (Eq.refl i'))))));
          Exists.intro ground
            (Exists.intro lower
              ⟨hlower,
                ⟨hbase,
                  ⟨Erdos597Object.BooleanFunctionReflection.function_eq_of_total_subset (Flypitch.bSet.check PSet.omega)
                      (Flypitch.bSet.check codomain) f (Flypitch.bSet.check ground) lower (LE.le.trans hbase hfunction)
                      (Flypitch.bSet.is_total_of_is_function (Flypitch.bSet.check_is_func hground)) hsubset,
                    hground⟩⟩⟩)

theorem Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.requests_covers : ∀ (schedule : Erdos597.One → Erdos597.Pattern)
  (a b index : Erdos597.One) (hindex : index < b) (hrow : ∀ (k : ℕ), a < (schedule index).row k)
  (hcolumn : ∀ (k m : ℕ), (schedule index).column k m < b),
  Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.requests schedule a b (Encodable.encode ⟨index, hindex⟩) =
    some ⟨schedule index, ⋯⟩ :=

  of_eq_true
    (Eq.trans
      (congrFun'
        (congrArg Eq
          (Eq.trans
            (Option.bind_congr' (Encodable.encodek ⟨index, hindex⟩) fun a_1 a_2 =>
              Eq.refl
                (if h : (∀ (k : ℕ), a < (schedule ↑a_1).row k) ∧ ∀ (k m : ℕ), (schedule ↑a_1).column k m < b then
                  some ⟨schedule ↑a_1, h⟩
                else none))
            (dite_eq_left_of_eq_true
              (Eq.trans
                (congr (congrArg And (Eq.trans (forall_congr fun k => (fun k => eq_true (hrow k)) k) (implies_true ℕ)))
                  (Eq.trans
                    (forall_congr fun k =>
                      Eq.trans (forall_congr fun m => (fun k m => eq_true (hcolumn k m)) k m) (implies_true ℕ))
                    (implies_true ℕ)))
                (and_self True)))))
        (some ⟨schedule index, ⟨hrow, hcolumn⟩⟩))
      (eq_self
        (some
          ⟨schedule index,
            of_eq_true
              (Eq.trans
                (congr (congrArg And (Eq.trans (forall_congr fun k => (fun k => eq_true (hrow k)) k) (implies_true ℕ)))
                  (Eq.trans
                    (forall_congr fun k =>
                      Eq.trans (forall_congr fun m => (fun k m => eq_true (hcolumn k m)) k m) (implies_true ℕ))
                    (implies_true ℕ)))
                (and_self True))⟩)))

    Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.requests left a b = Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.requests right a b

    Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.requests left a b = Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.requests right a b :=

  funext fun n =>
    id
      (Option.casesOn (motive := fun t =>
        Encodable.decode n = t →

                some ⟨left ↑index, h⟩

                some ⟨right ↑index, h⟩

          Eq.ndrec (motive := fun x =>
            Encodable.decode n = x →
              (x.bind fun index =>
                  if h : (∀ (k : ℕ), a < (left ↑index).row k) ∧ ∀ (k m : ℕ), (left ↑index).column k m < b then
                    some ⟨left ↑index, h⟩
                  else none) =
                x.bind fun index =>
                  if h : (∀ (k : ℕ), a < (right ↑index).row k) ∧ ∀ (k m : ℕ), (right ↑index).column k m < b then
                    some ⟨right ↑index, h⟩
                  else none)

              Eq.refl
                (none.bind fun index =>
                  if h : (∀ (k : ℕ), a < (left ↑index).row k) ∧ ∀ (k m : ℕ), (left ↑index).column k m < b then
                    some ⟨left ↑index, h⟩

        (fun index h =>
          Eq.ndrec (motive := fun x =>
            Encodable.decode n = x →

                    some ⟨left ↑index, h⟩

                x.bind fun index =>

                    some ⟨right ↑index, h⟩

theorem Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.avoids : ∀ (schedule : Erdos597.One → Erdos597.Pattern)
  (code : Erdos597.RowCodes) {x u v : Erdos597.Vertex},
  Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.out schedule code x u →
    Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.out schedule code x v →
      Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.stage schedule code x u <
          Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.stage schedule code x v →
        ¬Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.previousRelation code x.2

    (fun hu =>
      id
        (fun hv =>
          id

                      Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.family schedule code c)
                    (Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.requests schedule x.1 x.2))
                  (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a.out u) heq) hu))
                (Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.Neighborhood.stage_spec
                  (Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.neighborhood code x.1 x.2

        hv)
    hu

Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.reversal : ∀ (schedule : Erdos597.One → Erdos597.Pattern) (code : Erdos597.RowCodes)
  {x u v : Erdos597.Vertex},
  Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.out schedule code x u →
    Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.out schedule code x v →
      Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.out schedule code u v →
        Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.stage schedule code x v <
          Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.stage schedule code x u
theorem Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.reversal : ∀ (schedule : Erdos597.One → Erdos597.Pattern)
  (code : Erdos597.RowCodes) {x u v : Erdos597.Vertex},
  Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.out schedule code x u →
    Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.out schedule code x v →
      Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.out schedule code u v →
        Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.stage schedule code x v <
          Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.stage schedule code x u :=
fun schedule code {x u v} hu hv huv =>
  Decidable.byContradiction fun h =>
    Or.casesOn (lt_or_eq_of_le (le_of_not_gt h))
      (fun hlt =>
        Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.avoids schedule code hu hv hlt
          (Exists.intro (Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.nested schedule code hu).right.right huv))
      fun heq =>
      have huvEq :=
        Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.Neighborhood.eq_of_stage_eq
          (Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.family schedule code x.2 x.1) hu hv heq;
      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {v} =>
        Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.out schedule code x v →
          Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.out schedule code u v →
            ¬Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.stage schedule code x v <
                  Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.stage schedule code x u →
              Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.stage schedule code x u =
                  Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.stage schedule code x v →
                False)
        (fun hv huv h heq => Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.loopless schedule code u huv) huvEq hv huv h heq
'Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.reversal' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]

theorem Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.hits_index : ∀ (schedule : Erdos597.One → Erdos597.Pattern)
  (code : Erdos597.RowCodes) (index a b : Erdos597.One),

    (∀ (k : ℕ), a < (schedule index).row k) →
      (∀ (k m : ℕ), (schedule index).column k m < b) →

          (Erdos597Object.ScheduledSparseGraph.rules schedule code).graph.Adj (a, b) ((schedule index).point i j) :=

          (Eq.trans
            (Eq.trans
              (congrArg Not

                  (funext fun index => Eq.trans (congrArg Not (PFun.mem_dom._simp_1 p.f index)) not_exists._simp_1)))
              not_exists._simp_1)

          h);

Erdos597Object.PatternCollapse.entry_onto : ∀ (pattern : Erdos597.Pattern),
  ⨆ index, Erdos597Object.PatternCollapse.entry index pattern = ⊤
theorem Erdos597Object.PatternCollapse.entry_onto : ∀ (pattern : Erdos597.Pattern),
  ⨆ index, Erdos597Object.PatternCollapse.entry index pattern = ⊤ :=
fun pattern =>
  top_unique
    (Decidable.byContradiction fun hnot =>
      let all := ⨆ index, Erdos597Object.PatternCollapse.entry index pattern;
      have hne := fun hzero => hnot (Eq.ge (compl_eq_bot.mp hzero));
      Exists.casesOn (Flypitch.collapse_poset.collapse_poset_dense (bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.mpr hne)) fun p hp =>
        Exists.casesOn (Erdos597Object.PatternCollapse.fresh_index p) fun index hindex =>
          let singleton :=
            Flypitch.collapse_poset.singleton_collapse_poset index pattern Flypitch.collapse_poset.one_lt_succ_aleph0;
          have hcompatible := fun x hp hq =>
            have hx :=
              Eq.mp
                (Eq.trans
                  (congrFun'
                    (congrArg Membership.mem
                      (Eq.trans
                        (congrArg PFun.Dom
                          (congrArg Flypitch.collapse_poset.f
                            (Flypitch.collapse_poset.singleton_collapse_poset.eq_1 index pattern
                              Flypitch.collapse_poset.one_lt_succ_aleph0)))
                        Flypitch.collapse_poset.pfun_singleton_dom))
                    x)
                  Erdos597Object.PatternCollapse.entry_onto._simp_1_2)
                hq;
            False.elim (hindex (hx ▸ hp));
          have hbelow := Erdos597Object.PatternCollapse.union_below p singleton hcompatible;
          have hin :=
            LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans hbelow inf_le_right)
              (le_iSup (fun index => Erdos597Object.PatternCollapse.entry index pattern) index);
          have hout := LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans hbelow inf_le_left) hp;
          Flypitch.collapse_poset.inclusion_ne_bot (p.union singleton)
            (bot_unique (LE.le.trans_eq (le_inf hin hout) inf_compl_eq_bot)))

Erdos597Object.BooleanScheduledGraph.coefficient_of_adj : ∀ (bound : Erdos597.One)
  (schedule : Erdos597.One → Erdos597.Pattern) (x y : Erdos597.Vertex),
  x.2 ≤ bound →

      hnot
        (have hle := le_compl_iff_disjoint_right.mpr (disjoint_iff.mpr hzero);
        Eq.mp (congrArg (LE.le context) (compl_compl cover)) hle);

    have hbounded := fun row =>

        LE.le.trans inf_le_right
          (compl_le_compl
            (le_iSup (fun r => Erdos597Object.BooleanUnboundedRows.unboundedValue fun column => weight (r, column))
              ↑row));

      (Erdos597Object.BooleanCountableDecision.decide_countable_family hB part
        (fun row bound => (Erdos597Object.BooleanUnboundedRows.tailValue (fun column => weight (↑row, column)) bound)ᶜ)
        hpart hbounded)

      And.casesOn h fun hlower right =>
        And.casesOn right fun hbase right =>
          Exists.casesOn right fun bounds hbounds =>
            Exists.casesOn (Erdos597.countable_family_bounded bounds) fun columnBound hcolumnBound =>
              have hsupport :=
                (fun h =>
                    Set.Countable.mono h
                      (Set.Countable.prod (Erdos597.countable_initial_segment rowBound)
                        (Erdos597.countable_initial_segment columnBound)))

                    Decidable.byContradiction fun h =>
                      have hz := hrows v (lt_of_not_ge h);

                        Erdos597Object.BooleanUnboundedRows.weight_le_tail (fun column => weight (↑row, column))

              have hsmall :=
                Erdos597Object.BooleanWeightedSupports.countable_of_countable_support lower label hdiscrete weight
                  hsupport;

                          (Erdos597Object.BooleanColumns.columnEquiv.symm u.2)
                          (Erdos597Object.BooleanColumns.columnEquiv.symm v.2))))

theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.vertex_after_row : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (u v : Erdos597.Vertex),
  v.1 < u.1 →
    Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.squareOrder

@Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.row_lt_of_unbounded_before : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (context : B),
  context ≠ ⊥ →
    ∀ (row : Erdos597.One) (weight : Erdos597.One → B) (v : Erdos597.Vertex),
      context ≤ Erdos597Object.BooleanUnboundedRows.unboundedValue weight →
        (∀ (column : Erdos597.One),
            context ⊓ weight column ≤
              Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.squareOrder
                (Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.vertexLabel (row, column))
                (Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.vertexLabel v)) →
          row < v.1
theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.row_lt_of_unbounded_before : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (context : B),
  context ≠ ⊥ →
    ∀ (row : Erdos597.One) (weight : Erdos597.One → B) (v : Erdos597.Vertex),
      context ≤ Erdos597Object.BooleanUnboundedRows.unboundedValue weight →
        (∀ (column : Erdos597.One),
            context ⊓ weight column ≤
              Erdos597Object.edgeValue (Flypitch.V B) Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.squareOrder
                (Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.vertexLabel (row, column))
                (Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.vertexLabel v)) →
          row < v.1 :=
fun {B} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] context hne row weight v hunbounded hbefore =>
  Decidable.byContradiction fun hrow =>
    have hzero := fun column hcolumn =>
      have hnot := fun a => Or.casesOn a (fun h => hrow h) fun h => And.casesOn h fun left h => lt_asymm hcolumn h;
      have hedge :=
        Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = ⊥) (Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.vertex_order_edge (row, column) v)))
          (of_eq_true
            (Eq.trans
              (congrFun'
                (congrArg Eq
                  (Eq.trans (ite_congr (eq_false hnot) (fun a => Eq.refl ⊤) fun a => Eq.refl ⊥) (ite_false ⊤ ⊥)))
                ⊥)
              (eq_self ⊥)));
      bot_unique (LE.le.trans_eq (hbefore column) hedge);
    have htail := LE.le.trans hunbounded (Erdos597Object.BooleanUnboundedRows.unbounded_le_tail weight v.2);
    have hle :=
      Eq.mp
        (congrArg (LE.le context)
          (Eq.trans (inf_iSup_eq context fun i => ⨆ (_ : v.2 < i), weight i)
            (congrArg iSup (funext fun i => inf_iSup_eq context fun i_1 => weight i))))
        (le_inf le_rfl htail);
    have hz := bot_unique (iSup_le fun column => iSup_le fun h => Eq.le (hzero column h));
    hne (bot_unique (LE.le.trans_eq hle hz))

@Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.value_mem_image : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] (context : B)

  context ≤ (values i).mem Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.squareDomain →
    context ≤ (values i).mem (Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.imageName values)
theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.value_mem_image : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] (context : B)
  (values : Erdos597.One → Flypitch.bSet B) (i : Erdos597.One),
  context ≤ (values i).mem Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.squareDomain →
    context ≤ (values i).mem (Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.imageName values) :=
fun {B} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] context values i hmember =>
  have hcovered :=
    Flypitch.bSet.subst_congr_mem_right'
      (LE.le.trans le_top (Flypitch.bSet.bv_symm Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.vertexLabel_domain)) hmember;
  id
    (fun hcovered =>
      LE.le.trans
        (le_inf le_rfl
          (Eq.mp
            (congrArg (LE.le context)
              (congrArg iSup
                (funext fun i_1 => top_inf_eq ((values i).bv_eq (Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.vertexLabel i_1)))))
            (Eq.mp
              (congrArg (fun _a => context ≤ _a)
                (Erdos597Object.BooleanSets.member_weightedSet Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.vertexLabel (fun x => ⊤)
                  (values i)))
              hcovered)))
        (Flypitch.lattice.bv_cases_right fun v => le_iSup_of_le v (le_inf (le_iSup_of_le i inf_le_right) inf_le_right)))
    hcovered

theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.image_uncountable : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B],
  Flypitch.has_dense_omega_closed_subset B →
    ∀ (context : B) (values : Erdos597.One → Flypitch.bSet B),
      (∀ (i : Erdos597.One), context ≤ (values i).mem Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.squareDomain) →
        (∀ (i j : Erdos597.One), i ≠ j → context ⊓ (values i).bv_eq (values j) = ⊥) →
          context ≤
            (Erdos597Object.injectsIntoValue (Flypitch.V B) (Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.imageName values)
                Flypitch.bSet.omega)ᶜ :=
fun {B} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] hB context values hmembers hdiscrete =>
  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a) (propext le_compl_iff_disjoint_right)))
    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a) (propext disjoint_iff)))
      (Decidable.byContradiction fun hne =>
        let part :=
          context ⊓
            Erdos597Object.injectsIntoValue (Flypitch.V B) (Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.imageName values)
              Flypitch.bSet.omega;
        have hpart := hne;
        have hbase := inf_le_left;
        have hseparate := fun i j hij =>
          bot_unique
            (LE.le.trans_eq (le_inf (LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_left) hbase) inf_le_right)

              (fun i =>
                LE.le.trans hbase (Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.value_mem_image context values i (hmembers i)))
              hseparate inf_le_right);
        not_countable hcount))

@Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.image_pair_transfer : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] (context : B)
  (left right : Erdos597.One → Flypitch.bSet B) (predicate : Flypitch.bSet B → Flypitch.bSet B → B),
  (∀ (y : Flypitch.bSet B), Flypitch.bSet.B_ext fun x => predicate x y) →
    (∀ (x : Flypitch.bSet B), Flypitch.bSet.B_ext (predicate x)) →
      (∀ (i j : Erdos597.One), context ≤ predicate (left i) (right j)) →
        ∀ (u v : Erdos597.Vertex),
          context ⊓ Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.imageWeight left u ⊓
              Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.imageWeight right v ≤
            predicate (Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.vertexLabel u) (Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.vertexLabel v)
theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.image_pair_transfer : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  (context : B) (left right : Erdos597.One → Flypitch.bSet B) (predicate : Flypitch.bSet B → Flypitch.bSet B → B),
  (∀ (y : Flypitch.bSet B), Flypitch.bSet.B_ext fun x => predicate x y) →
    (∀ (x : Flypitch.bSet B), Flypitch.bSet.B_ext (predicate x)) →
      (∀ (i j : Erdos597.One), context ≤ predicate (left i) (right j)) →
        ∀ (u v : Erdos597.Vertex),
          context ⊓ Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.imageWeight left u ⊓
              Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.imageWeight right v ≤
            predicate (Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.vertexLabel u) (Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.vertexLabel v) :=
fun {B} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] context left right predicate hleft hright hvalues u v =>
  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrFun'
        (congrArg LE.le
          (Eq.trans
            (Eq.trans
              (congrFun'
                (congrArg min
                  (inf_iSup_eq context fun i => (left i).bv_eq (Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.vertexLabel u)))
                (⨆ i, (right i).bv_eq (Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.vertexLabel v)))
              (inf_iSup_eq (⨆ i, context ⊓ (left i).bv_eq (Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.vertexLabel u)) fun i =>
                (right i).bv_eq (Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.vertexLabel v)))
            (congrArg iSup
              (funext fun i =>
                iSup_inf_eq (fun i => context ⊓ (left i).bv_eq (Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.vertexLabel u))
                  ((right i).bv_eq (Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.vertexLabel v))))))
        (predicate (Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.vertexLabel u) (Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.vertexLabel v))))
    (iSup_le fun j =>
      iSup_le fun i =>
        let part :=
          context ⊓ (left i).bv_eq (Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.vertexLabel u) ⊓
            (right j).bv_eq (Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.vertexLabel v);
        have hbase := LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_left;
        have hu := LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_right;
        have hv := inf_le_right;
        have hfirst :=
          LE.le.trans (le_inf hu (LE.le.trans hbase (hvalues i j)))
            (hleft (right j) (left i) (Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.vertexLabel u));
        LE.le.trans (le_inf hv hfirst)
          (hright (Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.vertexLabel u) (right j)
            (Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.vertexLabel v)))

@Erdos597Object.BooleanUnboundedSequences.select_sequence : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B],
  Flypitch.has_dense_omega_closed_subset B →
    ∀ (context : B) (weight : Erdos597.One → B) (lowerBound : Erdos597.One),
      context ≠ ⊥ →
        context ≤ Erdos597Object.BooleanUnboundedRows.unboundedValue weight →
          ∃ lower,
            lower ≠ ⊥ ∧
              lower ≤ context ∧
                ∃ sequence,
                  StrictMono sequence ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ), lowerBound < sequence n) ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ), lower ≤ weight (sequence n)
theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanUnboundedSequences.select_sequence : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B],
  Flypitch.has_dense_omega_closed_subset B →
    ∀ (context : B) (weight : Erdos597.One → B) (lowerBound : Erdos597.One),
      context ≠ ⊥ →
        context ≤ Erdos597Object.BooleanUnboundedRows.unboundedValue weight →
          ∃ lower,
            lower ≠ ⊥ ∧
              lower ≤ context ∧
                ∃ sequence,
                  StrictMono sequence ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ), lowerBound < sequence n) ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ), lower ≤ weight (sequence n) :=
fun {B} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] hB context weight lowerBound hne hunbounded =>
  Exists.casesOn hB fun D hD =>
    let State := { s // s.1 ∈ D ∧ s.1 ≤ context ∧ s.1 ≤ weight s.2 ∧ lowerBound < s.2 };
    have next := fun q hq hcontext bound hbound =>
      have hcover :=
        LE.le.trans
          (LE.le.trans hcontext
            (LE.le.trans hunbounded (Erdos597Object.BooleanUnboundedRows.unbounded_le_tail weight bound)))
          (iSup_le fun i => iSup_le fun hi => le_iSup_of_le ⟨i, hi⟩ le_rfl);
      Exists.casesOn
        (Erdos597Object.BooleanWeightedSupports.exists_nonzero_intersection q (fun i => weight ↑i) hq hcover)
        fun i hi =>
        Exists.casesOn (hD.left.right (q ⊓ weight ↑i) (bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.mpr hi)) fun r h =>
          And.casesOn h fun hr hle =>
            Exists.intro
              ⟨(r, ↑i),
                ⟨hr,
                  ⟨LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans hle inf_le_left) hcontext,
                    ⟨LE.le.trans hle inf_le_right, LE.le.trans_lt hbound i.property⟩⟩⟩⟩
              ⟨LE.le.trans hle inf_le_left, i.property⟩;
    (fun step x =>
        let states := fun t =>
          Nat.rec (step context hne le_rfl lowerBound le_rfl)
            (fun x previous =>
              step (↑previous).1
                (ne_of_gt (Flypitch.nonzero_of_mem_dense_omega_closed_subset hD previous.property.left))
                previous.property.right.left (↑previous).2 (LT.lt.le previous.property.right.right.right))
            t;
        have hchain := fun n =>
          (fun q a a_1 bound a_2 => (x q a a_1 bound a_2).left) (↑(states n)).1
            (ne_of_gt (Flypitch.nonzero_of_mem_dense_omega_closed_subset hD (states n).property.left))
            (states n).property.right.left (↑(states n)).2 (LT.lt.le (states n).property.right.right.right);
        have hstrict :=
          strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ fun n =>
            (fun q a a_1 bound a_2 => (x q a a_1 bound a_2).right) (↑(states n)).1
              (ne_of_gt (Flypitch.nonzero_of_mem_dense_omega_closed_subset hD (states n).property.left))
              (states n).property.right.left (↑(states n)).2 (LT.lt.le (states n).property.right.right.right);
        let lower := ⨅ n, (↑(states n)).1;
        have hpositive :=
          Flypitch.nonzero_infi_of_mem_dense_omega_closed_subset hD hchain fun n => (states n).property.left;
        Exists.intro lower
          ⟨ne_of_gt hpositive,
            ⟨LE.le.trans (iInf_le (fun n => (↑(states n)).1) 0) (states 0).property.right.left,
              Exists.intro (fun n => (↑(states n)).2)
                ⟨hstrict,
                  ⟨fun n => (states n).property.right.right.right, fun n =>
                    LE.le.trans (iInf_le (fun n => (↑(states n)).1) n) (states n).property.right.right.left⟩⟩⟩⟩)
      (fun q a a_1 bound a_2 => Classical.choose (next q a a_1 bound a_2)) fun q a a_1 bound a_2 =>
      Classical.choose_spec (next q a a_1 bound a_2)
'Erdos597Object.BooleanUnboundedSequences.select_sequence' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
@Erdos597Object.BooleanUnboundedSequences.increasing_sequences_cover : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B],
  Flypitch.has_dense_omega_closed_subset B →
    ∀ (weight : Erdos597.One → B) (lowerBound : Erdos597.One),
      Erdos597Object.BooleanUnboundedRows.unboundedValue weight ≤
        Erdos597Object.BooleanUnboundedSequences.sequenceCover weight lowerBound
theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanUnboundedSequences.increasing_sequences_cover : ∀ {B : Type}
  [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B],
  Flypitch.has_dense_omega_closed_subset B →
    ∀ (weight : Erdos597.One → B) (lowerBound : Erdos597.One),
      Erdos597Object.BooleanUnboundedRows.unboundedValue weight ≤
        Erdos597Object.BooleanUnboundedSequences.sequenceCover weight lowerBound :=
fun {B} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] hB weight lowerBound =>
  Decidable.byContradiction fun hnot =>
    let context :=
      Erdos597Object.BooleanUnboundedRows.unboundedValue weight ⊓
        (Erdos597Object.BooleanUnboundedSequences.sequenceCover weight lowerBound)ᶜ;
    have hne := fun hzero =>
      hnot
        (have hle := le_compl_iff_disjoint_right.mpr (disjoint_iff.mpr hzero);
        Eq.mp
          (congrArg (LE.le (Erdos597Object.BooleanUnboundedRows.unboundedValue weight))
            (compl_compl (Erdos597Object.BooleanUnboundedSequences.sequenceCover weight lowerBound)))
          hle);
    Exists.casesOn
      (Erdos597Object.BooleanUnboundedSequences.select_sequence hB context weight lowerBound hne inf_le_left)
      fun lower h =>
      And.casesOn h fun hlower right =>
        And.casesOn right fun hbase right =>
          Exists.casesOn right fun sequence h =>
            And.casesOn h fun hstrict right =>
              And.casesOn right fun habove hweights =>
                have hin := le_iSup_of_le sequence (le_iSup_of_le ⟨hstrict, habove⟩ (le_iInf hweights));
                hlower (bot_unique (LE.le.trans_eq (le_inf hin (LE.le.trans hbase inf_le_right)) inf_compl_eq_bot))

        (fun col => Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.imageWeight (F.values n) (rows n, col)) (rows (n + 1), column)
        (LE.le.trans inf_le_left (hrows n)) fun col =>

          (le_inf (le_inf (LE.le.trans (LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_left) hcontext) inf_le_right)
            (LE.le.trans inf_le_left inf_le_right))
          (Erdos597Object.BooleanRedCopyFamilies.Family.images_before F n (n + 1) (Nat.lt_succ_self n) (rows n, col)

theorem Erdos597Object.BooleanRedRowSelection.extract_pattern : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra B]
  {context : B} {blue : Flypitch.bSet B} (F : Erdos597Object.BooleanRedCopyFamilies.Family context blue),
  Flypitch.has_dense_omega_closed_subset B →
    context ≠ ⊥ →
      ∃ lower,
        lower ≠ ⊥ ∧
          lower ≤ context ∧
            ∃ firstRow pattern,
              (∀ (n : ℕ), firstRow < pattern.row n) ∧
                (lower ≤
                    Erdos597Object.BooleanUnboundedRows.unboundedValue fun column =>
                      Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.imageWeight (F.values 0) (firstRow, column)) ∧
                  ∀ (n m : ℕ),
                    lower ≤ Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.imageWeight (F.values (n + 1)) (pattern.point n m) :=
fun {B} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra B] {context} {blue} F hB hne =>
  Exists.casesOn (Erdos597Object.BooleanRedRowSelection.select_rows F hB hne) fun base h =>
    And.casesOn h fun hbase right =>
      And.casesOn right fun hcontext right =>
        Exists.casesOn right fun rows hrows =>
          have hrowStrict :=
            Erdos597Object.BooleanRedRowSelection.selected_rows_increasing F base hbase hcontext rows hrows;
          let weight := fun n sequence =>
            ⨆ (_ : StrictMono sequence ∧ ∀ (m : ℕ), rows (n + 1) < sequence m),
              ⨅ m, Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.imageWeight (F.values (n + 1)) (rows (n + 1), sequence m);
          have hcover := fun n =>
            LE.le.trans (hrows (n + 1))
              (Erdos597Object.BooleanUnboundedSequences.increasing_sequences_cover hB
                (fun col => Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.imageWeight (F.values (n + 1)) (rows (n + 1), col))
                (rows (n + 1)));
          Exists.casesOn (Erdos597Object.BooleanCountableDecision.decide_countable_family hB base weight hbase hcover)
            fun lower h =>
            And.casesOn h fun hlower right =>
              And.casesOn right fun hlow right =>
                Exists.casesOn right fun columns hcolumns =>
                  have hproperties := fun n =>
                    Decidable.byContradiction fun hnot =>
                      have hzero := bot_unique (iSup_le fun h => False.elim (hnot h));
                      hlower (bot_unique (LE.le.trans_eq (hcolumns n) hzero));
                  let pattern :=
                    { row := fun n => rows (n + 1), column := columns,
                      rows_increasing := fun x x_1 h => hrowStrict (Nat.add_lt_add_right h 1),
                      columns_increasing := fun n => (hproperties n).left,
                      active := fun n m => (hproperties n).right m };
                  Exists.intro lower
                    ⟨hlower,
                      ⟨LE.le.trans hlow hcontext,
                        Exists.intro (rows 0)
                          (Exists.intro pattern
                            ⟨fun n => hrowStrict (Nat.zero_lt_succ n),
                              ⟨LE.le.trans hlow (hrows 0), fun n m =>
                                LE.le.trans (hcolumns n)
                                  (LE.le.trans (iSup_le fun x => le_rfl)
                                    (iInf_le
                                      (fun m =>
                                        Erdos597Object.BooleanRedImages.imageWeight (F.values (n + 1))
                                          (rows (n + 1), columns n m))
                                      m))⟩⟩)⟩⟩

  (label : I → Flypitch.bSet B),
  (∀ (i j : I), i ≠ j → (label i).bv_eq (label j) = ⊥) →
    ∀ (H : SimpleGraph I),
      H.CliqueFree 4 →
        ⊤ ≤
          Erdos597Object.cliqueFreeFourValue (Flypitch.V B) (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.labelDomain label)
            (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.graphName label H) :=

  let edges := Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.graphName label H;
  let body := fun a b c =>
    ⨅ d,
      Flypitch.lattice.imp (d.mem (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.labelDomain label))
        (Erdos597Object.fourCliqueValue (Flypitch.V B) edges a b c d)ᶜ;

    Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_iInf fun d =>
      Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_imp (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_const (d.mem (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.labelDomain label)))

    Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_iInf fun d =>
      Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_imp (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_const (d.mem (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.labelDomain label)))
        (Flypitch.bSet.B_ext_compl (Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteCliqueFree.fourClique_third_ext edges a b d));

  Exists.casesOn h fun H h =>

          Erdos597Object.BooleanFiniteGraphs.naturalLabel_discrete H;

          Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.squareDomain Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockDomain
          Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.squareOrder Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockOrder;
      have hfirst :=
        Flypitch.lattice.bv_context_apply
          (iInf_le
            (fun vertices =>
              (Erdos597Object.memberValue (Flypitch.V Erdos597Object.PatternCollapse.Algebra) vertices
                    ((Flypitch.V Erdos597Object.PatternCollapse.Algebra).fun_map Flypitch.ZFC.ZFCFunc.omega
                      Flypitch.dvector.nil))ᶜ ⊔
                ⨅ edges,
                  (Erdos597Object.graphValue (Flypitch.V Erdos597Object.PatternCollapse.Algebra) vertices edges ⊓
                        Erdos597Object.cliqueFreeFourValue (Flypitch.V Erdos597Object.PatternCollapse.Algebra) vertices
                          edges)ᶜ ⊔
                    ⨅ blue,
                      (Erdos597Object.graphValue (Flypitch.V Erdos597Object.PatternCollapse.Algebra)
                            Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.squareDomain blue)ᶜ ⊔

                            Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.blockDomain Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.squareDomain

                            Erdos597Object.CanonicalDomains.squareDomain edges blue))

          (LE.le.trans le_top hvertices);
      have hsecond :=
        Flypitch.lattice.bv_context_apply
          (LE.le.trans hfirst
            (iInf_le
              (fun relation =>

                  (Erdos597Object.graphValue (Flypitch.V Erdos597Object.PatternCollapse.Algebra) vertices relation ⊓
                    Erdos597Object.cliqueFreeFourValue (Flypitch.V Erdos597Object.PatternCollapse.Algebra) vertices

                        Erdos597Object.blueCopyValue (Flypitch.V Erdos597Object.PatternCollapse.Algebra) vertices

          (LE.le.trans le_top (le_inf hgraph hclique));
      have hfinal :=
        Flypitch.lattice.bv_context_apply
          (LE.le.trans hsecond
            (iInf_le
              (fun blue =>
                Flypitch.lattice.imp

          (LE.le.trans le_top Erdos597Object.BooleanScheduledGraph.graph_spec);

          (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => value ≤ ⊥ ⊔ _a) hnoBlue)

Erdos597Object.BipartiteTarget.short_walk : ∀ (x y : Erdos597Object.BipartiteTarget.Vertex), ∃ p, p.length ≤ 3
theorem Erdos597Object.BipartiteTarget.short_walk : ∀ (x y : Erdos597Object.BipartiteTarget.Vertex),
  ∃ p, p.length ≤ 3 :=
fun x y =>
  if h : Erdos597Object.BipartiteTarget.color x = Erdos597Object.BipartiteTarget.color y then
    have hflip :=
      List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a x_1 =>
        List.finRange 2 = a →
          Fintype.complete (Erdos597Object.BipartiteTarget.color x) ≍ x_1 →
            Erdos597Object.BipartiteTarget.color x ≠ (Erdos597Object.BipartiteTarget.color x).rev)
        (Fintype.complete (Erdos597Object.BipartiteTarget.color x))
        (fun as h =>
          List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
            Eq.ndrec (motive := fun c =>
              ∀ (this : c ∈ Fintype.elems),
                (fun x1 x2 => (fun i => i) x1 :: x2) ⟨1, Nat.le_refl 2⟩ [] ≍ as → this ≍ List.Mem.head as → c ≠ c.rev)
              (fun this tail_eq =>
                Eq.ndrec (motive := fun as =>
                  this ≍ List.Mem.head as →
                    (fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.le_refl 2)⟩ ≠
                      ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.le_refl 2)⟩).rev)
                  (fun h => of_decide_eq_true (id (Eq.refl true))) (eq_of_heq tail_eq))
              (eq_of_heq head_eq) (Fintype.complete (Erdos597Object.BipartiteTarget.color x)))
        (fun b {as} a h =>
          List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
            Eq.ndrec (motive := fun b =>
              (fun x1 x2 => (fun i => i) x1 :: x2) ⟨1, Nat.le_refl 2⟩ [] ≍ as →
                Fintype.complete (Erdos597Object.BipartiteTarget.color x) ≍ List.Mem.tail b a →
                  Erdos597Object.BipartiteTarget.color x ≠ (Erdos597Object.BipartiteTarget.color x).rev)
              (fun tail_eq =>
                Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {as} =>
                  ∀ (a : List.Mem (Erdos597Object.BipartiteTarget.color x) as),
                    Fintype.complete (Erdos597Object.BipartiteTarget.color x) ≍
                        List.Mem.tail ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.le_refl 2)⟩) a →
                      Erdos597Object.BipartiteTarget.color x ≠ (Erdos597Object.BipartiteTarget.color x).rev)
                  (fun a h =>
                    List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a_1 x_1 =>
                      (fun x1 x2 => (fun i => i) x1 :: x2) ⟨1, Nat.le_refl 2⟩ [] = a_1 →
                        a ≍ x_1 → Erdos597Object.BipartiteTarget.color x ≠ (Erdos597Object.BipartiteTarget.color x).rev)
                      a
                      (fun as h =>
                        List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
                          Eq.ndrec (motive := fun c =>
                            ∀ (a : List.Mem c ((fun x1 x2 => (fun i => i) x1 :: x2) ⟨1, Nat.le_refl 2⟩ [])),
                              [] ≍ as → a ≍ List.Mem.head as → c ≠ c.rev)
                            (fun a tail_eq =>
                              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun as =>
                                a ≍ List.Mem.head as →
                                  (fun i => i) ⟨1, Nat.le_refl 2⟩ ≠ ((fun i => i) ⟨1, Nat.le_refl 2⟩).rev)
                                (fun h => of_decide_eq_true (id (Eq.refl true))) (eq_of_heq tail_eq))
                            (eq_of_heq head_eq) a)
                      (fun b {as} a_1 h =>
                        List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
                          Eq.ndrec (motive := fun b =>
                            [] ≍ as →
                              a ≍ List.Mem.tail b a_1 →
                                Erdos597Object.BipartiteTarget.color x ≠ (Erdos597Object.BipartiteTarget.color x).rev)
                            (fun tail_eq =>
                              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {as} =>
                                ∀ (a_2 : List.Mem (Erdos597Object.BipartiteTarget.color x) as),
                                  a ≍ List.Mem.tail ((fun i => i) ⟨1, Nat.le_refl 2⟩) a_2 →
                                    Erdos597Object.BipartiteTarget.color x ≠
                                      (Erdos597Object.BipartiteTarget.color x).rev)
                                (fun a_2 h =>
                                  List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a x_1 =>
                                    [] = a →
                                      a_2 ≍ x_1 →
                                        Erdos597Object.BipartiteTarget.color x ≠
                                          (Erdos597Object.BipartiteTarget.color x).rev)
                                    a_2 (fun as h => False.elim (noConfusion_of_Nat List.ctorIdx h))
                                    (fun b {as} a h => False.elim (noConfusion_of_Nat List.ctorIdx h)) (Eq.refl [])
                                    (HEq.refl a_2))
                                (eq_of_heq tail_eq) a_1)
                            (eq_of_heq head_eq))
                      (Eq.refl ((fun x1 x2 => (fun i => i) x1 :: x2) ⟨1, Nat.le_refl 2⟩ [])) (HEq.refl a))
                  (eq_of_heq tail_eq) a)
              (eq_of_heq head_eq))
        (Eq.refl (List.finRange 2)) (HEq.refl (Fintype.complete (Erdos597Object.BipartiteTarget.color x)));
    have hx := (Erdos597Object.BipartiteTarget.adj_hub x (Erdos597Object.BipartiteTarget.color x).rev).mpr hflip;
    have hy :=
      (Erdos597Object.BipartiteTarget.adj_hub y (Erdos597Object.BipartiteTarget.color x).rev).mpr
        (Eq.mpr (id (congrFun' (congrArg Ne (Eq.symm h)) (Erdos597Object.BipartiteTarget.color x).rev)) hflip);
    Exists.intro (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hx (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons (SimpleGraph.Adj.symm hy) SimpleGraph.Walk.nil))
      (of_eq_true
        (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg LE.le (congrFun' (congrArg HAdd.hAdd (zero_add 1)) 1)) 3)
          (eq_true_of_decide (Eq.refl true))))
  else
    have hx := (Erdos597Object.BipartiteTarget.adj_hub x (Erdos597Object.BipartiteTarget.color y)).mpr h;
    have hh := Ne.symm h;
    have hy := (Erdos597Object.BipartiteTarget.adj_hub y (Erdos597Object.BipartiteTarget.color x)).mpr (Ne.symm h);
    Exists.intro
      (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hx
        (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hh (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons (SimpleGraph.Adj.symm hy) SimpleGraph.Walk.nil)))
      (of_eq_true
        (Eq.trans
          (congrFun' (congrArg LE.le (congrFun' (congrArg HAdd.hAdd (congrFun' (congrArg HAdd.hAdd (zero_add 1)) 1)) 1))
            3)
          (Std.le_refl._simp_1 3)))

@Flypitch.bSet_models_ZFC : ∀ {β : Type u_1} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra β], ⊤ ⊩[Flypitch.V β] Flypitch.ZFC.ZFC
theorem Flypitch.ZFC.bSet_models_ZFC.{u} : ∀ {β : Type u} [inst : CompleteBooleanAlgebra β],
  ⊤ ⊩[Flypitch.V β] Flypitch.ZFC.ZFC :=
fun {β} [CompleteBooleanAlgebra β] =>
  id
    (le_iInf fun f =>
      le_iInf fun hf =>
        id
          (fun hf =>
            Or.casesOn
              (Eq.mp
                (Eq.trans
                  (Flypitch.ZFC.bSet_models_ZFC._simp_1_1 f
                    {Flypitch.ZFC.axiomOfEmptyset, Flypitch.ZFC.axiomOfOrderedPairs, Flypitch.ZFC.axiomOfExtensionality,
                      Flypitch.ZFC.axiomOfUnion, Flypitch.ZFC.axiomOfPowerset, Flypitch.ZFC.axiomOfInfinity,
                      Flypitch.ZFC.axiomOfRegularity, Flypitch.ZFC.zornsLemma}
                    (⋃ n, (fun φ => Flypitch.ZFC.axiomOfCollection φ) '' Set.univ))
                  (congr
                    (congrArg Or
                      (Eq.trans Flypitch.ZFC.bSet_models_ZFC._simp_1_2
                        (congrArg (Or (f = Flypitch.ZFC.axiomOfEmptyset))
                          (Eq.trans Flypitch.ZFC.bSet_models_ZFC._simp_1_2
                            (congrArg (Or (f = Flypitch.ZFC.axiomOfOrderedPairs))
                              (Eq.trans Flypitch.ZFC.bSet_models_ZFC._simp_1_2
                                (congrArg (Or (f = Flypitch.ZFC.axiomOfExtensionality))
                                  (Eq.trans Flypitch.ZFC.bSet_models_ZFC._simp_1_2
                                    (congrArg (Or (f = Flypitch.ZFC.axiomOfUnion))

  A = B → CompleteLatticeHom A.Carrier B.Carrier
def Erdos597Object.SystemGluing.castHom : {A B : Erdos597Object.IterationSystems.Algebra} →
  A = B → CompleteLatticeHom A.Carrier B.Carrier :=
fun {A B} h =>
  Eq.casesOn (motive := fun a t => B = a → h ≍ t → CompleteLatticeHom A.Carrier B.Carrier) h
    (fun h_1 =>
      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {B} => (h : A = B) → h ≍ ⋯ → CompleteLatticeHom A.Carrier B.Carrier)
        (fun h h_2 => CompleteLatticeHom.id A.Carrier) ⋯ h)
    ⋯ ⋯

Erdos597Object.PatternCollapse.patternNonempty : Nonempty Erdos597.Pattern
theorem Erdos597Object.PatternCollapse.patternNonempty : Nonempty Erdos597.Pattern :=
Exists.casesOn (Erdos597.increasing_sequence_in_uncountable_set Set.not_countable_univ Erdos597.zeroOne) fun row h =>
  And.casesOn h fun hrow right =>
    have hcolumns := fun n => Erdos597.increasing_sequence_in_uncountable_set Set.not_countable_univ (row n);
    (fun column x =>
        Nonempty.intro
          { row := row, column := column, rows_increasing := hrow, columns_increasing := fun n => (x n).left,
            active := fun n m => ((fun n => (x n).right) n m).right })
      (fun n => Classical.choose (hcolumns n)) fun n => Classical.choose_spec (hcolumns n)
